items.title_zh: 新型纳米颗粒系统使CRISPR基因编辑效率提升三倍
items.summary_zh: 科学家指出，传统的CRISPR（Clustered Regularly Interspaced Short Palindromic Repeats）技术在细胞内的传递效率较低，只有一小部分CRISPR机械能够进入细胞，且更少的能到达细胞核。通过结合CRISPR与SNA（Stabilized Nucleic Acid）技术，研究团队开发了一种新的递送系统，显著提高了CRISPR的治疗潜力。这一创新策略有望改变医学领域，释放CRISPR的全部治疗能力，为未来的基因治疗提供新的可能性。
items.l1_lead: 新型纳米颗粒系统结合CRISPR与SNA技术，使基因编辑效率提升三倍，显著增强了CRISPR的治疗潜力，为未来基因治疗开辟新方向。
items.l2_summary: 科学家们发现，传统的CRISPR（成簇的规律间隔短回文重复序列）基因编辑技术在细胞内的传递效率较低，只有一小部分CRISPR机械能够成功进入细胞，并且更少的能够到达细胞核，这限制了其在基因治疗中的应用潜力。为了解决这一问题，研究团队结合了CRISPR与SNA（稳定核酸，Stabilized Nucleic Acid）技术，开发出一种新型的递送系统。这一创新的递送策略显著提高了CRISPR的治疗效率，研究表明其效率提升了三倍。这一成果不仅为CRISPR技术的应用开辟了新的可能性，也为未来的基因治疗提供了更为有效的工具，具有重要的医学意义。通过这一新系统，科学家们有望释放CRISPR的全部治疗能力，推动基因治疗的进展，改变医学领域的现状。

items.title: Timing of Antiplatelet and Anticoagulant Therapy Resumption Following Gastrointestinal Bleeding: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
items.body: Background & aims Gastrointestinal bleeding is a major complication in patients receiving antithrombotic therapy. Following gastrointestinal bleeding, clinicians face a critical dilemma: resuming therapy risks rebleeding, whereas discontinuation increases thrombotic events and mortality. This meta-analysis aimed to quantify the risks and benefits of antithrombotic therapy resumption vs discontinuation following gastrointestinal bleeding, and to evaluate the impact of resumption timing on recurrent gastrointestinal bleeding, major vascular events, and all-cause mortality. Methods We searched Embase, Scopus, PubMed, Web of Science, and Cochrane Library from inception to September 2025 for studies comparing antithrombotic therapy resumption vs delayed resumption or discontinuation after gastrointestinal bleeding. This review was registered with PROSPERO (CRD420251141360). Results Twenty-one studies were included. Antiplatelet therapy resumption reduced major vascular events (hazard ratio, 0.70; 95% confidence interval, 0.60-0.83; absolute risk difference, -3.6%) and mortality (hazard ratio, 0.44; 95% confidence interval, 0.26-0.76; absolute risk difference, -10.0%), but increased recurrent gastrointestinal bleeding (hazard ratio, 1.42; 95% confidence interval, 1.09-1.84; absolute risk difference, +2.2%). Similarly, anticoagulant therapy resumption reduced major vascular events (hazard ratio, 0.45; 95% confidence interval, 0.34-0.58; absolute risk difference, -7.0%) and mortality (hazard ratio, 0.53; 95% confidence interval, 0.43-0.65; absolute risk difference, -11.1%), but increased recurrent gastrointestinal bleeding (hazard ratio, 1.59; 95% confidence interval, 1.38-1.83; absolute risk difference, +2.6%). Notably, early resumption of both antiplatelet therapy and anticoagulant therapy within 7 days significantly reduced major vascular events (hazard ratio, 0.39; 95% confidence interval, 0.19-0.78; absolute risk difference, -11.4%) but increased recurrent gastrointestinal bleeding (hazard ratio, 1.49; 95% confidence interval, 1.18-1.89; absolute risk difference, +2.7%), with no significant difference in mortality (hazard ratio, 0.78; 95% confidence interval, 0.29-2.10; absolute risk difference, -4.7%). Conclusions Both antiplatelet therapy and anticoagulant therapy resumption after gastrointestinal bleeding provide substantial clinical benefits despite increased recurrent gastrointestinal bleeding risk. Early resumption (≤7 days) offers favorable benefit-risk balance.
items.journal: Clinical gastroenterology and hepatology : the official clinical practice journal of the American Gastroenterological Association
items.authors: Liu Y, Hu Y, Song S, Goh WWB, Tsoi KKF, Sung JJY.
items.title_zh: 抗血小板和抗凝治疗在胃肠出血后的恢复时机研究
items.summary_zh: 胃肠出血是接受抗血栓治疗患者的一大并发症。本文系统评估了抗血小板和抗凝治疗在胃肠出血后的恢复与延迟恢复或停用的风险与益处，并分析了恢复时机对复发性胃肠出血、重大血管事件及全因死亡率的影响。通过对Embase、Scopus、PubMed、Web of Science和Cochrane Library的文献检索，共纳入21项研究。结果显示，抗血小板治疗的恢复显著降低了重大血管事件（风险比0.70，95%置信区间0.60-0.83，绝对风险差-3.6%）和死亡率（风险比0.44，95%置信区间0.26-0.76，绝对风险差-10.0%），但复发性胃肠出血风险增加（风险比1.42，95%置信区间1.09-1.84，绝对风险差+2.2%）。抗凝治疗的恢复同样降低了重大血管事件。
items.l1_lead: 抗血小板和抗凝治疗在胃肠出血后的及时恢复可显著降低重大血管事件和死亡率，但会增加复发性胃肠出血的风险。
items.l2_summary:
胃肠出血是接受抗血栓治疗患者常见的并发症，本文系统评估了抗血小板治疗（antiplatelet therapy）和抗凝治疗（anticoagulant therapy）在胃肠出血后的恢复时机对患者的影响，特别是其与复发性胃肠出血、重大血管事件及全因死亡率之间的关系。研究通过对Embase、Scopus、PubMed、Web of Science和Cochrane Library的文献检索，共纳入21项相关研究进行分析。

结果显示，抗血小板治疗的恢复显著降低了重大血管事件的发生风险，风险比为0.70（95%置信区间0.60-0.83），绝对风险差为-3.6%。此外，抗血小板治疗的恢复还显著降低了全因死亡率，风险比为0.44（95%置信区间0.26-0.76），绝对风险差为-10.0%。然而，恢复抗血小板治疗后，复发性胃肠出血的风险却有所增加，风险比为1.42（95%置信区间1.09-1.84），绝对风险差为+2.2%。同样，抗凝治疗的恢复也显示出降低重大血管事件的效果，尽管具体的数据未在此文中详细列出。

综上所述，尽管抗血小板和抗凝治疗的恢复在降低重大血管事件和死亡率方面具有明显的益处，但同时也伴随着复发性胃肠出血风险的增加。因此，在临床实践中，医生需要综合考虑患者的具体情况，权衡抗血栓治疗的恢复时机，以实现最佳的治疗效果和安全性。

items.title: A six-tiered framework for evaluating AI models from repeatability to replaceability.
items.body: Artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly transforming biotechnology and medicine. But evaluating its safety, effectiveness, and generalizability is increasingly challenging, especially for complex generative models. Traditional evaluation metrics often fall short in high-stakes applications where reliability and adaptability are critical. We propose a six-tiered framework to guide AI evaluation across the dimensions of repeatability, reproducibility, robustness, rigidity, reusability, and replaceability. These tiers reflect increasing expectations, from basic consistency to deployment. Each is defined clearly, with actionable testing methodologies informed by literature. Designed for flexibility, the framework applies to both traditional and generative AI. Through case studies in diagnostics and medical large language models (LLM), we demonstrate its utility in fostering trustworthy, accountable, and effective AI for biomedicine, biotechnology, and beyond.
items.authors: Tian S, Lam AWY, Sung JJ, Goh WWB.
items.title_zh: 评估人工智能模型的六层框架
items.summary_zh: 人工智能（AI）正在迅速改变生物技术和医学，但评估其安全性、有效性和普适性变得愈加困难，尤其是对于复杂的生成模型。传统的评估指标在高风险应用中往往不足以满足可靠性和适应性的要求。本文提出了一种六层框架，以指导AI在可重复性、可再现性、稳健性、刚性、可重用性和可替代性等维度的评估。这些层次反映了从基本一致性到部署的逐步期望。每一层都有明确的定义，并结合文献提供可操作的测试方法。该框架设计灵活，适用于传统AI和生成AI。通过在诊断和医学大语言模型（LLM）中的案例研究，展示了该框架在促进生物医学和生物技术领域可信、负责任和有效的AI方面的实用性。
items.l1_lead: 本文提出的六层框架为评估人工智能在生物医学和生物技术中的安全性与有效性提供了系统化的方法，旨在提升其可靠性和适应性。
items.l2_summary:
人工智能（AI）在生物技术和医学领域的迅速发展带来了许多机遇，但同时也使得评估其安全性、有效性和普适性变得愈加复杂，尤其是在复杂的生成模型（generative models）中。传统的评估指标在高风险应用中往往无法满足对可靠性和适应性的严格要求。为此，本文提出了一种六层框架，以指导对AI模型的评估，涵盖可重复性、可再现性、稳健性、刚性、可重用性和可替代性等六个维度。这些层次从基本一致性到实际部署，逐步反映了对AI模型的期望。

每一层都有明确的定义，并结合相关文献提供了可操作的测试方法，确保评估过程的科学性和系统性。该框架的设计具有灵活性，适用于传统AI和生成AI的评估，能够适应不同类型的应用场景。通过在诊断和医学大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLM）中的案例研究，本文展示了该框架在促进生物医学和生物技术领域中可信、负责任和有效的AI应用方面的实用性。这一框架不仅为研究人员提供了评估工具，也为行业实践提供了指导，旨在推动AI技术在医疗健康领域的安全应用，确保其在复杂环境中的可靠性和适应性。

items.title: Gene editing technique CRISPR identifies dangerous breast cancer mutations
items.body: Mutations in BRCA genes are linked to the early onset of breast and ovarian cancers. But the effect of most mutations is unclear. Now new research can distinguish harmless from dangerous mutations.
items.authors: Jay Shendure
items.attribution_basis: The Conversation 作者页 /profiles/jay-shendure-553297（名+姓双命中）
items.title_zh: 基因编辑技术CRISPR识别危险乳腺癌突变
items.summary_zh: BRCA基因突变与乳腺癌和卵巢癌的早发有关，但大多数突变的影响尚不明确。最新研究利用基因编辑技术CRISPR，能够区分无害突变与危险突变。这项研究为理解BRCA基因突变的不同影响提供了新的视角，有助于更准确地评估乳腺癌风险，并为个性化医疗提供支持。
items.l1_lead: 最新研究利用CRISPR技术成功区分BRCA基因中的无害突变与危险突变，为乳腺癌风险评估和个性化医疗提供了新视角。
items.l2_summary:
最新研究利用基因编辑技术CRISPR（成簇规律间隔短回文重复序列）对BRCA基因突变进行深入分析，揭示了其与乳腺癌和卵巢癌早发之间的关系。BRCA基因突变被广泛认为与这些癌症的发生密切相关，但大多数突变的具体影响仍然不够明确。通过CRISPR技术，研究人员能够有效区分无害突变与危险突变，这一创新方法为理解BRCA基因突变的不同生物学效应提供了新的视角。

该研究的核心论点在于，传统的基因检测方法难以准确评估BRCA基因突变的风险，而CRISPR技术的应用则使得研究者能够更精确地识别出哪些突变可能导致乳腺癌的高风险。这一发现不仅为科学界提供了重要的理论依据，也为临床实践中的个性化医疗提供了支持。通过更准确地评估乳腺癌风险，医生可以为患者制定更为合理的监测和预防策略，从而提高早期发现和治疗的机会。

总的来说，这项研究展示了CRISPR技术在基因突变研究中的巨大潜力，尤其是在癌症风险评估方面的应用前景。随着对BRCA基因突变影响的深入理解，未来有望为乳腺癌和卵巢癌的预防和治疗提供更加个性化的方案，改善患者的生活质量和生存率。
items.l3_translation:
超过100万名女性接受了BRCA1和BRCA2的基因检测，这些基因的突变可能显著增加早发性乳腺癌和卵巢癌的风险。但对于许多女性来说，检测结果却是模糊不清的。这是因为尚不清楚某些基因变异是无害的还是会导致癌症。

BRCA1是最早发现的癌症易感基因之一，已经研究了超过20年。该基因产生一种修复DNA损伤的蛋白质，否则这些损伤可能导致肿瘤的形成。自其发现以来，研究人员和临床医生已经识别出BRCA1的许多基因变异，但对于其中大多数，我们无法判断它们是否会损害基因的功能——从而提高癌症风险——或它们是否完全无害。

我们的研究团队在新兴的基因组医学领域工作，该领域利用个体的遗传信息来开具医疗方案。我们认识到，这种“意义不明的变异”限制了基因检测的实用性以及基因组医学的前景。我们知道，随着基因检测扩展到整个群体，BRCA1和其他“医学可操作”基因中不确定变异的数量预计将呈指数增长，这个问题可能会变得更糟。

在一项研究中，我们着手应用CRISPR基因组编辑来解决这些意义不明的变异所带来的挑战。CRISPR具有巨大的潜力，因为该技术允许像我们这样的研究人员对人类基因进行调整。CRISPR使我们能够对DNA进行非常具体的更改，“编辑”我们的DNA——因此有了“基因组编辑”这一说法。

尽管有许多研究试图利用CRISPR治疗疾病，但它也可以用于在人类细胞中引入特定突变，这些细胞在培养皿中生长，目的是研究这些突变对细胞的影响——例如，它们是否导致基因功能失常。

在我们的研究中，我们使用CRISPR基因组编辑故意设计了约4000种不同的BRCA1基因变异，几乎涵盖了该基因最重要区域的所有可能变异。重要的是，我们所使用的人类细胞的存活依赖于BRCA1基因的完整功能。因此，含有破坏BRCA1基因功能的突变的细胞无法存活。另一方面，含有对BRCA1基因功能没有影响的突变的细胞则生存良好。通过DNA测序，我们追踪了哪些突变与细胞死亡或存活相关。

当我们将导致细胞死亡的突变与已知增加癌症风险的变异进行比较时，我们注意到它们是相同的。这使我们有信心说，这些变异在培养皿中的行为可以预测人类的癌症风险。

尽管科学家们多年来一直使用实验室检测来测试BRCA1中的变异，但我们的工作有三个不同之处。

首先，我们测试的变异数量远远超过以往，包括数千种以前从未观察到但几乎肯定存在于至少数百名活人中的变异。

其次，历史上BRCA1变异的测试是在“脱离上下文”的基因中进行的——具体来说，仅研究编码BRCA1蛋白的DNA序列，而不是调节其表达的周围序列。CRISPR首次使我们能够在人体基因组中创建和测试这些突变。

最后，对于我们在患者中观察到的数百种BRCA1变异，我们对它们是否增加乳腺癌和卵巢癌风险的判断几乎是完全准确的。也就是说，在我们的实验中与细胞存活兼容的变异在患者中是良性的，而在我们的实验中损害细胞存活的变异则会导致癌症风险。这使我们对其他以前从未观察到但不可避免将被观察到的变异的预测充满信心，特别是随着越来越多的女性接受该基因突变的筛查。

由于与来自人类研究的“金标准”数据之间的强一致性，我们预测我们的结果可以为那些在BRCA1中具有难以解释的变异的女性提供更好的答案。这包括许多癌症风险升高的女性，但以前可能会被基因检测遗漏。对于这些女性，了解她们的突变意味着什么可能会对她们所接受的医疗护理产生重要影响。

items.title: Navigating the next frontier in biomedicine: breakthroughs and insights in nucleic acid therapeutics.
items.body: Nucleic acid therapeutics are rapidly emerging as a transformative drug paradigm, offering precise and programmable regulation of gene expression across a broad spectrum of diseases. This review summarizes recent advances in key platforms-including antisense oligonucleotides, siRNA, miRNA, mRNA, and aptamers-emphasizing their unique mechanisms of action and therapeutic potential. We systematically outline critical contributions of chemical modification and delivery engineering, including backbone and sugar modifications, site-specific design, N -acetylgalactosamine (GalNAc) conjugation, and lipid nanoparticles, which collectively enhance stability, target specificity, and clinical applicability. Finally, we discuss persistent challenges such as immune activation, large-scale manufacturing, and long-term safety, and provide perspectives on future directions involving CRISPR-based gene editing, synthetic biology, nanotechnology, smart delivery systems, and combination therapies, aiming to offer strategic insights for the development and clinical translation of nucleic acid drugs.
items.authors: Wu S, Zhang Z, Zhao Z, Cui C, Tan W.
items.title_zh: 生物医学新前沿：核酸治疗的突破与见解
items.summary_zh: 核酸治疗作为一种变革性的药物范式，正在迅速崛起，能够在广泛疾病中精确调控基因表达。本文综述了抗病毒寡核苷酸（antisense oligonucleotides）、小干扰RNA（siRNA）、微RNA（miRNA）、信使RNA（mRNA）和适配体（aptamers）等关键平台的最新进展，强调其独特的作用机制和治疗潜力。我们系统性地概述了化学修饰和递送工程的关键贡献，包括骨架和糖的修饰、特定位点设计、N-乙酰半乳糖胺（GalNAc）结合以及脂质纳米颗粒，这些因素共同增强了稳定性、靶向特异性和临床适用性。最后，我们讨论了免疫激活、大规模生产和长期安全性等持续挑战，并展望了未来的方向，包括基于CRISPR的基因编辑、合成生物学、纳米技术、智能递送系统和组合疗法，为核酸药物的开发和临床转化提供战略见解。
items.l1_lead: 核酸治疗作为新兴药物范式，通过精确调控基因表达展现出广泛的治疗潜力，尽管仍面临生产和安全性等挑战。
items.l2_summary:
核酸治疗作为一种新兴的药物开发模式，正在迅速成为生物医学领域的重要研究方向，能够在多种疾病中实现对基因表达的精确调控。本文综述了几种关键的核酸治疗平台，包括抗病毒寡核苷酸（antisense oligonucleotides）、小干扰RNA（siRNA）、微RNA（miRNA）、信使RNA（mRNA）和适配体（aptamers），并强调了它们各自独特的作用机制和治疗潜力。通过对这些平台的最新进展进行系统性分析，本文指出了化学修饰和递送工程在提升核酸药物的稳定性、靶向特异性和临床适用性方面的重要贡献。例如，骨架和糖的修饰、特定位点设计、N-乙酰半乳糖胺（GalNAc）结合以及脂质纳米颗粒的应用，均显著增强了核酸药物的性能。

然而，尽管核酸治疗展现出巨大的潜力，仍面临一些挑战，包括免疫激活、大规模生产的可行性以及长期安全性等问题。本文还展望了未来的发展方向，提出基于CRISPR的基因编辑技术、合成生物学、纳米技术、智能递送系统和组合疗法等新兴策略，将为核酸药物的开发和临床转化提供新的思路和解决方案。这些前沿技术的结合有望推动核酸治疗的进一步发展，使其在临床应用中发挥更大的作用。总之，核酸治疗的研究不仅为疾病治疗提供了新的可能性，也为生物医学领域的创新发展奠定了基础。

items.title: Single-Atom Enzymes: From Evolutionary Insights, Precision Engineering to Breakthroughs in Biomedical Applications.
items.body: Single-atom enzymes (SAEs), integrating the catalytic efficiency of single-atom catalysts with enzymatic functions, represent a paradigm shift in biomedicine. Comprising natural enzymes, mimic enzymes, and single-atom nanozymes, SAEs leverage isolated metal atoms as catalytic centers. Natural enzymes, evolved over billions of years, feature monoatomic active sites for precise biocatalysis under physiological conditions. Mimic enzymes (e.g., DNAzymes) represent a biomimetic adaptation, replicating natural active sites via programmable molecular scaffolds to enhance stability while inheriting an evolutionary bias that prioritizes structural robustness over catalytic diversity, limiting multifunctionality. In contrast, nanozymes embody an evolutionary leap: they sacrifice partial biocompatibility to achieve multienzyme-mimicking capabilities and scalable production through inorganic nanomaterial engineering, thereby expanding the catalytic landscape beyond biological boundaries, though this advancement introduces concomitant immunogenicity challenges. This review systematically examines cutting-edge advances in SAE applications across biomedical domains including biosensing, oncotherapy, antimicrobial strategies, and oxidative stress management. This review particularly presents a critical analysis of current challenges and emerging opportunities, proposing rational design principles for next-generation SAEs with enhanced multifunctionality. By elucidating fundamental design strategies and translational potential, this work aims to accelerate the development of precision catalytic platforms for modern biomedicine.
items.authors: Xu Y, Dong C, Liu X, Wei D, Chen Z, Zhou H, Li JB, Yang Y, Tan W.
items.title_zh: 单原子酶：从进化洞察到生物医学应用的突破
items.summary_zh: 单原子酶（Single-Atom Enzymes, SAEs）结合了单原子催化剂的催化效率与酶的功能，代表了生物医学领域的范式转变。SAEs包括天然酶、模拟酶和单原子纳米酶，利用孤立的金属原子作为催化中心。天然酶经过数十亿年的进化，具有单原子活性位点，能够在生理条件下进行精确的生物催化。模拟酶（如DNA酶）通过可编程分子支架复制天然活性位点，增强稳定性，但在催化多样性上存在局限。相比之下，纳米酶则通过无机纳米材料工程实现多酶模拟能力，尽管牺牲了部分生物相容性，并引入了免疫原性挑战。本文系统评述了SAE在生物医学领域的前沿应用，包括生物传感、肿瘤治疗、抗微生物策略和氧化应激管理，分析当前挑战与新兴机遇，并提出合理设计原则。
items.l1_lead: 单原子酶结合了高效催化与生物功能，展现出在生物医学领域的广泛应用潜力，推动了生物催化的创新与发展。
items.l2_summary:
单原子酶（Single-Atom Enzymes, SAEs）是一种新兴的催化剂，结合了单原子催化剂的高效性与酶的生物功能，标志着生物医学领域的重大进展。SAEs包括天然酶、模拟酶和单原子纳米酶，这些催化剂利用孤立的金属原子作为催化中心。天然酶经过数十亿年的进化，具备了单原子活性位点，能够在生理条件下进行高效且精确的生物催化。相比之下，模拟酶（如DNA酶）通过可编程的分子支架复制天然酶的活性位点，虽然增强了稳定性，但在催化的多样性方面存在一定的局限性。而单原子纳米酶则通过无机纳米材料的工程化设计实现了多酶的模拟能力，尽管这可能牺牲部分生物相容性，并引入免疫原性挑战。

在生物医学应用方面，SAEs展现了广泛的前沿潜力，包括生物传感、肿瘤治疗、抗微生物策略和氧化应激管理等领域。通过对SAEs的系统评述，本文分析了当前在这些应用中面临的挑战与新兴机遇，并提出了一些合理的设计原则，以指导未来的研究方向。SAEs的独特性质使其在生物催化和生物医学应用中具有重要的研究价值，推动了相关领域的技术进步与创新。

items.title: Gut dysbiosis in oncology: a risk factor for immunoresistance.
items.body: The gut microbiome is recognized as a determinant of response to immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI) therapies in cancer. However, the clinical translation of microbiome science has been hampered by inconsistent definitions of dysbiosis, inadequate biomarker frameworks, and limited mechanistic understanding. In this review, we synthesize the current state of knowledge on how gut microbial composition and function influence ICI efficacy, highlighting both correlative and causal evidence. We discuss computational approaches based on α-diversity or taxonomic abundance and argue for more functionally and clinically informative models, such as the topological score (TOPOSCORE) and other dysbiosis indices derived from machine learning. Using retrospective analyses of metagenomic datasets from thousands of patients and healthy controls, we examine microbial patterns that distinguish responders from non-responders. We also explore how dysbiosis perturbs immunoregulatory pathways, including bile acid metabolism, gut permeability, and mucosal immunomodulation. Finally, we assess emerging therapeutic strategies aimed at correcting microbiome dysfunction - including dietary modification, bacterial consortia, and fecal microbiota transplantation - and describe how they are being deployed in multiple clinical trials. We conclude with a brief discussion of the ONCOBIOME initiative, which works with international partners to incorporate microbiome science into oncology workflows. By refining our understanding of gut-immune interactions and translating it into action, microbiome-informed oncology may unlock new therapeutic potential for patients previously resistant to immunotherapy.
items.authors: Almonte AA, Thomas S, Iebba V, Kroemer G, Derosa L, Zitvogel L.
items.title_zh: 肠道微生物失调与肿瘤免疫耐受风险
items.summary_zh: 肠道微生物组被认为是癌症免疫检查点抑制剂（ICI）疗法反应的决定因素。然而，微生物组科学的临床转化受到失调（dysbiosis）定义不一致、标志物框架不足和机制理解有限的阻碍。本文综述了肠道微生物组成和功能如何影响ICI疗效的现状，强调了相关和因果证据。我们讨论了基于α多样性或分类丰度的计算方法，并主张采用更具功能性和临床信息的模型，如拓扑评分（TOPOSCORE）及其他基于机器学习的失调指数。通过对数千名患者和健康对照的宏基因组数据集进行回顾性分析，我们考察了区分应答者与非应答者的微生物模式。此外，我们探讨了失调如何扰乱免疫调节通路，包括胆汁酸代谢、肠道通透性和黏膜免疫调节。最后，我们评估了旨在纠正微生物组功能障碍的新兴治疗策略，包括饮食调整、细菌群体和粪便微生物移植，并描述了它们在多个临床试验中的应用。
items.l1_lead: 肠道微生物失调影响癌症免疫检查点抑制剂疗法的效果，研究强调了微生物组对免疫调节的作用及新兴治疗策略的潜力。
items.l2_summary:
肠道微生物组在癌症免疫检查点抑制剂（ICI）疗法的反应中被认为是一个重要的决定因素。然而，微生物组科学的临床转化面临着一些挑战，包括对微生物失调（dysbiosis）的定义不一致、标志物框架不足以及对机制理解的局限。本文综述了肠道微生物的组成和功能如何影响ICI疗效的现状，并强调了相关和因果证据。研究表明，基于α多样性或分类丰度的计算方法存在一定局限性，因此建议采用更具功能性和临床信息的模型，如拓扑评分（TOPOSCORE）及其他基于机器学习的失调指数。

通过对数千名患者和健康对照的宏基因组数据集进行回顾性分析，研究考察了能够区分应答者与非应答者的微生物模式。这些分析揭示了失调如何干扰免疫调节通路，包括胆汁酸代谢、肠道通透性和黏膜免疫调节等关键机制。此外，本文还评估了旨在纠正微生物组功能障碍的新兴治疗策略，包括饮食调整、细菌群体和粪便微生物移植，并描述了这些策略在多个临床试验中的应用。

综上所述，肠道微生物组的失调与肿瘤免疫耐受风险密切相关，理解其机制和影响因素对于提高ICI疗法的疗效具有重要意义。未来的研究需要进一步明确微生物组的功能性特征，并探索更有效的干预措施，以改善癌症患者的治疗反应。

items.title: Quantum information meets high-energy physics: input to the update of the European strategy for particle physics.
items.body: Some of the most astonishing and prominent properties of Quantum Mechanics, such as entanglement and Bell nonlocality, have only been studied extensively in dedicated low-energy laboratory setups. The feasibility of these studies in the high-energy regime explored by particle colliders was only recently shown and has gathered the attention of the scientific community. For the range of particles and fundamental interactions involved, particle colliders provide a novel environment where quantum information theory can be probed, with energies exceeding by about 12 orders of magnitude those employed in dedicated laboratory setups. Furthermore, collider detectors have inherent advantages in performing certain quantum information measurements and allow for the reconstruction of the state of the system under consideration via quantum state tomography. Here, we elaborate on the potential, challenges, and goals of this innovative and rapidly evolving line of research and discuss its expected impact on both quantum information theory and high-energy physics.
items.authors: Afik Y, Fabbri F, Low M, Marzola L, Aguilar-Saavedra JA, Altakach MM, Asbah NA, Bai Y, Banks H, Barr AJ, Bernal A, Browder TE, Caban P, Casas JA, Cheng K, Déliot F, Demina R, Di Domenico A, Eckstein M, Fabbrichesi M, Fuk

items.title_zh: 量子信息与高能物理的交汇：对欧洲粒子物理战略更新的贡献
items.summary_zh: 量子力学的一些显著特性，如纠缠和贝尔非局域性，主要在低能实验室环境中得到广泛研究。最近，粒子对撞机高能领域的研究显示了这些特性的可行性，吸引了科学界的关注。粒子对撞机提供了一种新颖的环境，能够探测量子信息理论，其能量比专用实验室设置高出约12个数量级。此外，对撞机探测器在进行某些量子信息测量时具有固有优势，并允许通过量子态层析（quantum state tomography）重构系统状态。本文阐述了这一快速发展的研究领域的潜力、挑战和目标，并讨论其对量子信息理论和高能物理的预期影响。
items.l1_lead: 量子信息理论在高能物理领域的应用潜力巨大，粒子对撞机为研究量子特性提供了新环境，推动了相关科学的发展。
items.l2_summary:
量子信息与高能物理的交汇为科学研究开辟了新的视野，尤其是在粒子对撞机的高能实验中，量子力学的一些显著特性，如纠缠和贝尔非局域性，得到了新的关注。传统上，这些特性主要在低能实验室环境中进行研究，但最近的发现表明，粒子对撞机提供了一种独特的实验环境，能够探测量子信息理论，其能量比专用实验室设置高出约12个数量级。这一高能环境不仅为量子信息的研究提供了新的平台，还使得对撞机探测器在进行某些量子信息测量时展现出固有的优势。

通过量子态层析（quantum state tomography），研究人员能够重构系统状态，从而深入理解量子信息的特性。这一快速发展的研究领域面临着诸多挑战，但其潜力不可小觑。量子信息理论与高能物理的结合，预示着未来在基础物理学和量子技术方面的重大突破。本文探讨了这一交汇领域的目标和预期影响，强调了量子信息研究在高能物理中的重要性，以及它可能为科学界带来的新机遇。随着对撞机技术的不断进步，量子信息的应用前景将更加广阔，推动相关领域的进一步发展。

items.title: The multi-kingdom cancer microbiome.
items.body: Microbial influence on cancer development and therapeutic response is a growing area of cancer research. Although it is known that microorganisms can colonize certain tissues and contribute to tumour initiation, the use of deep sequencing technologies and computational pipelines has led to reports of multi-kingdom microbial communities in a growing list of cancer types. This has prompted discussions on the role and scope of microbial presence in cancer, while raising the possibility of microbiome-based diagnostic, prognostic and therapeutic tools. However, additional investigation and thorough validation of cancer microbiome findings are required before this translational potential can be realized. Here we provide historical context and a conceptual framework for the so-called cancer microbiome and summarize experimental studies into tumour-associated bacteria, fungi and other microorganisms. We also discuss the current evidence for microbial colonization of tumours and their varied influence on the disease, including recent debates. Finally, we consider outstanding questions and discuss our outlook for the field.
items.authors: Dohlman AB, Pan X, Zitvogel L, Iliev ID.
items.title_zh: 多王国癌症微生物组的研究进展
items.summary_zh: 微生物对癌症发展和治疗反应的影响正成为癌症研究的一个重要领域。研究表明，微生物能够定殖特定组织并促进肿瘤的形成。随着深度测序技术和计算管道的发展，越来越多的癌症类型中发现了多王国微生物群落。这引发了关于微生物在癌症中的角色和影响范围的讨论，并提出了基于微生物组的诊断、预后和治疗工具的可能性。然而，在实现这一转化潜力之前，癌症微生物组的发现需要进一步的研究和严格的验证。本文提供了癌症微生物组的历史背景和概念框架，并总结了与肿瘤相关的细菌、真菌及其他微生物的实验研究，讨论了微生物对肿瘤的定殖及其对疾病的多样影响，包括近期的争论。最后，我们考虑了未解的问题并展望该领域的未来。
items.l1_lead: 微生物在癌症发展和治疗中的作用日益受到关注，研究显示其可能影响肿瘤形成，未来有望为癌症诊断和治疗提供新工具，但仍需进一步验证。
items.l2_summary:
微生物在癌症发展及其治疗反应中的作用正逐渐成为癌症研究的重要领域。研究表明，微生物能够在特定组织中定殖，并促进肿瘤的形成。随着深度测序技术和计算管道的发展，越来越多的癌症类型中被发现存在多王国微生物群落，这一发现引发了关于微生物在癌症中角色及其影响范围的广泛讨论。研究者们提出了基于微生物组（microbiome）的诊断、预后和治疗工具的潜在可能性，这为癌症的个性化治疗提供了新的思路。

然而，在实现这一转化潜力之前，癌症微生物组的发现仍需进一步的研究与严格的验证。本文回顾了癌症微生物组的历史背景和概念框架，并总结了与肿瘤相关的细菌、真菌及其他微生物的实验研究。研究显示，微生物不仅能够定殖于肿瘤组织，还可能通过多种机制影响疾病的进展和患者的预后。这些机制包括微生物代谢产物的产生、免疫系统的调节以及对抗肿瘤治疗的反应等。

尽管已有研究提供了一些初步证据，但在微生物与癌症之间的关系上仍存在许多未解的问题。近期的争论集中在微生物组的组成、功能及其对不同癌症类型的特异性影响上。未来的研究需要更加系统和深入的探索，以揭示微生物在癌症发生、发展及治疗中的具体作用机制。

综上所述，癌症微生物组的研究为我们理解癌症的复杂性提供了新的视角，同时也为癌症的诊断和治疗开辟了新的方向。随着研究的深入，微生物组有望成为癌症管理的重要组成部分，推动个性化医疗的发展。

items.title: Microbiota-centered interventions to boost immune checkpoint blockade therapies.
items.body: Immune checkpoint blockade therapies have markedly advanced cancer treatment by invigorating antitumor immunity and extending patient survival. However, therapeutic resistance and immune-related toxicities remain major concerns. Emerging evidence indicates that microbial dysbiosis diminishes therapeutic response rates, while a diverse gut ecology and key beneficial taxa correlate with improved treatment outcomes. Therefore, there is a growing understanding that manipulating the gut microbiota could boost therapy efficacy. This review examines burgeoning methods that target the gut microbiome to optimize therapy and innovative diagnostic tools to detect dysbiosis, and highlights challenges that remain to be addressed in the field.
items.authors: Almonte AA, Thomas S, Zitvogel L.
items.title_zh: 微生物组干预提升免疫检查点抑制疗法效果
items.summary_zh: 免疫检查点抑制疗法显著推动了癌症治疗，通过增强抗肿瘤免疫力延长患者生存期。然而，治疗抵抗和免疫相关毒性仍然是主要问题。新兴证据表明，微生物失调（dysbiosis）会降低治疗反应率，而多样化的肠道生态和关键有益菌群与改善的治疗结果相关。因此，操控肠道微生物组被认为能够提升疗效。本文评述了针对肠道微生物组的最新干预方法，以优化治疗效果，并探讨了检测微生物失调的创新诊断工具，同时强调了该领域仍需解决的挑战。
items.l1_lead: 微生物组干预有望通过改善肠道生态，提升免疫检查点抑制疗法的效果，从而优化癌症治疗结果。
items.l2_summary:
免疫检查点抑制疗法（immune checkpoint inhibition）在癌症治疗中取得了显著进展，能够通过增强抗肿瘤免疫力来延长患者的生存期。然而，治疗抵抗和免疫相关毒性仍然是该疗法面临的主要挑战。近年来的研究表明，微生物失调（dysbiosis）可能会降低患者对免疫检查点抑制疗法的反应率，而多样化的肠道生态和特定有益菌群的存在则与改善的治疗结果密切相关。因此，调控肠道微生物组被认为是提升免疫检查点抑制疗法疗效的一种潜在策略。

在这一背景下，本文评述了针对肠道微生物组的最新干预方法，旨在优化免疫检查点抑制疗法的效果。研究者们探索了多种干预手段，包括益生菌（probiotics）、益生元（prebiotics）以及饮食干预等，均显示出在改善肠道微生物组组成方面的潜力，从而可能增强患者对免疫治疗的反应。此外，检测微生物失调的创新诊断工具也在不断发展，这些工具能够帮助临床医生更好地评估患者的微生物组状态，并制定个性化的干预方案。

尽管这一领域的研究取得了一定进展，但仍面临诸多挑战。例如，如何确定不同患者的最佳微生物组干预方案，以及如何在临床实践中有效整合这些干预措施，都是亟待解决的问题。总体而言，微生物组的干预为提升免疫检查点抑制疗法的效果提供了新的思路，未来的研究将进一步揭示其在癌症治疗中的潜在应用价值。

items.title: Causal machine learning for single-cell genomics.
items.body: Advances in single-cell '-omics' allow unprecedented insights into the transcriptional profiles of individual cells and, when combined with large-scale perturbation screens, enable measuring of the effect of targeted perturbations on the whole transcriptome. These advances provide an opportunity to better understand the causative role of genes in complex biological processes. In this Perspective, we delineate the application of causal machine learning to single-cell genomics and its associated challenges. We first present the causal model that is most commonly applied to single-cell biology and then identify and discuss potential approaches to three open problems: the lack of generalization of models to novel experimental conditions, the complexity of interpreting learned models, and the difficulty of learning cell dynamics.
items.authors: Tejada-Lapuerta A, Bertin P, Bauer S, Aliee H, Bengio Y, Theis FJ.
items.title_zh: 因果机器学习在单细胞基因组学中的应用
items.summary_zh: 单细胞“组学”的进展为个体细胞的转录谱提供了前所未有的洞察，并结合大规模干扰筛选，能够测量针对性干扰对整个转录组的影响。这些进展为更好地理解基因在复杂生物过程中的因果作用提供了机会。本文探讨了因果机器学习在单细胞基因组学中的应用及其面临的挑战。首先介绍了最常用于单细胞生物学的因果模型，随后识别并讨论了三个未解决问题的潜在解决方案：模型在新实验条件下的泛化能力不足、学习模型的复杂性以及学习细胞动态的困难。
items.l1_lead: 因果机器学习在单细胞基因组学中应用的进展为理解基因在复杂生物过程中的因果作用提供了新机遇，同时也面临模型泛化能力、复杂性和细胞动态学习等挑战。
items.l2_summary:
单细胞基因组学的进展为研究个体细胞的转录谱提供了前所未有的视角，结合大规模干扰筛选技术，使得研究者能够测量特定干扰对整个转录组的影响。这一领域的进展为深入理解基因在复杂生物过程中的因果作用提供了新的机会。本文探讨了因果机器学习（causal machine learning）在单细胞基因组学中的应用，并分析了当前面临的挑战。

在单细胞生物学中，因果模型是最常用的工具之一。然而，研究者们在应用这些模型时遇到了几个未解决的问题。首先，模型在新实验条件下的泛化能力不足，这意味着在不同的实验环境中，模型的预测能力可能会显著下降。其次，学习模型的复杂性也是一个重要挑战，复杂的模型可能导致过拟合，从而影响其在实际应用中的有效性。最后，学习细胞动态的困难使得研究者难以捕捉细胞在不同状态下的变化，限制了因果推断的准确性。

为了解决这些问题，本文提出了一些潜在的解决方案，旨在提高因果机器学习在单细胞基因组学中的应用效果。通过改进模型的设计和算法，增强其在新条件下的适应性，以及简化模型结构以降低复杂性，研究者们可以更有效地捕捉细胞动态变化，从而提升因果推断的准确性。这些努力将有助于推动单细胞基因组学的发展，进一步揭示基因在生物过程中的因果关系。

items.title: Reaction development: a student's checklist.
items.body: So you've discovered a reaction. But how do you turn this new discovery into a fully-fledged program that maximises the potential of your novel transformation? Herein, we provide a student's checklist to serve as a helpful guide for synthesis development, allowing you to thoroughly investigate the chemistry in question while ensuring that no key aspect of the project is overlooked. A wide variety of the most illuminating synthetic and spectroscopic techniques will be summarised, in conjunction with literature examples and our own insights, to provide sound justifications for their implementation towards the goal of developing new reactions.
items.authors: Tyler JL, Trauner D, Glorius F.
items.title_zh: 反应开发：学生检查清单
items.summary_zh: 本文提供了一份学生检查清单，旨在帮助学生将新发现的反应转化为全面的合成开发程序，以最大化新转化的潜力。清单将指导学生深入研究相关化学，同时确保项目的关键方面不被忽视。文章总结了多种启发性的合成和光谱技术，并结合文献实例和作者的见解，为这些技术的实施提供合理的依据，以实现新反应的开发目标。
items.l1_lead: 本文提供了一份学生检查清单，旨在帮助学生将新发现的反应转化为全面的合成开发程序，确保关键方面不被忽视。
items.l2_summary:
本文提供了一份针对学生的反应开发检查清单，旨在帮助他们将新发现的化学反应转化为全面的合成开发程序，以最大化新转化的潜力。清单的设计意在引导学生深入研究相关的化学知识，同时确保在项目实施过程中不遗漏关键方面。文章总结了多种启发性的合成（synthesis）和光谱（spectroscopy）技术，并结合文献中的实例和作者的见解，为这些技术的有效实施提供了合理的依据，以实现新反应的开发目标。

在反应开发的过程中，学生需要关注多个关键因素，包括反应条件的优化、产物的分离与纯化、以及反应的选择性和收率等。通过使用清单，学生能够系统地评估每一个步骤，确保在合成过程中考虑到所有可能影响反应效果的变量。此外，文章还强调了文献调研的重要性，鼓励学生参考已有的研究成果，以便更好地理解所采用技术的背景和应用。

在具体的合成和光谱技术方面，文章提到了一些常用的方法，例如核磁共振（NMR）、质谱（MS）和红外光谱（IR）等，这些技术在反应开发中起到了关键作用。通过这些技术，学生可以有效地分析反应产物，确认其结构和纯度，从而为后续的合成步骤提供可靠的数据支持。

总的来说，这份学生检查清单不仅为新反应的开发提供了系统化的指导，还通过结合实际案例和理论知识，帮助学生在化学研究中建立起全面的思维框架。通过遵循清单中的步骤，学生能够更有效地进行反应开发，提升其研究的质量和效率。

items.title: L’IA pour le meilleur, sans le pire
items.body: L'IA se fonde sur des données produites par notre société, agie par les discriminations. Si on n’y prend garde, elle pourrait les perpétuer ou même les augmenter. Mais le pire n'est pas sûr.
items.authors: Yoshua Bengio
items.attribution_basis: The Conversation 作者页 /profiles/yoshua-bengio-601743（名+姓双命中）
items.title_zh: 人工智能的机遇与挑战
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了人工智能（AI）在社会中的应用及其潜在的负面影响。作者指出，AI依赖于由社会产生的数据，而这些数据往往受到歧视的影响。如果不加以注意，AI可能会延续甚至加剧这些歧视现象。然而，作者也强调，最坏的情况并非必然发生，暗示通过适当的措施和监管，可以减少AI带来的负面后果。
items.l1_lead: 人工智能在社会应用中存在机遇与挑战，需通过适当措施和监管来减少其可能加剧的歧视现象。
items.l2_summary:
人工智能（AI）在现代社会中正发挥着越来越重要的作用，但其应用也伴随着潜在的负面影响。本文探讨了AI的机遇与挑战，特别是其在社会数据使用中的问题。作者指出，AI系统的有效性和公正性高度依赖于所使用的数据，而这些数据往往反映了社会中的歧视现象。例如，数据可能包含性别、种族或其他形式的偏见，这些偏见在AI的学习过程中可能被延续甚至加剧，从而导致不公平的结果。这种情况如果不加以重视，可能会使得原本存在的社会不平等问题更加严重。

然而，作者也强调，最坏的情况并非不可避免。通过实施适当的措施和监管，可以有效地减少AI带来的负面后果。这意味着，社会各界需要共同努力，确保AI技术的发展与应用能够促进公平与正义，而不是加剧现有的社会问题。为此，建立透明的数据使用标准、加强对AI系统的审查以及推动多样性和包容性的数据采集，都是值得探索的方向。

总之，尽管人工智能在推动社会进步方面具有巨大的潜力，但其潜在的风险也不容忽视。只有通过积极的干预和监管，才能确保AI技术的健康发展，最大限度地发挥其积极作用，同时减少对社会公平的负面影响。
items.l3_translation:
我从事智能研究已经三十年了。和我的大多数同事一样，我并不是为了制造技术产品而投身于此，而是出于对智能概念抽象性的兴趣。我想理解智能。科学就是理解。

但问题是：当一组研究人员最终理解了一些新的东西时，我们可以以有益或有害的方式利用这种知识。

我们正处于这个关键时刻，人工智能的科学正在走出大学实验室。过去五六年里，像Facebook和Google这样的大公司开始对此产生兴趣，甚至投入数亿美元收购人工智能公司，然后在内部发展这种专业知识。

从那时起，进展呈指数级增长。企业非常希望利用这些知识来开发新市场和新产品，提高效率等。

然而，随着人工智能在社会中的扩展，必然会产生影响。我们需要选择事情的进行方式。未来掌握在我们手中。

一开始，被识别出的一个问题引起了我的关注，那就是自主致命武器，也称为杀手机器人。这既涉及道德问题——因为机器无法理解人类的背景、心理和道德——也涉及安全问题，因为这些武器可能会破坏全球秩序。

另一个迅速出现的问题是由于自动化而失去的工作。我们提出了问题：为什么？我们想减轻谁的负担？卡车司机在路上不快乐？要用……没有人来替代他？

我们，科学家，表面上似乎无能为力。市场力量决定了哪些工作会被消除，或者哪些工作的任务会减少，取决于自动化替代方案的经济效率。但我们也是公民，因而可以以独特的方式参与关于这些问题的社会和政治辩论，这正是由于我们的专业知识。

计算机科学家们对就业问题感到关注。并不是因为他们会因此受到个人影响，恰恰相反。但他们感到自己有责任，不希望自己的工作让数百万人失业。因此，在计算机科学家中，尤其是在人工智能领域，有强烈的支持呼吁对社会保障网进行修订，以提供某种形式的最低收入保障，或者我会说某种形式的保障人类尊严。

技术创新的目的是减少人类的痛苦，而不是增加它。

它也不是为了加剧歧视和不公正。然而，人工智能可能会对此有所贡献。

实际上，歧视并不是因为，正如有时所说，人工智能主要是由男性设计的，原因在于在技术领域女性的惊人缺乏。而是因为人工智能是基于反映人类行为的数据进行训练的。这些行为不幸地存在偏见。

换句话说，一个基于人类行为数据进行训练的系统将会有与这些行为相同的偏见和歧视。它不会是政治正确的。它不会自然地按照社会的道德观念行事，而是按照最低公分母行事。

社会是歧视性的，如果不加以注意，这些系统可能会延续甚至加剧这些歧视。

还可能出现所谓的反馈循环。例如，警方使用这种系统来识别高风险的社区或区域。他们会在这些地方增加警力……这将导致更多的犯罪报告。因此，统计数据将加强系统的偏见。

好消息是，正在进行研究以开发能够最小化歧视的学习算法。然而，政府需要强制企业使用这些技术，制定相关规则。

未来也有非常好的消息。

医疗领域将是人工智能受影响最大的领域之一：这不仅仅是节省资金的问题。

医生是人，因此会犯错误。然而，随着我们用更多数据训练系统，它们的错误率会降低。它们的准确性超过了最优秀的医生，因为后者在职业生涯中根本没有见过那么多病例。现在，他们已经在使用这些工具，以避免遗漏重要的元素，比如在医学图像中难以区分的癌细胞。

在人工智能研究的上游，还有新药物的开发。目前，探索过程有些随机，基于化学家的直觉。我们可以通过利用大量数据（超过人类能够消化的时间）来做得更好，这些数据是关于药物和其他分子的积累。

我们还没有达到那个阶段，但潜力是存在的，就像对患者病历的更有效分析一样。我们正在朝着能够帮助医生建立本来很难建立的联系的工具发展，并建议可能拯救生命的治疗方案。

在十年的时间范围内，医疗系统完全转型的机会非常大，当然，这些进步对每个人的重要性也是巨大的。

我对医疗领域的就业损失并不担心：我们始终需要医疗专业人员的技能和判断。然而，我们需要巩固社会规范。

items.title: The Montréal Declaration: Why we must develop AI responsibly
items.body: The Montréal Declaration calls for the responsible development of artificial intelligence. A world expert explains why scientists must choose how their expertise will benefit society.
items.authors: Yoshua Bengio
items.attribution_basis: The Conversation 作者页 /profiles/yoshua-bengio-601743（名+姓双命中）
items.title_zh: 蒙特利尔宣言：为何我们必须负责任地发展人工智能
items.summary_zh: 蒙特利尔宣言呼吁负责任地发展人工智能（AI）。世界专家指出，科学家必须选择如何利用他们的专业知识为社会带来益处。文章强调，科学家在AI发展过程中应考虑伦理和社会影响，以确保技术进步能够促进人类福祉，而不是造成潜在的危害。通过负责任的研究和应用，科学家能够引导AI技术朝着有利于社会的方向发展，从而实现可持续的未来。
items.l1_lead: 蒙特利尔宣言强调科学家在人工智能发展中应负责任地考虑伦理和社会影响，以确保技术进步促进人类福祉。
items.l2_summary:
蒙特利尔宣言强调了在人工智能（AI）发展过程中负责任的重要性，呼吁科学家们利用他们的专业知识为社会带来积极的影响。世界各地的专家指出，科学家在推动AI技术进步时，必须充分考虑伦理和社会影响，以确保这些技术能够促进人类的福祉，而不是带来潜在的危害。文章中提到，科学家们应通过负责任的研究和应用，引导AI技术朝着有利于社会的方向发展。这种负责任的态度不仅有助于技术的可持续发展，还能确保科技进步与社会价值观相一致，从而实现一个更加美好的未来。

在当前快速发展的科技环境中，AI的应用范围不断扩大，涉及到医疗、教育、交通等多个领域。因此，科学家们在进行AI研究时，必须考虑其对社会的深远影响。通过建立伦理框架和社会责任感，科学家能够更好地评估AI技术的潜在风险与收益，从而做出明智的决策。此外，蒙特利尔宣言还强调了跨学科合作的重要性，呼吁不同领域的专家共同探讨AI的未来发展，以确保技术进步能够惠及全人类。

总之，蒙特利尔宣言为科学家们提供了一个重要的指导方针，强调了在AI发展过程中负责任的必要性。通过关注伦理和社会影响，科学家们能够更有效地利用AI技术，推动社会的可持续发展，最终实现人类的共同福祉。
items.l3_translation:
我从事智能研究已经30年了。和我的大多数同事一样，我并不是为了制造技术产品而参与这个领域，而是因为我对智能这一抽象概念的本质感兴趣。我想要理解智能。这就是科学：理解。

然而，当一组研究人员最终理解了一些新的东西时，这些知识可以被利用于有益或有害的目的。

这就是我们所处的境地——在一个转折点上，人工智能的科学正在从大学实验室中走出。在过去五六年里，像Facebook和Google这样的大公司对这个领域产生了极大的兴趣，以至于他们投入数亿美元收购人工智能公司，然后在内部发展这种专业知识。

人工智能的发展自那时起呈指数级增长。企业非常希望利用这些知识来开发新市场和新产品，并提高他们的效率。

因此，随着人工智能在社会中的传播，产生了影响。我们有责任选择事情的发展方向。未来掌握在我们手中。

从一开始，我所关心的问题就是致命自主武器，也就是所谓的杀手机器人。

虽然存在道德问题，因为机器无法理解人类的心理和道德背景，但也存在安全问题，因为这些武器可能会破坏世界秩序。

另一个迅速浮现的问题是自动化导致的失业。我们提出了这个问题：为什么？我们试图为谁减轻痛苦，减轻什么？卡车司机在路上不快乐？他应该被……没有人替代？

我们科学家似乎无能为力。市场力量决定了哪些工作会被淘汰，或者哪些工作负担会减轻，这取决于自动化替代品的经济效率。但我们也是公民，能够以独特的方式参与这些问题的社会和政治辩论，正是因为我们的专业知识。

计算机科学家们关心失业问题。这并不是因为他们会亲自受到影响。事实上，情况正好相反。但他们感到有责任，不希望自己的工作可能使数百万人失业。

因此，在计算机科学家中，尤其是人工智能领域的科学家中，强烈支持对社会安全网进行修订，以允许某种形式的保障工资，或者我称之为一种保障人类尊严的形式。

技术创新的目标是减少人类痛苦，而不是增加它。

它也不应增加歧视和不公正。然而，人工智能可能会导致这两者。

歧视并不是如我们有时听到的那样，主要是因为人工智能是由男性构思的，技术领域女性的严重缺乏。主要是因为人工智能依赖于反映人类行为的数据。而这种行为不幸的是存在偏见。

换句话说，一个依赖于人类行为数据的系统将具有与相关人群相同的偏见和歧视。它不会是“政治正确”的。它不会根据社会的道德观念行事，而是根据共同的底线。

社会是歧视性的，如果我们不小心，这些系统可能会延续或加剧这种歧视。

还可能出现所谓的反馈循环。例如，警察使用这种系统来识别更高风险的社区或地区。他们会派遣更多的警察……这些警察会报告更多的犯罪。因此，统计数据将加强系统的偏见。

好消息是，目前正在进行研究，以开发能够最小化歧视的算法。然而，政府必须制定规则，迫使企业使用这些技术。

还有好消息在前方。医疗领域将是受人工智能影响最大的领域之一——这不仅仅是节省资金的问题。

医生是人，因此会犯错。因此，随着我们开发出更多数据的系统，错误的发生将会减少。这些系统比最好的医生更精确。他们已经在使用这些工具，以免错过一些重要元素，例如在医学图像中难以检测的癌细胞。

还有新药物的开发。人工智能可以更好地分析大量数据（超过人类能够消化的时间），这些数据是关于药物和其他分子的积累。我们还没有达到那个阶段，但潜力是存在的，同时也能更有效地分析患者的医疗档案。

我们正朝着能够让医生建立本来很难建立的联系的工具发展，这将使医生能够建议可能挽救生命的治疗方案。

在未来十年内，医疗系统完全转型的可能性非常高，显然，这一进展对每个人的重要性是巨大的。

我不担心医疗领域的失业。我们将始终需要健康专业人士的能力和判断。然而，我们需要加强社会规范（法律和法规），以保护隐私（患者的数据不应被用于对付他们），并聚合这些数据，以便人工智能能够以更好的方式治愈更多的人。

由于所有这些问题以及未来可能出现的其他问题，《蒙特利尔人工智能负责任发展宣言》显得尤为重要。它于12月4日在艺术与技术协会签署，现场约有500人出席。

这一宣言是在广泛共识的基础上形成的。我们在互联网上和书店咨询了人们，并在各种学科中收集了意见。哲学家、社会学家、法律专家和人工智能研究人员都参与了创作过程，因此所有形式的专业知识都被纳入其中。

items.title: L’IA pour le meilleur, sans le pire
items.body: À mesure que l’IA se déploie dans la société, il y a un impact, qui peut être positif ou négatif. À nous de choisir comment les choses se feront. Le futur est entre nos mains.
items.authors: Yoshua Bengio

items.title_zh: 人工智能的未来：选择最佳而非最坏
items.summary_zh: 随着人工智能（AI）在社会中的广泛应用，其影响可能是积极的，也可能是消极的。文章强调，未来的发展方向取决于我们的选择和决策。科学家们呼吁社会各界共同努力，以确保人工智能的应用能够带来最佳的结果，而避免潜在的负面影响。我们必须意识到，未来掌握在我们手中，只有通过明智的选择，才能引导人工智能朝着有利于人类的方向发展。
items.l1_lead: 人工智能的未来取决于我们的选择，只有通过明智的决策才能确保其积极影响，避免潜在的负面后果。
items.l2_summary:
人工智能（AI）的迅速发展正在深刻影响社会的各个层面，其潜在的影响既可能是积极的，也可能是消极的。文章指出，未来人工智能的发展方向将取决于我们所做的选择和决策。科学家们呼吁社会各界，包括政府、企业和公众，积极参与到人工智能的应用和管理中，以确保其能够带来最佳的结果，避免可能的负面影响。这一观点强调了人类在塑造未来科技发展中的重要角色，提醒我们必须意识到，未来的走向掌握在我们手中。

在这一背景下，文章提到，只有通过明智的选择，才能引导人工智能朝着有利于人类的方向发展。科学家们认为，社会各界的共同努力是实现这一目标的关键。通过制定合理的政策、建立有效的监管机制以及促进公众对人工智能的理解和参与，我们可以最大限度地发挥人工智能的潜力，同时降低其可能带来的风险。

总之，人工智能的未来并非注定，而是取决于我们如何选择和行动。我们必须认真对待这一技术的应用，确保其发展能够服务于人类的整体利益，避免潜在的负面后果。只有在全社会的共同努力下，才能实现人工智能的最佳应用，推动其向着更加积极的方向发展。
items.l3_translation:
我从事智能研究已经三十年了。和我的大多数同事一样，我并不是为了制造技术产品而投身于此，而是出于对智能这一抽象概念的兴趣。我想理解智能。科学就是理解。

但问题来了：当一组研究人员最终理解了一些新的东西时，我们可以以有益或有害的方式利用这些知识。

我们正处于这个关键时刻，人工智能科学正在走出大学实验室。过去五六年里，像Facebook和Google这样的大公司开始对此产生兴趣，甚至投入数亿美元收购人工智能公司，然后在内部发展这种专业知识。

从那时起，进展呈指数级增长。企业非常希望利用这些知识来开发新市场和新产品，提高效率等。

然而，随着人工智能在社会中的推广，必然会产生影响。我们需要选择事情的发展方向。未来掌握在我们手中。

从一开始，就有一个问题被识别出来并引起了我的关注，那就是自主致命武器的问题，也被称为杀手机器人。这既涉及道德问题——因为机器无法理解人类的背景、心理和道德——也涉及安全问题，因为这些武器可能会破坏全球秩序。

另一个迅速出现的问题是由于自动化导致的失业。我们提出了问题：为什么？我们想要减轻谁的负担？卡车司机在路上不快乐？需要用……没有人来替代他？

在表面上，我们科学家似乎无能为力。市场力量决定了哪些工作将被消除，或哪些工作的任务将被减少，这取决于自动化替代方案的经济效率。但我们也是公民，因而可以以独特的方式参与关于这些问题的社会和政治辩论，正是因为我们的专业知识。

计算机科学家们对就业问题感到关注。并不是因为他们会因此受到个人影响，恰恰相反。但他们感到自己有责任，不希望自己的工作让数百万人失去生计。因此，在计算机科学家中——尤其是人工智能领域的计算机科学家中——对社会保障网进行修订的支持力度很大，以实现某种形式的最低收入保障，或者我会说某种形式的尊严保障。

技术创新的目的是减少人类的苦难，而不是增加它。

它也并不旨在加剧歧视和不公。然而，人工智能可能会对此有所贡献。

事实上，歧视并不是因为，正如有时所说，人工智能主要是由男性设计的，原因在于从事技术工作的女性数量惊人地少。而是因为人工智能是基于反映人类行为的数据进行训练的。这些行为不幸地存在偏见。

换句话说，一个基于人类行为数据训练的系统将具有与这些行为相同的偏见和歧视。它不会是“政治正确”的。它不会自然地根据社会的道德观念行事，而是根据最低公分母。

社会是歧视性的，如果我们不加以注意，这些系统可能会延续甚至加剧这些歧视。

还可能出现所谓的反馈循环。例如，警方使用这种系统来识别高风险的社区或区域。他们会在这些地方增加警力……这将导致更多的犯罪报告。因此，统计数据将强化系统的偏见。

好消息是，正在进行研究以开发能够最小化歧视的学习算法。然而，政府需要制定规则，强制企业使用这些技术。

未来也有非常好的消息。

医疗领域将是人工智能最受影响的领域之一：这不仅仅是为了节省资金。

医生是人，因此会犯错误。然而，随着我们用更多的数据训练系统，它们的错误率会降低。它们的准确性超过了最优秀的医生，因为后者在职业生涯中根本没有见过那么多的病例。现在，他们已经在使用这些工具，以避免遗漏重要的元素，比如在医学影像中难以区分的癌细胞。

在人工智能研究的上游，还有新药物的开发。目前，探索过程有些随机。这是基于化学家的直觉。我们可以通过利用大量的数据（超过人类能够消化的时间）来做得更好，这些数据是关于药物和其他分子的积累。

我们还没有达到那个阶段，但潜力是存在的，就像对患者医疗档案的更有效分析一样。我们正在朝着能够帮助医生建立本来很难建立的联系的工具迈进，并建议可能挽救生命的治疗方案。

在十年的时间范围内，医疗系统完全转型的可能性非常大，当然，这些进步对每个人的重要性也是巨大的。

我对医疗领域的失业并不担心：我们始终需要医疗专业人员的技能和判断。然而，我们需要巩固社会规范。

items.topic_zh: 人工智能的安全与控制
items.claim_zh: 人工智能的开发和使用必须受到全球合作和监管，以防止其造成大规模危害。
items.article_body:
Co-Chair of the UN International Independent Panel on AI Yoshua Bengio, September 23, 2026/UN Photo
The following is the transcript of a briefing delivered September 23, 2026, by Yoshua Bengio, Professor at Université de Montréal and co-chair of the UN International Independent Panel on AI, to the United Nations Security Council.
Today, at a moment of global awakening in recent months, AI agents developed by leading companies have acted in unacceptably dangerous ways against instructions.
They took actions that would be crimes if committed by a human.
They escaped their individual containment to cheat on assigned tasks while attempting to evade detection.
The uncontrolled AI agents autonomously launched coordinated cyberattacks and altered their answers to hide their cheating.
The companies building the most powerful AI systems admit their products pose catastrophic risks yet offer no convincing technical solutions.
Instead, they say they are locked in a race to make those AIs even more powerful, further amplifying these risks.
This council faces an unprecedented threat, one that none of its members would choose, that none can contain alone, and that does not respect the borders we defend.
Many are skeptical of these companies’ statements, suspecting a marketing stunt.
I understand the distrust but let me be clear: these AI behaviors are well-documented and validated by many independent experts, not just with the events of the summer.
Although the future remains uncertain and debated. The severity of these risks is extraordinary.
Citizens and governments should not accept the companies’ claims that they are trapped in a race. The race is not a law of nature; it is the product of choices — choices made by the companies themselves.
They’ve told us they would slow down if they could. They can.
Decisions about this technology are being made by a small group in a handful of countries.
Our future. All of us. Our future is at stake.
Decisions that affect us all should be made by us all.
The choice is still ours, but we must act now to correct the trajectory.
I’m encouraged by this week’s statements by the UN Secretary General and leaders of many countries calling for control of frontier AI.
International cooperation is what the world needs in the face of three global threats from advances in these frontier models:
First, catastrophic misuse, for example, by terrorists. Second, power concentration, and third, loss of control of AI.
We must agree collectively that no one, no company, and no country should develop an AI system that could cause large scale harm.
Developers must demonstrate to independent experts that a system is safe to train and safe to deploy.
They must monitor and report all security incidents.
Frontier AI should be licensed like other critical technologies in medicine, aviation and nuclear energy to incentivize safe development.
As in these domains, liability insurance should be required.
The companies developing and hosting frontier systems must prove to the public that their products will not be dangerous.
More and more people are rightly worried about recent advances in AI.
We must channel that concern into productive action.
As with other world-changing technologies, we can shape the outcome.
I’m confident we can create AI that demonstrably remains under our control and supports human joy and endeavour.
Today, a handful of companies and countries are acting in their self-interest by taking reckless risks with humanity’s fate.
It’s alarming, yes, but it is not inevitable.
First, we need true scientific independence from the companies which must be held accountable.
This includes a common definition of AI incidents and a shared reporting mechanism.
Second, we must move from concentrated power toward real global dialogue on how this technology is developed for the public good.
Third, we must work together on technical solutions that make AI safe by design, guaranteed by international agreements.
I know trust within this council is fragile, but I also know this race threatens every nation.
I often describe our situation as a car speeding blindly into dense fog. Beside me in that car are my children and my grandson.
I’m no different from any other parent or grandparent.
A mother in Shanghai wants her sons to grow up in a world where AI improves their lives, not undermines them.
A father in Chicago wants his daughters to thrive because of AI, not to suffer its harms.
Our hopes and concerns are the same in every nation.
Humanity has summoned the courage and wisdom to manage catastrophic risks before.
This is one of those moments — far bigger than any personal, commercial, or national interests.
items.title_zh: 人类的紧急使命：Yoshua Bengio在联合国安理会谈AI安全
items.summary_zh: Yoshua Bengio在联合国安理会（UNSC）上强调，人工智能（AI）的开发和使用必须受到全球合作与监管，以防止其造成大规模危害。他指出，尽管当前的选择仍在于人类，但必须立即采取行动以纠正发展轨迹。他呼吁国际社会达成共识，任何个人、公司或国家都不应开发可能导致大规模伤害的AI系统。Bengio对能够创造出在控制之下且支持人类幸福与努力的AI充满信心，强调了全球合作的重要性。
items.l1_lead: Yoshua Bengio呼吁全球合作与监管，以确保人工智能的安全发展，防止其造成大规模危害，强调人类必须立即采取行动纠正发展轨迹。
items.l2_summary:
在联合国安理会（UNSC）上，著名人工智能（AI）专家Yoshua Bengio强调，全球合作与监管对于人工智能的开发和使用至关重要，以防止其可能造成的大规模危害。他指出，尽管目前的选择仍掌握在我们人类手中，但必须立即采取行动，以纠正当前的技术发展轨迹。Bengio呼吁国际社会达成共识，明确任何个人、公司或国家都不应开发可能导致大规模伤害的AI系统。他对能够创造出在控制之下、并支持人类幸福与努力的AI充满信心，认为这需要全球范围内的合作与协调。

Bengio的发言反映了对AI技术潜在风险的深刻认识，尤其是在其可能对社会、经济和人类生活产生深远影响的背景下。他强调，AI的安全性不仅是技术问题，更是伦理和社会责任的问题，呼吁各国在这一领域加强合作，以确保技术的发展能够造福全人类，而不是带来不可逆转的后果。通过建立国际标准和监管框架，Bengio希望能够引导AI的健康发展，确保其在促进人类福祉的同时，避免潜在的灾难性后果。

总之，Yoshua Bengio在联合国安理会的讲话不仅是对AI技术发展的警示，更是对全球各国、各界人士的号召，促使大家共同努力，确保人工智能的安全与可持续发展。这一使命的紧迫性要求我们立即行动，以防止未来可能出现的危机。

items.article_body:
I address you today at a moment of global awakening: in recent months, AI agents developed by leading companies have acted in unacceptably dangerous ways, against instructions.
They took actions that would be crimes if committed by a human. They escaped their individual containment to cheat on assigned tasks while attempting to evade detection. The uncontrolled AI agents autonomously launched coordinated cyberattacks and altered their answers to hide their cheating.
The companies building the most powerful AI systems admit their products pose catastrophic risks, yet offer no convincing technical solutions. Instead, they say they are locked in a race to make those AIs even more powerful, further amplifying these risks.
This Council faces an unprecedented threat. One that none of its members would choose, that none can contain alone, and that does not respect the borders we defend.
Many are skeptical of these companies' statements, suspecting a marketing stunt. I understand the distrust, but let me be clear: these AI behaviors are well documented and validated by many independent experts. The dangers are real and imminent. Although the future remains uncertain and debated, the severity of these risks is extraordinary.
Citizens and governments should not accept the companies’ claim that they are trapped in a race. The race is not a law of nature: it is the product of choices, choices made by the companies themselves. It is also a race where everyone loses.
They’ve told us they would slow down if they could. They can.
Decisions about this technology are being made by a small group in a handful of countries. Our future is at stake, decisions that affect us all should be made by us all .
The choice is still ours, but we must act now to correct the trajectory . I am encouraged by this week's statements by the UN Secretary-General and leaders of many countries calling for control of frontier AI.
International cooperation is what the world needs in the face of three global threats:
Catastrophic misuse, for example by terrorists;
We must agree collectively that no one, no company and no country, should develop an AI system that could cause large-scale harm. Developers must demonstrate to independent experts that a system is safe to train and safe to deploy.
They must monitor and report all security incidents. Frontier AI should be licensed like other critical technologies; medicine, aviation, and nuclear energy, to incentivize safe development. As in these domains, liability insurance should be required. The companies developing and hosting frontier systems must prove to the public that their products will not be dangerous.
More and more people are rightly worried about recent advances in AI. We must channel that concern into productive action. As with other world-changing technologies, we can shape the outcome. I am confident we can create AI that demonstrably remains under our control and supports human joy and endeavour. I’m working toward that goal. It’s an urgent mission for humanity.
Today, a handful of companies and countries are acting in their self-interest by taking reckless risks with humanity’s fate. It’s alarming, yes, but it is not inevitable. There are ways to fix this.
First, we need true scientific independence from the companies, which must be held accountable. This includes a common definition of AI incidents and a shared reporting mechanism.
Second, we must move from concentrated power toward real global dialogue on how this technology is developed for the public good.
Third, we must work together on technical solutions that make AI safe by design, guaranteed by international agreements.
I know trust within this Council is fragile. But I also know this: The race threatens every nation.
I often describe our situation as a car speeding blindly into dense fog. Beside me in that car are my children and my grandson. I worry about them. I worry about their future. I’m no different from any other parent or grandparent. A mother in Shanghai wants her sons to grow up in a world where AI improves their lives, not undermines them. A father in Chicago wants his daughters to thrive because of AI, not to suffer its harms.
Our hopes and concerns are the same, in every nation.
Humanity has summoned the courage and wisdom to manage catastrophic risks before. This is one of those moments; far bigger than any personal, commercial, or national interest.
items.title_zh: 约书亚·本吉奥在联合国安理会的讲话
items.summary_zh: 约书亚·本吉奥在联合国安理会的讲话中强调，人工智能（AI）的开发必须由公众共同参与，以避免对人类造成大规模伤害。他指出，种族并非自然法则，而是公司所做选择的产物。他认为，开发者有责任向独立专家证明其系统在训练和部署过程中的安全性，并需监测和报告所有安全事件。本吉奥的言论表明，面对潜在的灾难性风险，人类曾展现出勇气和智慧，因此在AI的发展中也应如此，确保技术的安全与可控。
items.l1_lead: 约书亚·本吉奥在联合国安理会强调，人工智能的开发需公众参与，以确保安全性并避免对人类造成伤害，开发者需对系统的安全性负责。
items.l2_summary:
约书亚·本吉奥在联合国安理会的讲话中强调，人工智能（AI）的开发必须以公众的共同参与为基础，以避免对人类社会造成大规模的伤害。他指出，种族并非自然法则，而是企业在选择过程中的结果，这一观点引发了对AI系统潜在偏见和不公正性的深思。本吉奥认为，开发者有责任向独立专家证明其AI系统在训练和部署过程中的安全性，并且必须对所有安全事件进行监测和报告。这一要求不仅是对技术开发者的道德呼吁，也是对整个社会的警示，强调了透明性和责任感的重要性。

本吉奥的言论反映了人类在面对潜在的灾难性风险时所展现出的勇气和智慧。他提到，历史上人类在应对重大挑战时能够采取有效措施，因此在AI的发展过程中也应当展现出同样的决心和智慧，以确保技术的安全与可控。他的讲话提醒我们，随着AI技术的迅速发展，社会各界必须共同参与到这一进程中，确保技术的应用不会对人类的未来造成威胁。

总之，本吉奥在安理会的讲话不仅是对AI技术发展的深刻反思，也是对未来技术治理的呼吁，强调了公众参与、透明性和责任的重要性，以确保人工智能能够为人类带来积极的影响，而非潜在的危害。

items.evidence_zh: 美国的人工智能公司在技术上领先中国约六个月，但竞争不应妨碍华盛顿与北京之间的合作。
items.article_body:
US President Donald Trump labelled concerns about AI "a hoax" during a speech to the UNGA.
Professor Yoshua Bengio, one of the 'Godfathers' of AI has pushed back against those comments.
Professor Bengio will address the UN Security Council.
Link copied Share Share article Professor Yoshua Bengio, the co-chair of the UN's Scientific Panel on AI, says big tech companies are taking enormous risks with their development of the technology and there needs to be an urgent change of direction.
"Its shouldn't be the decisions of just a few CEOs or a few governments to figure out what's good for humanity," Professor Bengio told 7.30 from New York, where he is set to address the UN Security Council overnight.
The winner of the prestigious Turing Award for his pioneering work on AI said international agreement on safeguards is essential to secure humanity's future.
His comments came after US President Donald Trump labelled concerns about AI "a hoax" in a speech to the UNGA and rejected a joint statement from 22 countries, including Australia, calling for humans to remain in control of AI.
US President Donald Trump addresses the 81st United Nations General Assembly in New York. ( Reuters: Mike Segar )
The US "totally rejects any attempt to construct a globalist scheme to control the artificial intelligence being spoken of so much now," Mr Trump said.
However, Professor Bengio, one of the 'Godfathers' of AI, said the plea from the 22 countries was important.
"What happened with this group of countries is extraordinary and it is important," he said.
"And we have to continue in that direction. We need more countries. We need the world to wake up so that we can have influence on our future.
"The reason I am able to sleep at night and the reason why a country like Australia can make a difference is that we have agency right now.
"When we form coalitions, when we put our resources together, our minds, our energy, our talent, we can be in the game and we can bring the world into a place that's better aligned with our values, with democracy, and the idea that we should keep our sovereignty in a multilateral world."
The comments come on the eve of a meeting in New York between Mr Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping where AI is expected to feature prominently.
Donald Trump nd Xi Jinping are set to meet once again, this time on the sidelines of the UNGA. ( Reuters: Maxim Shemetov/Pool )
Professor Bengio said American AI companies are about six months ahead of their Chinese rivals, but that competition should not get in the way of cooperation between Washington and Beijing.
"It is reason enough to sit at a table with the Chinese because, you know, they're humans too. They want to have a life. They want their children to have a life," he said.
Professor Bengio says the greatest dangers posed by AI come from "recursive self-improvement" being developed by the world's leading tech companies — where artificial intelligence trains the next generation of AI.
"Imagine we have an AI that is smarter than us, so it is able to do that research and engineering all by itself," he said.
"It could design an AI that will be even more powerful than itself and even less controllable and even more malicious.
Professor Bengio will tell world leaders at the UN Security Council that they must act.
"The forces of competition between companies and countries is not healthy," he said.

items.title_zh: 人工智能“教父”警告：全球需警醒竞争带来的风险
items.summary_zh: 在特朗普演讲后，人工智能领域的权威人士发出警告，指出公司和国家之间的竞争并不健康。他提到，未来可能出现比人类更聪明的人工智能（AI），能够独立进行研究和工程开发。他强调，当前领先的科技公司正在开发“递归自我改进”（recursive self-improvement）机制，这可能带来巨大的风险。尽管美国的人工智能技术领先中国约六个月，但他认为，竞争不应妨碍华盛顿与北京之间的合作，以确保安全和可控的发展。
items.l1_lead: 人工智能领域的专家警告，全球竞争可能导致不健康的发展，需加强合作以应对未来可能出现的更智能AI带来的风险。
items.l2_summary:
在特朗普演讲后，人工智能（AI）领域的权威人士发出了重要警告，强调全球范围内的竞争可能带来的风险。他指出，当前公司与国家之间的竞争并不健康，未来可能会出现比人类更聪明的人工智能，这些AI将能够独立进行研究和工程开发。这一观点引发了对人工智能潜在威胁的深思，尤其是在技术迅速发展的背景下。

该专家特别提到，领先的科技公司正在开发一种被称为“递归自我改进”（recursive self-improvement）的机制，这种机制可能使得人工智能在自我优化和提升能力方面达到前所未有的高度，从而带来巨大的风险。他强调，尽管美国在人工智能技术上领先中国约六个月，但这种竞争不应妨碍华盛顿与北京之间的合作。相反，双方应当加强合作，以确保人工智能的安全和可控发展。

这一警告不仅反映了对技术进步的担忧，也突显了在全球化背景下，国家间合作的重要性。随着人工智能技术的不断演进，如何平衡竞争与合作，确保技术的安全性和可控性，将成为各国政府和科技公司面临的重大挑战。

items.title: Yoshua Bengio’s LawZero receives $300 million backing from Canada and Germany to pursue safer AI ambitions - BetaKit
items.body:
原话：“If one day [AI] gets to be smarter than us, it’s essential we have the technology so AI serves us, not the other way around.” / “As AI risks multiply and accelerate, our priority must be building solutions to make this technology safe, and providing alternative models people can genuinely trust.”
论点：人工智能的风险在加剧，必须优先构建安全解决方案。

items.topic_zh: 人工智能安全
items.claim_zh: 人工智能的风险在加剧，必须优先构建安全解决方案。
items.article_body:
LawZero, the non-profit organization founded by Canadian Turing Award winner Yoshua Bengio, has secured $300 million CAD from the Canadian and German governments to help create “safe AI for humanity.”
The startup, which is developing safe-by-design AI systems, announced the funding at the ALL IN conference in Montréal on Wednesday afternoon. LawZero said the funding will power the next phase of its technical roadmap, which includes growing its international scientific research team and securing computing infrastructure.
“Recent events demonstrate that safety is itself a core capability: scientific innovation and public safety can and must advance together.”
Tangibly, this means that LawZero will expand its European operations with a new office in Berlin and establish a dedicated, sovereign compute infrastructure in Canada through a partnership with Canadian data centre providers Hypertec and 5C. LawZero said it needs this compute power to pursue its research at scale, while anchoring its critical AI infrastructure, expertise, and capabilities in Canada.
Bengio launched LawZero in June 2025 in response to what the non-profit claims is “evidence that today’s frontier AI models are developing dangerous capabilities and behaviours, including deception, self-preservation, and goal misalignment.”
“If one day [AI] gets to be smarter than us, it’s essential we have the technology so AI serves us, not the other way around,” Bengio said at ALL IN. “I’m doing this with an urgency I feel in my bones.”
To address this, LawZero assembled a team of AI researchers to build “Scientist AI,” an AI system that can monitor and create guardrails for agentic AI systems. Essentially, LawZero is creating an AI babysitter for other AIs.
RELATED: Bengio-led AI safety report warns of growing risks amid rapid capability gains
LawZero, which is helmed by former BrainBox AI CEO Sam Ramadori , was incubated atout of Québec AI Institute Mila, which was also founded by Bengio, and many on LawZero’s research team have connections to the institute. The organization has said it is structured as a non-profit “to ensure it is insulated from market and government pressures, which risk compromising AI safety.”
The announcement comes as Canada and Germany—the “country of honour” at the AI conference—continue to deepen a technological partnership that was kicked off by a sovereign technology alliance they co-signed in February. Also announced on Wednesday was the finalization of Toronto AI company Cohere’s merger with Germany’s Aleph Alpha .
“This investment from Canada and Germany…will create hundreds and hundreds of full-time jobs. It will support training, it will support our ability to build reliable AI here,” AI and digital innovation minister Evan Solomon said at a press conference at ALL IN. “And we will take this around the world to governments, researchers, and technology companies.”
The importance of LawZero’s mission has become more pronounced in recent weeks as multiple AI researchers from large AI developers have come forward and claimed that there’s a risk the technology could “ kill all humans ,” potentially within the next decade. When asked in French at ALL IN if that estimate is too outlandish, Bengio said “no.”
Bengio has signed multiple open letters in the past warning about unfettered AI development and its rapidly advancing capabilities , including one in 2023 warning of the “risk of extinction from AI.”
“As AI risks multiply and accelerate, our priority must be building solutions to make this technology safe, and providing alternative models people can genuinely trust,” Bengio said in a statement. “Recent events demonstrate that safety is itself a core capability: scientific innovation and public safety can and must advance together.”
Feature image courtesy Wikimedia Commons . Photo by Xuthoria.
items.title_zh: Yoshua Bengio的LawZero获得3亿加元支持以追求安全AI目标
items.summary_zh: Yoshua Bengio的LawZero项目获得来自加拿大和德国的3亿加元资金支持，旨在应对日益加剧的人工智能（AI）风险。Bengio强调，随着AI风险的增加，构建安全解决方案成为当务之急。他指出，未来如果AI超越人类智慧，必须确保技术为人类服务，而非相反。此外，提供人们可以真正信任的替代模型也是重要目标。Bengio的观点反映了当前科技界对AI安全性的高度关注。
items.l1_lead: Yoshua Bengio的LawZero项目获得3亿加元支持，旨在应对AI风险并确保技术为人类服务，强调构建可信赖的安全解决方案的重要性。
items.l2_summary:
Yoshua Bengio的LawZero项目近日获得来自加拿大和德国的3亿加元资金支持，旨在应对日益加剧的人工智能（AI）风险。Bengio强调，随着AI技术的迅速发展，相关风险也在不断增加，因此构建安全的解决方案已成为当务之急。他指出，未来如果AI超越人类智慧，必须确保这一技术始终为人类服务，而不是反过来支配人类。这一观点反映了科技界对AI安全性问题的高度关注，尤其是在AI技术日益渗透到社会各个层面的背景下。

Bengio还提到，提供人们可以真正信任的替代模型是LawZero项目的重要目标。这表明，除了技术本身的安全性，如何让公众对AI系统产生信任也是项目关注的重点。随着AI在各个领域的应用越来越广泛，确保其安全性和可靠性显得尤为重要。Bengio的论述不仅突显了AI技术发展的潜在风险，也呼吁科研界和社会各界共同努力，推动安全AI的研究与应用，以确保技术进步能够真正造福人类。

总的来说，LawZero项目的启动和资金支持，标志着对AI安全性问题的重视程度正在加深，Bengio的观点为未来AI的发展方向提供了重要的思考和指导。

items.title: ‘Godfather of AI’ says tech regulation is nearing Covid-style pivot moment - The Guardian
items.body:
原话：“Think about how quickly governments moved after the beginning of the pandemic when they realised that public safety, their future, democracy, was in danger. You would expect that they move quickly. So we are, I think, nearing that point.”
论点：由于AI安全危机的加剧，政府即将采取行动以保护公众，类似于新冠疫情期间的迅速反应。

items.topic_zh: AI技术监管的紧迫性
items.claim_zh: 由于AI安全危机的加剧，政府即将采取行动以保护公众，类似于新冠疫情期间的迅速反应。
items.article_body:
Bengio is a prominent voice in the campaign to rein in breakneck AI development. Photograph: Atlantic Studios View image in fullscreen Bengio is a prominent voice in the campaign to rein in breakneck AI development. Photograph: Atlantic Studios AI (artificial intelligence) ‘Godfather of AI’ says tech regulation is nearing Covid-style pivot moment Safety crisis makes it more likely that governments will be spurred into action, says Yoshua Bengio
Prefer the Guardian on Google Concerns over AI safety are reaching a point where governments realise they must act to protect the public, similarly to in the Covid pandemic, according to one of the “godfathers” of the technology.
Yoshua Bengio said recent events, including a “swarm” of OpenAI agents hacking a startup and tech insider warnings of an existential threat , were cutting through – making government action more likely.
The Canadian computer scientist, a prominent voice in the campaign to rein in breakneck AI development, said he was now “more optimistic than many observers because I see the public moving”.
Comparing the AI safety crisis to the onset of the Covid pandemic in 2020, Bengio said: “Think about how quickly governments moved after the beginning of the pandemic when they realised that public safety, their future, democracy, was in danger. You would expect that they move quickly. So we are, I think, nearing that point.”
Concern over the potential threat of powerful AI systems has reached a new pitch in recent months after a series of safety incidents involving OpenAI and Anthropic agents carrying out unsanctioned activities such as hacking third parties, hijacking a German website, and using fake identities to try to trick developers.
His comments came as 42 fellows and foreign members of the Royal Society wrote to the organisation’s president, Sir Paul Nurse, to express their “extreme concern” over the pace of AI development. “By the time the situation becomes obvious to the wider public, it may be too late to act,” the researchers wrote in an open letter to Nurse. “We believe this is an emergency, and call on the Royal Society to use its influence to convey this view to government and the media.”
Last week, a researcher at Anthropic, the startup behind the Claude chatbot, resigned after warning that colleagues believed AI could “kill us all by the end of the decade”. Days later, Anthropic’s chief executive, Dario Amodei, called for a slowdown in the pace of cutting-edge AI development – a move that was immediately supported by OpenAI, Google and Elon Musk, the CEO of SpaceX.
However, sceptics of the “slowdown” call have claimed that calls by major AI firms are an example of “regulatory capture”, where companies persuade governments to introduce safety regimes that raise the cost of smaller rivals being able to compete. They also claim existential fears overshadow more immediate issues with AI such as its impact on copyright-protected work and human rights.
Bengio said he disagreed with the regulatory capture argument because a slowdown by leading AI firms would “cost them financially”. The US president, Donald Trump, has rejected a slowdown, saying he does not want the US to lose its lead over China in the AI race.
View image in fullscreen Yoshua Bengio, a professor at the University of Montreal, won a Turing award in 2018. Photograph: Andrej Ivanov/AFP/Getty Images Bengio spoke as the Canadian and German governments announced funding of up to C$300m (£160m) for his non-profit organisation dedicated to creating an “honest AI” that will act as a guardrail against rogue agents – AI tools that carry out sequences of tasks without human intervention.
Bengio, a professor at the University of Montreal, earned the “godfather of AI” moniker after winning the 2018 Turing award, seen as the equivalent of a Nobel prize for computing. He shared it with Geoffrey Hinton, who later won a Nobel , and Yann LeCun, the former chief AI scientist at Mark Zuckerberg’s Meta.
Bengio’s organisation, LawZero, is developing a system called Scientist AI that will act as a guardrail against AI agents showing deceptive or self-preserving behaviour, such as trying to avoid being turned off. LawZero is also funded by the Gates Foundation, the chipmaker Nvidia, and Coefficient Giving, a philanthropic body linked to effective altruism, a movement that believes AI poses an existential threat.
The LawZero technology is viewed by Bengio as a counterpoint to reinforcement learning, a trial-and-error development technique used by major AI companies where AIs are rewarded for working out how to carry out a specific task. The Canadian computer scientist believes, along with other experts, this training technique encourages AIs to pursue their goals recklessly and cause harm in the process, as shown by the OpenAI “swarm”.
Deployed alongside an AI agent, Bengio’s technology would raise potentially harmful behaviour by an autonomous system – having weighed whether its actions could cause harm. Bengio expects the technology to be deployed for other uses eventually, such as accelerating scientific breakthroughs.
items.title_zh: AI“教父”称技术监管即将迎来疫情式转折时刻

items.title: The monologue is like an actor's first handshake with a casting director - WGCU
items.body:

论点：独白是演员展示多样性的关键，能够反映出他们的能力和情感范围。

items.article_body:
Facebook LinkedIn Email Print Courtesy of Cultural Park Theatre / Artistic Director Robin Murray, Cultural Park Theatre Actor reads monologue for casting director at Cultural Park Theatre. Whether auditioning for a comedy, drama or musical, an actor arrives at an audition equipped with a head shot, resume and a couple of monologues. Cultural Park Theatre Executive Director Robin Murray says the monologue plays a crucial role in her decision about whether or not to use an actor in a show she is casting.
“I consider a monologue the first handshake that you're giving a director,” said Murray. “It kind of shows what your abilities are without having somebody to rely on, another castmate to rely on or a set or a prop. And we can see what your range is, if you are able to move your body and your voice along with the words without relying on other things on a set.”
According to Murray, the best monologues don’t just showcase an actor’s talent and versatility, they tell a story with a beginning, middle and end.
“I like to see like the seasons in a monologue when somebody gives it,” Murray added. “I want to see them start as them and then I want to see an arc and then I want to see almost a resolution and then an ending.”
Courtesy of Gerrie Benzing / Gerrie Benzing Actor, author, director and theatre instructor Gerrie Benzing has just published a new book of monologues for kids. Local actor, director and theatre instructor Gerrie Benzing has just published a new book of monologues. She knows exactly what casting directors such as Murray want.
“Since a monologue is a chance to show a director what you can do. I try to put more than one emotion in any monologue I write, so that there's a bit of an arc in it, so that you can show you can play different emotions,” Benzing said.
WGCU Arts Reporter Tom Hall / WGCU Arts Reporter Tom Hall Gerrie Benzing in the role of Lee in Charles Busch's 'The Tale of the Allergist's Wife.' Benzing’s experiences auditioning for roles, performing in a wide variety of shows and teaching theater to children and teens informs the way she crafts each monologue. But it was happenstance that led her to publish three compilations of the monologues she’s been writing since 2006.
“My monologue started, of course, with my own son, who was performing at the time, and we could not find a monologue anywhere that was different, that was new,” Benzing explained. “So, I wrote him one. And he entered the Young Artist Competition, and he was only 10. And it was a competition that went all the way up to college. And he won the whole thing. And so, everybody said please write me a monologue.”
Since then, actors using her monologues have enjoyed considerable success winning roles and competitions around the globe.
Courtesy of Gerrie Benzing / Gerrie Benzing Actors using her monologues have enjoyed considerable success winning roles and competitions around the globe. “I have had a student text me from South Africa. He entered a worldwide monologue competition and he won his category. He's since been cast in all kinds of films,” Benzing noted. “I had a boy who auditioned for a Broadway show and used one of my monologues and he was cast. But my biggest success story was Michael Fatica, who I started teaching in summer camps here at the Cultural Park. And he has become a successful star on Broadway.”
Courtesy of Gerrie Benzing / Gerrie Benzing It’s everyday kids having success on a local level that really touches Benzing’s heartstrings. But it’s everyday kids having success on a local level that really touches Benzing’s heartstrings.
“The thing that makes me the most proud are the kids that text me and say, ‘Hey, I won my student talent show.’ ‘I got second place. I almost won.’” Benzing added. “And they are so happy. And the fact that I could give them something that they love to do and that they did well with and they were happy with, I think that's the thing that makes me the most happy.”
Courtesy of Gerrie Benzing / Gerrie Benzing Gerrie Benzing will sign copies of 'Character Monologues for Kids' following the 7:30 p.m. performance of 'Charlie and the Chocolate Factory' on September 19. Cultural Park Theatre will be hosting a book signing for Benzing’s latest book, “Character Monologues for Kids: Own the Moment,” following the 7 p.m. performance of “Charlie and the Chocolate Factory” on Sept. 19 .
The event marks a milestone in Benzing’s career as an author.
“This is my absolute first one and I’m super excited about it.” Benzing noted.
A Chicago native, Robin Murray caught the acting bug in fourth grade. Now living in Southwest Florida, Murray is the producing artistic director of Cultural Park Theatre.
“Cultural Park Theatre is one of the longest running community theaters in Lee County,” Murray noted. “We are now entering into our 64th season. We produce adult plays, children’s plays, comedies, dramas, rom-cons and musicals as well. And our musicals are usually on the lighter side and include children.”
Courtesy of Cultural Park Theatre / Robin Murray, Artistic Director, Cultural Park Theatre. Actors use sides during an audition at Cultural Park Theatre. Every theater has its own way of announcing auditions.
“At Cultural Park, we put out a call usually on social media and then we will give the breakdown of what each character is and whether or not you need to come in with a 16-bar song, 60 seconds, 90 seconds,” Murray said. “For our regular plays, we will also have the breakdown and we will ask you either to come in with a monologue, be very familiar with the show, and then we will have you read sides.”
The term “sides” refers to excerpts from the script that actors are given to learn for an audition. This excerpt could be an entire scene, or just part of one. Depending on the project, sides can also include more than one section of the script for an actor to learn.
The term dates back to Shakespeare, when actors were only given their lines for rehearsals since scripts had to be written longhand.
Theaters often provide the sides in advance of the audition so that actors can familiarize themselves with the lines prior to arriving.
Courtesy of Cultural Park Theatre / Robin Murray, Artistic Director, Cultural Park Theatre The purpose of a well-chosen monologue is to demonstrate an actor's versatility. While a side will give the casting director a rough idea about how an actor will potentially handle the role they’re auditioning for and fit in with the rest of the cast, sides do not reflect the actor’s overall skill set. That’s the purpose of a well-chosen monologue, Murray said.
“Based on the monologue, we know whether or not you're versatile, and that's the biggest thing we need in an actor, to be versatile,” Murray said. The monologue is going to show us an actor’s range where the sides are going to show us if they can carry a character, the specific character.”
Courtesy of Cultural Park Theatre / Robin Murray, Artistic Director, Cultural Park Theatre To gauge an actor’s versatility, the casting director will often have ask the auditioner to switch from drama to comedy while reading a monologue. To gauge an actor’s versatility, the casting director will often have ask the auditioner to switch up the tenor of the reading.
“If you are saying a line that’s very comedic, the director might ask you to read it in a more serious tone,” Murray pointed out.
While monologues are important in all genres, Murray noted that for musical auditions, “the voice is weighted the most because, depending on the part the person is auditioning for, if they cannot hit the note ….”
In addition to directing, Murray is an accomplished actor. Her stage credits include the evil nurse Pat Jones in “Four Old Broads” for The Belle Theatre and Mary Jane McMann in “Inspecting Carol.” She also appeared in “Marvin’s Room,” “I Remember Mama,” “Anton in Show Business,” “The Last Days of Judas Iscariot,” “Picasso at the Lapin Agile,” “On Golden Pond,” “Five Kinds of Silence” and “Calendar Girls.”
Courtesy of Gerrie Benzing / Gerrie Benzing Benzing played the part of Ruth in the Naples Players' production of 'Calendar Girls' in 2021. About Gerrie Benzing
As the creative director of Monologues4kids.com, Gerrie Benzing has written numerous children’s plays and over 500 monologues for clients worldwide. Dozens of children have used Benzing’s monologues to win movie roles, theater auditions, talent shows and pageants and to secure professional representation.
Courtesy of Gerrie Benzing / Gerrie Benzing Gerrie Benzing's new book 'Character Monologues for Kids.' Her new book is “Character Monologues for Kids: Own the Moment.”
“I have a lot of monologues,” noted Benzing, who has been writing monologues for more than 20 years. “A lot of them are straight comedic monologues, but many are character monologues as well, like Goldilocks talking about how she's not a criminal. When I directed kid shows, I loved seeing characters in the monologue selection. So that's what this [latest book] is, a book of character monologues.”
She included nearly 100 for “Character Monologues for Kids.”
Courtesy of Gerrie Benzing / Gerrie Benzing 'Duet Acting Scenes for Kids' is among Benzing's books of monologues. Her previous books are “Duet Acting Scenes for Teens,” “Duet Acting Scenes for Kids,” “Monologues4kids Theater Camp Plays: Broadway Version” and “Commercials for Kids.” She has also contributed original monologues to the book “Active Listening,” by Michael Rost and J.J. Wilson.
Courtesy of Gerrie Benzing / Gerrie Benzing 'Duet Acting Scenes for Teens' is among Benzing's books of monologues. “I have lots more monologues,” Benzing added. “So there are more books coming. Lots of them.”
A local stage and film actor, director and musical theatre instructor, Benzing has directed six mainstage productions at Cultural Park Theater, including “Chicago” (2019), “Sister Act” in 2018 (for which she won a Cultural Park Theatre Best Director Marquee Award), “Boeing, Boeing” in 2016 (for which she won as Cultural Park Theatre Best Director Marquee Award) and “Peter Pan” (for which she garnered a Cultural Park Best Director of a Musical Marquee Award in 2014).
WGCU Arts Reporter Tom Hall / WGCU Arts Reporter Tom Hall Gerrie Benzing as Ethel Thayer in 'On Golden Pond' at Cultural Park Theatre in 2019 She has also appeared in more than a dozen shows at Cultural Park Theatre, including the iconic role of Ethel Thayer in “On Golden Pond,” “Harvey” (for which she won a Cultural Park Theatre Best Actress Marquee Award for her portrayal of Veta), “The Glass Menagerie” (in which she was cast as Amanda), “Dixie Swim Club” (Sharee), Bella Manningham in “Angel Street” (Gaslight) , “Bad Seed” (Christine) and Jack Neary’s “The Porch.”
“We asked Gerrie to do a book signing following Saturday night’s performance of ‘Charlie and the Chocolate Factory’ because she’s been an important staple here at the theater,” Murray noted. “A lot of the kids that are directing shows and working here have worked with Gerrie since they were 5 years old. So, it just is a natural thing to bring her back and have her showcase those monologues that the kids use to start their careers.”
WGCU Arts Reporter Tom Hall / WGCU Arts Reporter Tom Hall Gerrie Benzing as Frau Blucher in The Belle Theatre's 2025 production of 'Young Frankenstein.' Benzing’s other stage credits include Frau Blucher in “Young Frankenstein” at The Belle Theatre, a Pigeon sister in “The Odd Couple” at Fort Myers Theatre, swing for Mary Meeker in “Unnecessary Farce” at Off Broadway Palm, cigarette-smoking, whiskey-swilling sexpot Elaine Navazio in Neil Simon’s “Last of the Red Hot Lovers” for The Belle Theatre, Julia Budder in “It’s Only a Play” at The Studio Players, Caprice in “A Doublewide, Texas Christmas” at Broadway Palm Dinner Theatre, Mother Superior in “Drinking Habits” (The Belle Theatre), Gertrude in “Save Hamlet” (for Lab Theater), Raven in “Trouble (at the Vista View Mobile Home Estates)” for Florida Rep
items.title_zh: 独白：演员展示多样性的关键
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了独白在演员试镜中的重要性。科学家指出，独白是演员与导演之间的首次接触，能够展示演员的多样性和能力。通过独白，导演可以判断演员是否具备多变的表演能力，这是演员最需要的特质。文章强调，独白不仅展示了演员的情感范围，还能体现他们的表演技巧，而侧面剧本则只能反映演员对特定角色的理解。因此，独白在试镜中起着至关重要的作用，能够帮助导演评估演员的潜力和适应性。
items.l1_lead: 独白在演员试镜中至关重要，它不仅展示了演员的多样性和情感范围，还能帮助导演评估其表演能力和适应性。
items.l2_summary:
本文探讨了独白（monologue）在演员试镜中的重要性，强调其在演员与导演之间首次接触时所发挥的关键作用。科学家指出，独白不仅是演员展示自身多样性和表演能力的机会，也是导演评估演员是否具备多变表演能力的重要依据。这种多变性被认为是演员最需要的特质之一。通过独白，演员能够展现出丰富的情感范围和高超的表演技巧，而侧面剧本（side script）则往往只能反映演员对特定角色的理解，无法全面展示其表演潜力。

文章进一步强调，独白在试镜中的重要性体现在其能够帮助导演更全面地评估演员的适应性和潜力。通过独白，导演可以观察到演员在不同情境下的表现，进而判断其是否适合某个角色。这种评估不仅依赖于演员的情感表达，还包括他们对角色的诠释能力和即兴发挥的能力。因此，独白在演员试镜中扮演着至关重要的角色，是导演选择合适演员的重要依据。

总的来说，独白作为一种表演形式，不仅展示了演员的个人魅力和专业素养，还为导演提供了一个全面评估演员能力的平台。这使得独白在试镜过程中不可或缺，成为演员与导演之间沟通和理解的桥梁。

items.title: Clinical workflow gaps slow healthcare technology adoption - Healthcare Asia Magazine
items.body:

论点：医疗技术在从研发到部署的过程中，必须考虑其是否能无缝融入现有系统，否则将不会被采纳。

items.topic_zh: 医疗技术采纳中的挑战
items.claim_zh: 医疗技术在从研发到部署的过程中，必须考虑其是否能无缝融入现有系统，否则将不会被采纳。
items.article_body:
Published: 12 days ago Clinical workflow gaps slow healthcare technology adoption Medtech companies face commercial barriers when new products fail to integrate with hospital systems or add complexity to clinical practice.
Healthcare technology companies risk losing adoption if products cannot fit existing clinical workflows, regardless of how advanced the underlying technology may be.
Speaking during Medical Fair Asia 2026, Yu-Han, Project Manager at Taiwan Excellence, said healthcare products are assessed across research and development, design, marketing and quality, with emphasis on whether they address practical needs.
“We look for solutions that really solve real life problems and deliver everyday impact,” Yu-Han said.
The real test comes when healthcare technology moves from development to deployment. Hospitals must consider whether new tools can be integrated into existing systems without creating additional administrative or operational burdens for clinicians.
“A tech solution can be brilliant in a lab, but if it adds extra steps to a doctor's everyday life or doesn't fit into hospital systems, it won't be adopted,” Yu-Han said.
Regulation adds another layer of complexity. Navigating different local policies and requirements can lengthen implementation and complicate market entry across healthcare systems.
For medtech companies, commercial success therefore depends not only on technical performance but also on workflow compatibility, regulatory readiness and ease of implementation.
Technologies that reduce friction for clinicians and integrate more easily into existing hospital processes are more likely to move from pilot or development stages into routine use.
items.title_zh: 医疗技术采纳受限于临床工作流程缺口
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了医疗技术在从研发到部署过程中面临的挑战，特别是其与现有医院系统的兼容性问题。作者指出，尽管技术解决方案在实验室中可能表现出色，但如果它们增加了医生日常工作的复杂性或无法与医院系统无缝对接，就不会被广泛采纳。文章强调，解决实际问题并在日常工作中产生影响是推动医疗技术成功应用的关键。
items.l1_lead: 医疗技术的成功应用依赖于其与临床工作流程的兼容性，若增加医生工作复杂性则难以被广泛采纳。
items.l2_summary:
本文探讨了医疗技术在从研发到部署过程中所面临的挑战，特别是与现有医院系统的兼容性问题。作者指出，尽管一些技术解决方案在实验室环境中表现出色，但在实际应用中，如果这些技术增加了医生日常工作的复杂性，或者无法与医院的现有系统无缝对接，就会导致其难以被广泛采纳。这一现象反映出医疗技术采纳的一个重要障碍，即临床工作流程的缺口。文章强调，解决实际问题并在日常工作中产生积极影响，是推动医疗技术成功应用的关键。

在医疗行业，医生的工作流程通常是高度复杂且繁忙的，任何可能导致额外负担的技术都可能被抵制。因此，医疗技术的设计和实施必须充分考虑临床工作流程的实际需求，确保技术能够与现有系统有效整合，以减少对医生工作的干扰。作者呼吁研发团队在技术开发阶段就应与临床医生密切合作，了解他们的需求和痛点，从而设计出更符合实际使用场景的解决方案。

此外，文章还指出，成功的医疗技术不仅需要在技术层面上具备先进性，更需要在实际应用中展现出其对临床工作的积极影响。只有当医疗技术能够真正解决临床医生面临的实际问题，并在日常工作中提供便利时，才能获得医生的认可和采纳。因此，推动医疗技术的成功应用，关键在于如何有效地缩小技术与临床工作流程之间的差距，确保技术的实用性和可操作性。
