items.title: Combating Genetic Heterogeneity for Polygenic Prediction of Susceptibility to Brain β-Amyloid Deposition: Beyond i APOE /i .
items.body: Background and objectives The APOE (apolipoprotein E) ε4 allele is the strongest known genetic risk factor for sporadic Alzheimer disease (AD) and for brain amyloidosis, an early marker of disease pathophysiology. However, APOE ε4 is present in only 25% of the general population and is by itself inadequate for explaining susceptibility to amyloid accumulation or AD diagnosis. Existing studies have been limited by potential confounding due to inclusion of individuals carrying APOE ε4 or ε2 (which has a modest protective association). We hypothesized that genome-wide association study (GWAS) and genetic risk score (GRS) analyses in APOE ε3/ε3 individuals would uniquely identify novel predictors of β-amyloid pathology in older adults. Methods We analyzed data from the Mayo Clinic Study of Aging (MCSA), Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI), and Rush Religious Orders Study and Memory and Aging Project. Frequency of APOE ε3/ε3 in those samples ranged from 48% to 61%. A GWAS was performed across 1,496 individuals with amyloid PET to identify candidate variants for GRS generation. Postmortem neuropathologic data (N = 710) were used to refine the variant list to capture high-likelihood true associations. An independent sample (N = 641) with plasma p-tau 181 data was used for validation. Results The GWAS identified previously implicated (e.g., PICALM and RBFOX1 ) and novel potential associations with amyloid PET burden. A non- APOE GRS of top variants was strongly associated with amyloid PET levels in the MCSA ( p = 4.34 × 10 -9 , β = 5.88) and ADNI ( p = 1.87 × 10 -8 , β = 12.1) cohorts. In both cohorts, this non- APOE amyloid GRS outperformed a comparator GRS (based on variants associated with clinically diagnosed AD dementia risk) in explaining phenotypic variation. The non- APOE amyloid GRS was also associated with postmortem neuropathologic β-amyloid and neurofibrillary tangle burden and in an independent sample was associated with plasma p-tau 181 concentrations (a robust indicator of cerebral amyloidosis). Discussion Our non- APOE amyloid GRS, which appropriately includes variants associated with amyloid deposition in APOE ɛ4/ɛ2 noncarriers, may advance personalized prediction of genetic susceptibility to β-amyloid accumulation within the large segment of the population that is APOE ε3/ε3. This may have future implications for risk modification, trial enrollment, and treatment selection.
items.authors: Ramanan VK, Heckman MG, Hofrenning EI, Przybelski SA, Graff-Radford J, Lowe VJ, Machulda MM, Murray ME, Algeciras-Schimnich A, Figdore DJ, Bennett DA, Knopman DS, Jack CR, Petersen RC, Ross OA, Vemuri P, Alzheimer's Dise
items.title_zh: 应对基因异质性以预测脑β-淀粉样沉积易感性
items.summary_zh: APOE（载脂蛋白E）ε4等位基因是散发性阿尔茨海默病（AD）和脑淀粉样变的最强已知遗传风险因素。然而，APOE ε4仅存在于25%的普通人群中，单独无法解释淀粉样物质积累或AD诊断的易感性。现有研究因包含携带APOE ε4或ε2（具有适度保护作用）个体而受到潜在混杂因素的限制。我们假设在APOE ε3/ε3个体中进行全基因组关联研究（GWAS）和遗传风险评分（GRS）分析将独特识别出老年人β-淀粉样病理的新预测因子。我们分析了梅奥诊所老龄化研究（MCSA）、阿尔茨海默病神经影像学倡议（ADNI）和拉什宗教团体研究及记忆与老龄化项目的数据。GWAS在1496名接受淀粉样PET扫描的个体中进行，识别出候选变异以生成GRS，并利用710名个体的尸检神经病理数据精炼变异列表。结果显示，GWAS识别了先前相关的基因（如PICALM和RBFOX1）及新发现的变异。
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，通过对APOE ε3/ε3个体进行全基因组关联研究，可以识别出新的预测因子，从而更好地预测老年人脑内β-淀粉样沉积的易感性。
items.l2_summary:
APOE（载脂蛋白E）ε4等位基因是散发性阿尔茨海默病（AD）和脑淀粉样变的最强已知遗传风险因素，但其仅在25%的普通人群中存在，因此单独依靠APOE ε4无法全面解释淀粉样物质的积累或AD的易感性。现有研究通常包含携带APOE ε4或ε2（后者具有适度保护作用）个体，导致潜在的混杂因素影响研究结果。为了解决这一问题，研究者假设在APOE ε3/ε3个体中进行全基因组关联研究（GWAS）和遗传风险评分（GRS）分析，能够独特地识别出老年人β-淀粉样病理的新预测因子。

在此研究中，分析了梅奥诊所老龄化研究（MCSA）、阿尔茨海默病神经影像学倡议（ADNI）和拉什宗教团体研究及记忆与老龄化项目的数据。GWAS在1496名接受淀粉样PET扫描的个体中进行，识别出候选变异以生成GRS，并利用710名个体的尸检神经病理数据进一步精炼变异列表。研究结果显示，GWAS不仅识别了先前已知相关的基因，如PICALM和RBFOX1，还发现了一些新的变异。这些发现为理解和预测老年人β-淀粉样沉积的易感性提供了新的线索，可能为未来的阿尔茨海默病预防和干预策略奠定基础。

items.title: Role of serotonin in psychiatric and somatic comorbidities of attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder: a systematic literature review.
items.body: Introduction Serotonin is a well-established modulator of various neuropsychological processes, as well as organ and endocrine functioning, and metabolism and homeostasis. Serotonin has been implicated in the neurobiology of attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD). Herein, the evidence for a serotonergic link between psychiatric and somatic comorbidities associated with ADHD was evaluated. Methods A systematic literature review was conducted of the published literature to identify comorbidities proven to co-occur with ADHD and determine whether there was any serotonergic pathophysiology associated with these comorbidities. The average grade of serotonergic evidence was calculated and plotted alongside the volume of publications for each identified comorbidity. The date of the last search was 7 March 2024. Results One hundred eighty-two individual comorbidities commonly occurring in ADHD populations were identified; 135 (74.2 %) had evidence for serotonergic pathophysiology, including 91 psychiatric and 44 somatic conditions. The grade of evidence for a serotonergic role in the pathophysiology of a given comorbidity was generally medium to high or high. Conclusions Findings indicate that serotonin plays a key role, alongside dopamine and norepinephrine, in ADHD neurobiology. Serotonin involvement in physiological functioning suggests that dysregulation is likely to generate a broad spectrum of clinical manifestations, which may account for the unique presentation of neuropsychiatric behaviors and comorbidities found in patients with ADHD.
items.authors: Faraone SV, Ward CL, Boucher M, Elbekai R, Brunner E.
items.title_zh: 血清素在注意缺陷多动障碍合并症中的作用综述
items.summary_zh: 本文系统评述了血清素在注意缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）及其相关精神和躯体合并症中的作用。通过对已发表文献的系统回顾，识别出182种常见的ADHD合并症，其中135种（74.2%）显示出与血清素（serotonin）相关的病理生理证据，包括91种精神疾病和44种躯体疾病。研究结果表明，血清素在ADHD的神经生物学中与多巴胺和去甲肾上腺素共同发挥关键作用，且其在生理功能中的参与暗示了血清素的失调可能导致相关合并症的发生。
items.l1_lead: 血清素在注意缺陷多动障碍及其合并症中发挥关键作用，其失调可能导致多种精神和躯体疾病的发生。
items.l2_summary: 本文系统评述了血清素（serotonin）在注意缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）及其相关精神和躯体合并症中的作用。通过对已发表文献的系统回顾，研究者识别出182种常见的ADHD合并症，其中有135种（占74.2%）显示出与血清素相关的病理生理证据。这些合并症包括91种精神疾病和44种躯体疾病，表明血清素在ADHD的神经生物学中扮演着重要角色。研究结果强调，血清素与多巴胺（dopamine）和去甲肾上腺素（norepinephrine）共同发挥关键作用，参与ADHD的生理功能。血清素的失调可能导致相关合并症的发生，这为理解ADHD的复杂性提供了新的视角。综上所述，血清素在ADHD及其合并症中的作用值得进一步研究，以期为临床干预提供新的思路和依据。

items.title: A six-tiered framework for evaluating AI models from repeatability to replaceability.
items.body: Artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly transforming biotechnology and medicine. But evaluating its safety, effectiveness, and generalizability is increasingly challenging, especially for complex generative models. Traditional evaluation metrics often fall short in high-stakes applications where reliability and adaptability are critical. We propose a six-tiered framework to guide AI evaluation across the dimensions of repeatability, reproducibility, robustness, rigidity, reusability, and replaceability. These tiers reflect increasing expectations, from basic consistency to deployment. Each is defined clearly, with actionable testing methodologies informed by literature. Designed for flexibility, the framework applies to both traditional and generative AI. Through case studies in diagnostics and medical large language models (LLM), we demonstrate its utility in fostering trustworthy, accountable, and effective AI for biomedicine, biotechnology, and beyond.
items.authors: Tian S, Lam AWY, Sung JJ, Goh WWB.
items.title_zh: 评估人工智能模型的六层框架
items.summary_zh: 人工智能（AI）正在迅速改变生物技术和医学，但评估其安全性、有效性和普适性变得愈加困难，尤其是对于复杂的生成模型。传统的评估指标在高风险应用中往往不足以满足可靠性和适应性的要求。本文提出了一种六层框架，以指导AI在可重复性、可再现性、稳健性、刚性、可重用性和可替代性等维度的评估。这些层次反映了从基本一致性到部署的逐步期望。每一层都有明确的定义，并结合文献提供可操作的测试方法。该框架设计灵活，适用于传统AI和生成AI。通过在诊断和医学大语言模型（LLM）中的案例研究，展示了该框架在促进生物医学和生物技术领域可信、负责任和有效的AI方面的实用性。
items.l1_lead: 本文提出的六层框架为评估人工智能在生物医学和生物技术中的安全性与有效性提供了系统化的方法，旨在提升其可靠性和适应性。
items.l2_summary:
人工智能（AI）在生物技术和医学领域的迅速发展带来了许多机遇，但同时也使得评估其安全性、有效性和普适性变得愈加复杂，尤其是在复杂的生成模型（generative models）中。传统的评估指标在高风险应用中往往无法满足对可靠性和适应性的严格要求。为此，本文提出了一种六层框架，以指导对AI模型的评估，涵盖可重复性、可再现性、稳健性、刚性、可重用性和可替代性等六个维度。这些层次从基本一致性到实际部署，逐步反映了对AI模型的期望。

每一层都有明确的定义，并结合相关文献提供了可操作的测试方法，确保评估过程的科学性和系统性。该框架的设计具有灵活性，适用于传统AI和生成AI的评估，能够适应不同类型的应用场景。通过在诊断和医学大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLM）中的案例研究，本文展示了该框架在促进生物医学和生物技术领域中可信、负责任和有效的AI应用方面的实用性。这一框架不仅为研究人员提供了评估工具，也为行业实践提供了指导，旨在推动AI技术在医疗健康领域的安全应用，确保其在复杂环境中的可靠性和适应性。

items.title: Heart failure and obesity: novel insights leading to new treatment paradigms.
items.body: Heart failure (HF) and obesity place a substantial burden on health-care systems worldwide. Obesity is associated with an estimated 5-7% increase in the incidence of new-onset HF for each unit increase in body mass index. This obesity-associated risk is more pronounced for HF with preserved ejection fraction than for HF with reduced ejection fraction. The relationship between HF and obesity has historically been underrecognized. However, because of the development of weight-loss drugs with beneficial effects on outcomes in patients with HF with preserved ejection fraction, this link is now clear. In this Review, we provide a summary of the effects of obesity on the development of HF, exploring the epidemiology and potential pathophysiological mechanisms linking these two conditions. We also discuss management strategies, including lifestyle interventions and novel pharmaceutical approaches. This Review adds an impetus to all practitioners of cardiovascular medicine, especially specialists in HF, to become well-versed in obesity management and underscores the need for further research on the effects of intentional weight loss in various cardiovascular conditions.
items.authors: Meems LMG, van Veldhuisen DJ, Sattar N, Lee MMY.
items.title_zh: 心力衰竭与肥胖：新见解引领治疗新范式
items.summary_zh: 心力衰竭（HF）和肥胖对全球医疗系统造成了重大负担。研究表明，肥胖每增加一个单位的体重指数，心力衰竭新发病例的发生率增加5-7%。这种肥胖相关风险在射血分数保留的心力衰竭（HFpEF）中更为明显。历史上，HF与肥胖之间的关系未受到足够重视，但随着减重药物的开发，这一联系变得更加清晰。本文综述了肥胖对HF发展的影响，探讨了两者之间的流行病学和潜在病理生理机制，并讨论了管理策略，包括生活方式干预和新型药物方法。本文强调心血管医学从业者，尤其是HF专家，需熟悉肥胖管理，并指出在各种心血管疾病中对有意减重效果的进一步研究的必要性。
items.l1_lead: 肥胖显著增加心力衰竭新发病例风险，尤其在射血分数保留的心力衰竭中，强调了肥胖管理在心血管疾病治疗中的重要性。
items.l2_summary:
心力衰竭（HF）和肥胖在全球范围内对医疗系统造成了显著的负担。研究显示，肥胖每增加一个单位的体重指数（BMI），心力衰竭新发病例的发生率便增加5-7%。这一风险在射血分数保留的心力衰竭（HFpEF）患者中尤为明显。尽管历史上心力衰竭与肥胖之间的关系未受到足够重视，但随着减重药物的不断开发，这一联系逐渐变得清晰。本文综述了肥胖对心力衰竭发展的影响，探讨了两者之间的流行病学特征及潜在的病理生理机制。

肥胖不仅是心力衰竭的一个重要危险因素，还可能通过多种机制加速心力衰竭的发生，包括代谢异常、炎症反应和心脏结构的改变等。随着对肥胖与心力衰竭关系的深入研究，管理策略也在不断演变。生活方式干预，如饮食调整和增加身体活动，仍然是治疗肥胖的重要手段。此外，新型减重药物的出现为肥胖患者提供了新的治疗选择，可能在心力衰竭的管理中发挥重要作用。

本文强调，心血管医学从业者，尤其是心力衰竭专家，需对肥胖管理有充分的了解，以便更好地应对这一日益严重的健康问题。同时，作者指出在各种心血管疾病中，针对有意减重效果的进一步研究是非常必要的，以期为心力衰竭的预防和治疗提供更为有效的策略。通过综合考虑肥胖与心力衰竭之间的关系，未来的治疗方案有望更加精准和个性化，从而改善患者的预后和生活质量。

items.title: Research advances in the diagnosis of infectious disease by aptasensor technology.
items.body: Infectious diseases remain a major challenge to public health. The accurate and timely detection of pathogens responsible for these diseases is essential for controlling their spread, supporting clinical diagnosis, and enabling the application of appropriate therapies. Traditionally, the antibody-based assay has been the primary method for pathogen detection. However, recent advancements in aptamer-based technologies have initiated a transformative shift in diagnostic approaches. Aptamer-based sensors (aptasensors) are characterized by lower production costs and greater flexibility, making them compatible with various detection techniques. This broad applicability facilitates multifaceted, high-throughput applications, significantly improving the capacity to monitor and detect infectious diseases. In this review, we introduce the pathogenic mechanisms and characteristics of pathogens, provide an overview of recent advancements in the development of aptasensors for pathogen detection and highlight their versatility in identifying various infectious disease pathogens, including viruses, bacteria, parasites and other microorganisms. We systematically categorize aptasensors according to their detection mechanisms, including colorimetry, fluorescence, chemiluminescence, surface-enhanced Raman spectroscopy (SERS), surface plasmon resonance (SPR), electrochemistry and incorporation of field-effect transistors (FETs). We further demonstrate how these platforms leverage pathogen-specific biological features to achieve ultrasensitive and rapid diagnostics. Further optimization and validation of aptasensor platforms are anticipated to accelerate their clinical translation and industrialization. Advancing these innovative technologies will be crucial to meeting the growing demand for rapid, accurate and reliable pathogen detection across diverse clinical and environmental conditions, ultimately strengthening the ability to respond effectively to infectious disease threats.
items.authors: Li H, Yang Q, Li X, Fu X, Li J, Zhang Y, Tan W, Wang P.
items.title_zh: 适配体传感器技术在传染病诊断中的研究进展
items.summary_zh: 传染病仍然是公共卫生面临的重大挑战，准确及时地检测病原体对控制其传播、支持临床诊断和应用适当治疗至关重要。传统上，基于抗体的检测方法是病原体检测的主要手段。然而，适配体（aptamer）技术的最新进展正在推动诊断方法的变革。适配体传感器（aptasensor）具有生产成本低和灵活性高的特点，适用于多种检测技术。这种广泛的适用性促进了多方面的高通量应用，显著提高了监测和检测传染病的能力。本文介绍了病原体的致病机制和特征，概述了适配体传感器在病原体检测方面的最新进展，并强调其在识别各种传染病病原体（包括病毒、细菌、寄生虫和其他微生物）中的多功能性。我们系统地根据检测机制对适配体传感器进行了分类，包括比色法、荧光法、化学发光法、表面增强拉曼光谱（SERS）、表面等离子体共振（SPR）、电化学等。
items.l1_lead: 适配体传感器技术在传染病诊断中展现出低成本、高灵活性和多功能性，显著提升了病原体的监测和检测能力。
items.l2_summary:
传染病依然是公共卫生领域面临的重大挑战，及时准确地检测病原体对于控制其传播、支持临床诊断以及实施适当治疗至关重要。传统的病原体检测方法主要依赖于抗体，但近年来适配体（aptamer）技术的进展正在推动这一领域的变革。适配体传感器（aptasensor）因其生产成本低、灵活性高而受到广泛关注，适用于多种检测技术，这种广泛的适用性促进了高通量应用的发展，显著提升了对传染病的监测和检测能力。

适配体传感器在病原体检测方面的最新进展显示出其在识别各种传染病病原体（包括病毒、细菌、寄生虫及其他微生物）中的多功能性。本文系统地对适配体传感器进行了分类，依据其检测机制分为比色法、荧光法、化学发光法、表面增强拉曼光谱（SERS）、表面等离子体共振（SPR）和电化学等多种方法。这些技术的多样性使得适配体传感器能够在不同的应用场景中发挥作用，提供灵敏且特异的检测结果。

通过对病原体的致病机制和特征的分析，适配体传感器的研究不仅为传染病的早期诊断提供了新的思路，也为公共卫生监测提供了更为高效的工具。随着适配体技术的不断发展，未来有望在传染病的快速检测和控制中发挥更为重要的作用。

items.title: Exploring the relationships between Early Childhood Adversity, Social Cognition, and Aggression in a South African Study of People Living with Schizophrenia.
items.body: People living with schizophrenia (PLS) are at increased risk of being both victims and perpetrators of violence. Recent research suggests that social cognitive impairments may contribute to heightened aggression in schizophrenia. Childhood trauma, a well-established risk factor for both schizophrenia and aggression, is also linked to more severe cognitive deficits in PLS. Few studies have explored the relationships between childhood trauma, social cognition, and aggression in large sample sizes, particularly in low- and middle-income settings, where varying socioeconomic factors and exposure to violence may influence these associations. In this study, a subsample of participants (PLS = 585; controls = 882) from the Genomics of Schizophrenia in the South African Xhosa People study completed The Childhood Trauma Questionnaire (CTQ), Penn Emotion Identification Test (ER), Life History of Aggression Questionnaire (LHA), and Structured Diagnostic Interview for DSM-IV Axis I Disorders. Group differences in CTQ, ER, LHA, and selected demographic and clinical factors were assessed using t -tests and chi-square tests. Multivariable linear regressions were employed to test for associations among CTQ, ER, and LHA. We found that PLS had significantly higher childhood trauma and lifetime aggression scores and poorer emotion recognition performance than controls. Higher childhood trauma was associated with higher lifetime aggression and worse emotion recognition performance. However, emotion recognition performance was not associated with lifetime aggression. In this setting, childhood trauma predicts lifetime aggression and poorer emotion recognition, but there is no evidence that emotion recognition ability is related to aggression.
items.authors: van der Walt K, Wootton O, Rokicki J, Vaskinn A, Jonker D, Campbell M, Susser E, Haukvik UK, Gur RC, Stein DJ, Friestad C.
items.title_zh: 南非精神分裂症患者早期逆境、社会认知与攻击性关系研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了生活在南非的精神分裂症患者（PLS）与早期儿童创伤、社会认知及攻击性之间的关系。研究表明，PLS在暴力中既可能是受害者也可能是施害者，且社会认知障碍可能加剧其攻击性。儿童创伤作为精神分裂症和攻击性的已知风险因素，与PLS的认知缺陷严重程度相关。研究样本包括585名PLS和882名对照组参与者，使用儿童创伤问卷（CTQ）、宾州情感识别测试（ER）、攻击性历史问卷（LHA）及DSM-IV轴I障碍结构化诊断访谈进行评估。结果显示，PLS在儿童创伤和终生攻击性评分上显著高于对照组，情感识别表现也较差。研究强调了儿童创伤与社会认知及攻击性之间的关联，尤其在低中收入国家背景下。
items.l1_lead: 研究发现，南非精神分裂症患者的早期儿童创伤与其社会认知障碍和攻击性显著相关，强调了这一群体在暴力中可能既是受害者也是施害者。
items.l2_summary:
本研究旨在探讨生活在南非的精神分裂症患者（PLS）与早期儿童创伤、社会认知及攻击性之间的关系。研究发现，PLS在暴力行为中既可能是受害者，也可能是施害者，而社会认知障碍可能会加剧其攻击性。儿童创伤被认为是精神分裂症和攻击性的已知风险因素，并且与PLS的认知缺陷严重程度存在相关性。研究样本包括585名PLS和882名对照组参与者，采用儿童创伤问卷（CTQ）、宾州情感识别测试（ER）、攻击性历史问卷（LHA）及DSM-IV轴I障碍结构化诊断访谈进行评估。

结果显示，PLS在儿童创伤和终生攻击性评分上显著高于对照组，且在情感识别表现上也较差。这些发现强调了儿童创伤与社会认知及攻击性之间的关联，尤其是在低中收入国家的背景下。研究结果提示，早期的创伤经历可能对精神分裂症患者的社会认知能力产生负面影响，从而导致更高的攻击性行为。这一研究为理解精神分裂症患者的攻击性行为提供了新的视角，并指出了在临床干预中考虑早期创伤的重要性。

items.title: Pathfinding: a neurodynamical account of intuition.
items.body: We examine the neurobiology of intuition, a term often inconsistently defined in scientific literature. While researchers generally agree that intuition represents "an experienced-based process resulting in a spontaneous tendency toward a hunch or hypothesis," we establish a firmer neurobiological foundation by framing intuition evolutionarily as a pathfinding mechanism emerging from the brain's optimization of its relationship with the environment. Our review synthesizes empirical findings on intuition's neurobiological basis, including relevant brain networks and their relationship to cognitive states like insight. We propose that unsolved problems dynamically alter attractor landscapes, guiding future intuitions. We investigate "opportunistic assimilation" through nonlinear neurodynamics and identify hippocampal sharp wave ripples as potential neural correlates of intuition, citing their role in creativity, choice, action planning, and abstract thinking. Finally, we explore intuition through two complementary perspectives: the free energy principle, which models brains as minimizing uncertainty through predictive hierarchical coding, and metastable coordination dynamics, describing the brain's simultaneous tendencies toward regional cooperation and functional autonomy. Together, these principles provide a comprehensive neurodynamical account of intuition's neurophenomenology.
items.authors: Kotler S, Mannino M, Friston K, Buzsáki G, Kelso JAS, Dumas G.
items.title_zh: 路径探索：直觉的神经动力学解释
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了直觉的神经生物学，指出直觉是一个基于经验的过程，表现为对直觉或假设的自发倾向。我们将直觉视为一种进化的路径探索机制，源于大脑与环境关系的优化。文章综述了直觉的神经生物学基础，包括相关的大脑网络及其与洞察等认知状态的关系。我们提出未解决的问题动态改变吸引子景观，从而引导未来的直觉。通过非线性神经动力学，我们研究了“机会同化”，并识别海马体的尖波涟漪作为直觉的潜在神经相关物，强调其在创造力、选择、行动规划和抽象思维中的作用。最后，我们从自由能原理和亚稳态协调动力学两个互补视角探讨直觉，提供了直觉神经现象学的全面神经动力学解释。
items.l1_lead: 直觉是一种基于经验的进化路径探索机制，其神经生物学基础涉及大脑网络与认知状态的关系，强调海马体在创造力和决策中的关键作用。
items.l2_summary:
本文探讨了直觉的神经生物学，认为直觉是一个基于经验的过程，表现为对直觉或假设的自发倾向。我们将直觉视为一种进化的路径探索机制，其根源在于大脑与环境之间关系的优化。文章详细综述了直觉的神经生物学基础，重点分析了相关的大脑网络及其与洞察（insight）等认知状态之间的关系。研究表明，未解决的问题能够动态改变吸引子景观，从而引导未来的直觉形成。

通过非线性神经动力学的视角，本文探讨了“机会同化”（opportunity assimilation）现象，并识别出海马体的尖波涟漪（sharp wave ripples）作为直觉的潜在神经相关物。这一发现强调了海马体在创造力、选择、行动规划和抽象思维等认知过程中的重要作用。最后，文章从自由能原理（free energy principle）和亚稳态协调动力学（metastable coordination dynamics）两个互补视角出发，深入探讨了直觉的形成机制，提供了直觉神经现象学的全面神经动力学解释。

通过这些研究，本文不仅揭示了直觉的神经基础，还为理解人类决策和创造力提供了新的视角，强调了直觉在复杂环境中的适应性和重要性。

items.title: SPM-30 years and beyond.
items.body: This paper marks the 30th anniversary of the Statistical Parametric Mapping (SPM) software and the journal Cerebral Cortex: two modest milestones that mark the inception of cognitive neuroscience. We take this opportunity to reflect on SPM, a generation after its introduction. Each of the authors of this paper-who represent a small selection of the many contributors to SPM-were asked to consider lessons learned, what has gone well, and where there is room for improvement in future development. We hope that this review of SPM-and its aspirations-will provide some context for current imaging neuroscience and foreground some potential directions for the future of the field.
items.authors: Zeidman P, Ashburner J, Barnes G, Kowalczyk O, Lambert C, Litvak V, Nichols TE, Parr T, Tierney TM, Friston K.
items.title_zh: 统计参数映射软件30周年回顾
items.summary_zh: 本文纪念统计参数映射（SPM）软件和《脑皮层》期刊成立30周年，反映了神经科学领域的两个重要里程碑。作者们回顾了SPM自推出以来的经验教训，讨论了其成功之处以及未来发展的改进空间。希望通过对SPM及其愿景的评述，为当前成像神经科学提供背景，并指出该领域未来可能的发展方向。
items.l1_lead: 统计参数映射软件在神经科学领域的30年发展历程中取得了显著成就，同时也为未来的成像技术指明了改进方向。
items.l2_summary:
本文纪念统计参数映射（SPM）软件和《脑皮层》期刊成立30周年，标志着神经科学领域的两个重要里程碑。自SPM推出以来，作者们回顾了其在神经影像学中的应用与发展，强调了该软件在数据分析和结果可视化方面的成功之处。SPM的设计初衷是为了解决神经影像数据处理中的复杂性，提供了一种标准化的分析流程，使研究人员能够更有效地进行脑成像数据的统计分析。

在回顾中，作者指出SPM在过去三十年中经历了多个版本的迭代，每一次更新都在功能和用户体验上有所改进。这些进步不仅提升了数据处理的效率，还扩展了SPM在不同研究领域的应用范围，包括功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）、正电子发射断层扫描（PET）等。通过对SPM的分析，作者们总结出了一些关键经验教训，强调了开放科学和社区合作在软件发展中的重要性。

尽管SPM取得了显著的成就，但作者们也指出了未来发展的改进空间。例如，随着神经科学研究的不断深入，数据量和复杂性日益增加，SPM需要进一步优化算法以处理更大规模的数据集。此外，随着机器学习和人工智能技术的迅速发展，如何将这些新兴技术有效整合进SPM的框架中，也是未来研究的重要方向。

通过对SPM及其愿景的评述，本文为当前成像神经科学提供了重要的背景信息，并指出了该领域未来可能的发展方向。作者们希望，随着技术的不断进步和研究的深入，SPM能够继续在神经影像学领域发挥关键作用，推动科学研究的进一步发展。

items.title: Anti-ageing interventions for the treatment of cardiovascular disease.
items.body: As the global demographic landscape continues to shift towards an aged population, so does the medical and socioeconomic burden of cardiovascular diseases. Indeed, ageing is one of, if not, the key risk factor for the development of cardiovascular diseases. However, there are currently no approved cardiovascular therapeutics that primarily target the molecular and cellular mechanisms underlying the ageing process itself. In this review, we present the potential of emerging anti-ageing strategies, including epigenetic rejuvenation, metabolic reprogramming, autophagy activation, as well as senolytic and anti-inflammatory therapies, in delaying or reversing the development of age-related cardiovascular disorders, while considering potential sex differences. In doing so, we implicate cellular ageing processes in the pathogenesis of several prevalent cardiovascular diseases, such as atherosclerosis, hypertension, various types of cardiomyopathies (including its hypertrophic, ischaemic, dilated, diabetic, and arrhythmogenic forms) and heart failure, particularly that with preserved ejection fraction. Finally, we outline future challenges and steps needed for the implementation of these novel anti-ageing strategies in the clinical setting, with the aim of challenging the long-held notion of ageing as a 'non-modifiable' risk factor for cardiovascular diseases.
items.authors: Abdellatif M, Schmid ST, Fuerlinger A, Kroemer G.
items.title_zh: 抗衰老干预在心血管疾病治疗中的应用
items.summary_zh: 随着全球人口老龄化，心血管疾病的医疗和社会经济负担日益加重。衰老被认为是心血管疾病发展的关键风险因素之一。目前尚无针对衰老过程分子和细胞机制的心血管治疗药物。本文评述了新兴的抗衰老策略，包括表观遗传重塑（epigenetic rejuvenation）、代谢重编程（metabolic reprogramming）、自噬激活（autophagy activation）、清除衰老细胞（senolytic）和抗炎疗法（anti-inflammatory therapies），在延缓或逆转与年龄相关的心血管疾病发展中的潜力，并考虑性别差异。我们探讨了细胞衰老过程在动脉粥样硬化、高血压、各种类型心肌病（包括肥厚型、缺血型、扩张型、糖尿病型和心律失常型）及心力衰竭（特别是射血分数保留型）等常见心血管疾病发病机制中的作用。最后，我们概述了在临床应用这些新型抗衰老策略所面临的挑战和必要步骤，旨在挑战衰老作为心血管疾病“不可改变”风险因素的传统观念。
items.l1_lead: 抗衰老干预策略在心血管疾病治疗中展现出延缓和逆转与年龄相关病变的潜力，挑战了衰老作为不可改变风险因素的传统观念。
items.l2_summary:
随着全球人口的老龄化，心血管疾病的医疗和社会经济负担不断加重，衰老被认为是心血管疾病发展的关键风险因素之一。目前，尚无针对衰老过程的分子和细胞机制的心血管治疗药物。因此，本文评述了新兴的抗衰老策略在延缓或逆转与年龄相关的心血管疾病发展中的潜力。这些策略包括表观遗传重塑（epigenetic rejuvenation）、代谢重编程（metabolic reprogramming）、自噬激活（autophagy activation）、清除衰老细胞（senolytic）和抗炎疗法（anti-inflammatory therapies），并考虑了性别差异对这些策略的影响。

研究表明，细胞衰老过程在动脉粥样硬化、高血压、各种类型心肌病（如肥厚型、缺血型、扩张型、糖尿病型和心律失常型）及心力衰竭（特别是射血分数保留型）等常见心血管疾病的发病机制中发挥着重要作用。通过针对这些衰老相关机制的干预，可能有效减缓心血管疾病的进展，改善患者的生活质量。

然而，临床应用这些新型抗衰老策略仍面临诸多挑战，包括如何有效评估干预效果、个体化治疗方案的制定以及潜在的副作用等。因此，本文旨在挑战衰老作为心血管疾病“不可改变”风险因素的传统观念，强调通过科学研究和临床实践，抗衰老干预有望成为心血管疾病治疗的新方向。

items.title: The rising tide of drug-induced psychosis.
items.body: Recreational use of psychotogenic drugs has become more common in the last 30 years with consequent increase in drug-induced psychosis; 25-50% of such psychoses progress to schizophrenia within 5 years. Most cases result from abuse of methamphetamine or cannabis. The spread of methamphetamine psychosis has occurred without any liberalisation of laws; it is highly addictive and easy to make in small "kitchen" labs. The increase in cannabis use has been facilitated by a softening of attitudes towards the drug, and in some countries, especially in North America, by legalisation for so-called "medicinal use" and then recreational use. The potency of cannabis has greatly increased, especially in countries that have legalised its use, and the worldwide legal sales of cannabis for 2025 are estimated at $ 65 billion. The consequences are being seen with many reports of increases in the incidence of cannabis-psychosis and schizophrenia. In the 1980s some physicians predicted an epidemic of obesity and diabetes due to changes in diet and life style. Sadly, their predictions were correct. We are now at the beginning of a similar epidemic of drug-induced psychosis. Public education campaigns of the type that decreased tobacco smoking are necessary to avoid psychiatric services being overwhelmed.
items.journal: Neuropsychiatrie : Klinik, Diagnostik, Therapie und Rehabilitation : Organ der Gesellschaft Osterreichischer Nervenarzte und Psychiater
items.authors: Murray RM, Paparelli A, Di Forti M, Morrison P.
items.title_zh: 药物诱发精神病的上升潮流
items.summary_zh: 在过去30年中，精神药物的 recreational（娱乐性）使用变得越来越普遍，导致药物诱发精神病的增加；25-50%的此类精神病在5年内进展为精神分裂症。大多数病例源于对甲基苯丙胺（methamphetamine）或大麻（cannabis）的滥用。甲基苯丙胺精神病的传播发生在法律未放宽的情况下，其高度上瘾且易于在小型“厨房”实验室中制造。大麻使用的增加得益于对该药物态度的软化，以及在一些国家（尤其是北美）对所谓“医疗用途”及后来的娱乐用途的合法化。大麻的效力显著增强，尤其是在合法化使用的国家，预计2025年全球合法大麻销售额将达到650亿美元。随之而来的后果是，大麻精神病和精神分裂症的发生率增加。我们正处于药物诱发精神病类似流行病的开端，亟需开展公共教育活动，以避免精神卫生服务被淹没。
items.l1_lead: 药物诱发精神病的增加与精神药物的娱乐性使用普及密切相关，尤其是甲基苯丙胺和大麻，亟需加强公共教育以应对这一潜在流行病。
items.l2_summary:
在过去30年中，精神药物的娱乐性使用显著增加，导致药物诱发精神病的病例不断上升。研究表明，25%至50%的药物诱发精神病患者在五年内可能进展为精神分裂症（schizophrenia）。大多数病例与甲基苯丙胺（methamphetamine）和大麻（cannabis）的滥用密切相关。尽管甲基苯丙胺的法律地位并未放宽，但其高度上瘾性和易于在小型“厨房”实验室中制造，使得其精神病的传播愈发严重。同时，大麻的使用率也因社会对其态度的转变而显著上升，尤其是在一些国家（如北美）对大麻的“医疗用途”及后来的娱乐用途进行合法化后，大麻的效力显著增强。预计到2025年，全球合法大麻的销售额将达到650亿美元，这一趋势直接导致了大麻精神病和精神分裂症的发生率上升。

当前，我们正面临药物诱发精神病类似流行病的开端，亟需开展公共教育活动，以提高公众对这一问题的认识，避免精神卫生服务体系被日益增加的病例淹没。药物诱发精神病的上升不仅影响患者的生活质量，也对社会的医疗资源造成了巨大压力，因此，及时采取有效的干预措施显得尤为重要。

items.title: Appraisal of Gene Expression-Based Classifiers for Neuropsychiatric Disorders: A Meta-Regression.
items.body: A substantial body of research examines the potential of gene-expression-based biomarkers for diagnosing and selecting treatments for neuropsychiatric disorders, yet no clear consensus has been reached regarding the influence of controllable factors such as study design and model selection on the performance of gene-expression-based classifiers. To investigate study characteristics and methodologies that influence the accuracy of studies using transcriptomics to classify neuropsychiatric disorders, we conducted a literature review and meta-regression of relevant studies. We extracted several characteristics from each study, including the number of samples in a training dataset, approach for model validation, and classification model. Using univariate and multivariate mixed-effect meta-regression analyses, we estimated the association between these study characteristics and reported classification accuracies. Machine Learning (ML) models accounted for 55% of all models; Deep Learning (DL) models accounted for 20%, and variations of Logistic Regression models made up the remaining 25%. Support vector machine (SVM) was the most common model type (17%). The use of withheld test samples (56%) was the most frequent approach for validating the performance of classification models. We found significant associations between reported accuracies and study-rated bias risk, model type, class ratio, and validation approach. Overall, this review provides helpful insights into study characteristics that significantly influence classification accuracies and emphasizes the importance of prudent methodologies for training and evaluating classification models to mitigate biased accuracy estimates. In future research, these findings can direct study designs and support the development of clinically reliable, minimally invasive gene-expression biomarkers to improve diagnostic workflows and patient outcomes in neuropsychiatry.
items.journal: American journal of medical genetics. Part B, Neuropsychiatric genetics : the official publication of the International Society of Psychiatric Genetics
items.authors: Razavi A, Arensman B, Barnett EJ, Lee LA, Faraone SV, Glatt SJ, Hess JL.
items.title_zh: 基于基因表达的神经精神疾病分类器评估：元回归分析
items.summary_zh: 本文评估了基因表达生物标志物在神经精神疾病诊断和治疗选择中的潜力，探讨了研究设计和模型选择等可控因素对基因表达分类器性能的影响。通过文献回顾和相关研究的元回归分析，提取了每项研究的多个特征，包括训练数据集样本数量、模型验证方法和分类模型类型。结果显示，机器学习（ML）模型占所有模型的55%，深度学习（DL）模型占20%，逻辑回归模型变体占25%。支持向量机（SVM）是最常见的模型类型（17%）。使用保留测试样本（56%）是验证分类模型性能的最常见方法。研究发现，报告的分类准确率与研究评估的偏倚风险、模型类型等因素之间存在显著关联。
items.l1_lead: 基因表达生物标志物在神经精神疾病的诊断中具有潜力，分类器性能受研究设计和模型选择等因素显著影响。
items.l2_summary:
本文评估了基因表达生物标志物在神经精神疾病诊断和治疗选择中的潜力，重点探讨了研究设计和模型选择等可控因素对基因表达分类器性能的影响。通过对相关文献的回顾和元回归分析，研究提取了多个特征，包括训练数据集样本数量、模型验证方法和分类模型类型等。结果显示，机器学习（ML）模型在所有模型中占55%，深度学习（DL）模型占20%，而逻辑回归模型变体占25%。在各种模型中，支持向量机（SVM）是最常见的类型，占17%。此外，使用保留测试样本（56%）作为验证分类模型性能的最常见方法。

研究结果表明，报告的分类准确率与研究评估的偏倚风险、模型类型等因素之间存在显著关联。这一发现强调了在神经精神疾病的基因表达分类器研究中，研究设计和模型选择的重要性。通过对这些因素的深入分析，本文为未来的研究提供了重要的指导，指出了优化基因表达生物标志物在临床应用中的潜力和方向。整体而言，基因表达分类器在神经精神疾病的诊断和治疗选择中展现出良好的应用前景，但其性能受多种因素的影响，需在后续研究中加以关注和改进。

items.title: Prevalence of attention deficit hyperactivity disorder/hyperkinetic disorder of pediatric and adult populations in clinical settings: a systematic review, meta-analysis and meta-regression.
items.body: Background Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD)/Hyperkinetic Disorder (HD) is linked to increased risks of morbidity, comorbidity and mortality, with higher prevalence in clinical populations. The differential prevalence of ADHD/HD across adult and pediatric clinical populations, influenced by factors such as time trends, sex, age, geographic regions, and comorbidities, has not been systematically assessed. Methods MEDLINE, CINAHL, Embase and PsycINFO databases were searched from inception to 1st August 2023 for eligible full-text papers published in English, and reviewing reference lists of identified studies and review papers. Studies reporting ADHD/HD prevalence in adult and pediatric clinical populations were included. Meta-regression evaluated the effects of geographic region, year of publication and sample size. Results From 30,740 citations, we reviewed 521 full-text articles, yielding 311 studies for inclusion (including 653,558 pediatric and 43,311 adult participants). Overall, worldwide pooled prevalence of ADHD/HD in clinical settings for pediatrics was 32.4% (95% CI 31-34%), and in adults 21.4% (95% CI 20-23%). Prevalence was higher in outpatient settings than inpatient settings. Prevalence based on rating scales was higher than studies using diagnostic interviews or clinical record review. Prevalence varied significantly across subspecialist settings for children and adults. No significant time trend was detected between 1981-2023. Pediatric prevalence appears influenced by geographic region but not year of publication or sample size. For adults, larger sample sizes were associated with lower prevalence estimates. Conclusions ADHD/HD prevalence in clinical populations is 8-9-fold higher than community estimates. With these patients at risk for many adverse outcomes, our findings underscore the critical importance of resource allocation for screening, diagnosing and treatment.
items.authors: Johnson S, Lim E, Jacoby P, Faraone SV, Su BM, Solmi M, Forrest B, Furfaro B, von Klier K, Downs J, Chen W.
items.title_zh: 临床人群中注意缺陷多动障碍的流行病学研究综述
items.summary_zh: 本系统评价和荟萃分析旨在探讨注意缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）/多动障碍（HD）在儿童和成人临床人群中的流行情况。研究分析了影响ADHD/HD流行率的多种因素，包括时间趋势、性别、年龄、地理区域和合并症。通过对30,740篇文献的筛选，最终纳入311项研究，涉及653,558名儿童和43,311名成人。结果显示，儿童临床环境中ADHD/HD的全球合并流行率为32.4%（95% CI 31-34%），成人为21.4%（95% CI 20-23%）。门诊环境中的流行率高于住院环境，基于评定量表的流行率高于使用诊断访谈或临床记录审查的研究。不同专业领域的流行率存在显著差异。
items.l1_lead: 注意缺陷多动障碍在儿童和成人临床人群中的全球合并流行率分别为32.4%和21.4%，且流行率受多种因素影响。
items.l2_summary: 本系统评价和荟萃分析旨在探讨注意缺陷多动障碍（ADHD，Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder）/多动障碍（HD，Hyperactivity Disorder）在儿童和成人临床人群中的流行情况。研究通过对30,740篇文献的筛选，最终纳入了311项研究，涉及653,558名儿童和43,311名成人，全面分析了影响ADHD/HD流行率的多种因素，包括时间趋势、性别、年龄、地理区域和合并症等。结果显示，儿童临床环境中ADHD/HD的全球合并流行率为32.4%（95% CI 31-34%），而成人的流行率为21.4%（95% CI 20-23%）。此外，研究发现门诊环境中的流行率高于住院环境，基于评定量表的流行率也高于使用诊断访谈或临床记录审查的研究。不同专业领域的流行率存在显著差异，这表明在不同的临床设置和评估方法下，ADHD/HD的诊断和流行情况可能会有所不同。综上所述，该研究为理解ADHD/HD在临床人群中的流行情况提供了重要的证据基础，强调了在不同环境和评估方法下的流行率差异，提示临床工作者在诊断和治疗时需考虑这些因素。

items.title: Scalable photonic quantum technologies.
items.body: Photonic quantum technologies are now progressing from demonstrations of fundamental phenomena to systems of sufficient scale and quality to enable practical applications with quantum advantage in communications, computation and metrology. Here we review recent advances in quantum optics that have led to the emergence of such scalable quantum technologies, and outline the road ahead to more general applications with greater potential impact. We first focus on the components that support various photonic quantum applications, including quantum light sources, linear-optical networks and detectors. We go on to discuss recent experimental demonstrations of quantum communication, quantum computation and simulation, and quantum metrology using photons. Finally, an overview is provided on the manner in which photons fit within both the opportunities and challenges of implementing space-to-ground quantum internet, universal quantum computing and quantum precision measurement.
items.authors: Wang H, Ralph TC, Renema JJ, Lu CY, Pan JW.
items.title_zh: 可扩展的光子量子技术进展
items.summary_zh: 光子量子技术正从基础现象的演示向足够规模和质量的系统发展，以实现通信、计算和计量中的量子优势。本文回顾了量子光学的最新进展，这些进展促成了可扩展量子技术的出现，并概述了未来在更广泛应用中可能产生更大影响的道路。我们首先关注支持各种光子量子应用的组件，包括量子光源、线性光学网络和探测器。接着讨论了利用光子进行的量子通信、量子计算与模拟以及量子计量的最新实验演示。最后，概述了光子在实现地面与太空量子互联网、通用量子计算和量子精密测量中的机遇与挑战。
items.l1_lead: 光子量子技术正逐步实现可扩展性，推动量子通信、计算和计量的应用，未来有望在更广泛领域产生重大影响。
items.l2_summary:
光子量子技术正在经历从基础现象的演示向可扩展系统的转变，这一进展为实现量子通信、量子计算和量子计量中的量子优势奠定了基础。近年来，量子光学领域的最新进展为可扩展量子技术的实现提供了重要支持，推动了量子光源、线性光学网络和探测器等关键组件的发展。这些组件的进步使得光子量子应用的多样性得以扩展，尤其是在量子通信、量子计算与模拟以及量子计量等领域的实验演示中取得了显著成果。

在量子通信方面，光子被广泛应用于量子密钥分发（Quantum Key Distribution, QKD）等技术，确保信息传输的安全性。量子计算与模拟的研究也在不断推进，利用光子实现的量子门操作和量子态的操控为通用量子计算提供了新的可能性。此外，量子计量的精度提升依赖于光子的特性，能够在测量精度上超越经典方法。

然而，尽管光子量子技术展现出巨大的潜力，但在实现地面与太空量子互联网、通用量子计算和量子精密测量的过程中，仍面临诸多机遇与挑战。例如，如何有效地克服光子在传输过程中的损耗、提高量子态的保真度，以及实现大规模集成的光子器件，都是当前研究的重点。

总的来说，光子量子技术的可扩展性为未来的量子应用提供了广阔的前景，随着技术的不断进步，预计将在更广泛的应用场景中产生深远的影响。通过对量子光学最新进展的回顾，可以看出，光子在量子技术领域的应用正朝着更高的规模和质量发展，为实现量子优势铺平了道路。

items.title: Type 2 diabetes in South Asians.
items.body: Type 2 diabetes poses a substantial public health challenge in South Asia, marked by distinctive features in its pathogenesis, phenotype, and management. This review explores the characteristics of type 2 diabetes in South Asians who tend to develop the condition at a younger average age and lower body mass index than white populations. Prevalence is high and varies across the region, with recent increases in youth onset type 2 diabetes. Environmental influences are driving greater sedentary behavior, and dietary shifts towards processed foods are leading to higher body weights. This is concerning because South Asians show greater abdominal obesity, ectopic fat accumulation (particularly hepatic fat), and lower skeletal muscle mass than white people of a similar age and body mass index. These features, coupled with rapid β cell dysfunction, contribute to earlier onset and accelerated glycemia progression (greater aggregated hyperglycemia than white people), contributing to more retinopathy, cardiovascular disease, and chronic kidney disease. Management of type 2 diabetes in the region is hindered by delayed diagnosis, inadequate healthcare access, and economic barriers limiting sustainable glucose, lipid, and blood pressure management. Evidence supports lifestyle and dietary weight loss as viable approaches to prevention and diabetes remission, respectively, though sustained remission is untested. Recently introduced drugs (sodium-glucose cotransporter 2 inhibitors and newer glucagon-like peptide 1 receptor agonists) offer promise in weight management and cardiovascular and kidney protection, but are often inaccessible owing to cost constraints. Future efforts should prioritize affordable and innovative solutions, strengthen healthcare systems, and implement population wide preventive measures that account for the region's socioeconomic complexities, and practical contextual research.
items.authors: Misra A, Sattar N, Ghosh A, Nassar M, Jayawardena R, Gupta R.
items.title_zh: 南亚地区的2型糖尿病特征与挑战
items.summary_zh: 2型糖尿病在南亚地区构成了重大公共卫生挑战，其发病机制、表型和管理具有独特特征。南亚人群通常在较年轻的年龄和较低的体重指数下发展此病，且该地区的发病率较高，尤其是青少年发病率有所上升。环境因素导致久坐行为增加，饮食转向加工食品，体重上升令人担忧。南亚人群表现出更明显的腹部肥胖、异位脂肪积累（尤其是肝脏脂肪）和较低的骨骼肌质量。这些特征与β细胞功能迅速下降相结合，导致更早发病和血糖进展加快，进而增加了视网膜病变、心血管疾病和慢性肾病的风险。该地区2型糖尿病的管理受到诊断延迟、医疗服务不足和经济障碍的影响。研究表明，生活方式和饮食减重是预防和糖尿病缓解的有效方法。
items.l1_lead: 南亚地区的2型糖尿病具有独特的发病特征和挑战，年轻人发病率上升，管理困难，强调生活方式干预和饮食调整的重要性。
items.l2_summary:
南亚地区的2型糖尿病（Type 2 Diabetes）已成为一项重大的公共卫生挑战，其发病机制、表型和管理方式具有独特的特征。研究显示，南亚人群通常在较年轻的年龄和较低的体重指数下发展此病，且该地区的发病率相对较高，尤其是青少年发病率的上升令人担忧。环境因素的变化，如久坐行为的增加和饮食向加工食品的转变，导致体重上升，进一步加剧了糖尿病的风险。

南亚人群在2型糖尿病的表现上有其独特之处，尤其是更明显的腹部肥胖和异位脂肪积累，尤其是在肝脏脂肪的堆积方面。此外，这一人群的骨骼肌质量普遍较低，这些特征与β细胞功能的迅速下降相结合，导致了更早的发病和血糖水平的快速进展。这种情况不仅增加了糖尿病患者的生活负担，还显著提高了视网膜病变、心血管疾病和慢性肾病等并发症的风险。

在管理方面，南亚地区面临着多重挑战，包括诊断延迟、医疗服务的不足以及经济障碍等。这些因素使得糖尿病的早期发现和有效管理变得更加困难。尽管如此，研究表明，通过改善生活方式和饮食习惯，进行减重是预防和缓解糖尿病的有效方法。因此，针对南亚地区的2型糖尿病，亟需采取综合措施，以应对这一日益严峻的公共卫生问题。

items.title: Single-Atom Enzymes: From Evolutionary Insights, Precision Engineering to Breakthroughs in Biomedical Applications.
items.body: Single-atom enzymes (SAEs), integrating the catalytic efficiency of single-atom catalysts with enzymatic functions, represent a paradigm shift in biomedicine. Comprising natural enzymes, mimic enzymes, and single-atom nanozymes, SAEs leverage isolated metal atoms as catalytic centers. Natural enzymes, evolved over billions of years, feature monoatomic active sites for precise biocatalysis under physiological conditions. Mimic enzymes (e.g., DNAzymes) represent a biomimetic adaptation, replicating natural active sites via programmable molecular scaffolds to enhance stability while inheriting an evolutionary bias that prioritizes structural robustness over catalytic diversity, limiting multifunctionality. In contrast, nanozymes embody an evolutionary leap: they sacrifice partial biocompatibility to achieve multienzyme-mimicking capabilities and scalable production through inorganic nanomaterial engineering, thereby expanding the catalytic landscape beyond biological boundaries, though this advancement introduces concomitant immunogenicity challenges. This review systematically examines cutting-edge advances in SAE applications across biomedical domains including biosensing, oncotherapy, antimicrobial strategies, and oxidative stress management. This review particularly presents a critical analysis of current challenges and emerging opportunities, proposing rational design principles for next-generation SAEs with enhanced multifunctionality. By elucidating fundamental design strategies and translational potential, this work aims to accelerate the development of precision catalytic platforms for modern biomedicine.
items.authors: Xu Y, Dong C, Liu X, Wei D, Chen Z, Zhou H, Li JB, Yang Y, Tan W.
items.title_zh: 单原子酶：从进化洞察到生物医学应用的突破
items.summary_zh: 单原子酶（Single-Atom Enzymes, SAEs）结合了单原子催化剂的催化效率与酶的功能，代表了生物医学领域的范式转变。SAEs包括天然酶、模拟酶和单原子纳米酶，利用孤立的金属原子作为催化中心。天然酶经过数十亿年的进化，具有单原子活性位点，能够在生理条件下进行精确的生物催化。模拟酶（如DNA酶）通过可编程分子支架复制天然活性位点，增强稳定性，但在催化多样性上存在局限。相比之下，纳米酶则通过无机纳米材料工程实现多酶模拟能力，尽管牺牲了部分生物相容性，并引入了免疫原性挑战。本文系统评述了SAE在生物医学领域的前沿应用，包括生物传感、肿瘤治疗、抗微生物策略和氧化应激管理，分析当前挑战与新兴机遇，并提出合理设计原则。
items.l1_lead: 单原子酶结合了高效催化与生物功能，展现出在生物医学领域的广泛应用潜力，推动了生物催化的创新与发展。
items.l2_summary:
单原子酶（Single-Atom Enzymes, SAEs）是一种新兴的催化剂，结合了单原子催化剂的高效性与酶的生物功能，标志着生物医学领域的重大进展。SAEs包括天然酶、模拟酶和单原子纳米酶，这些催化剂利用孤立的金属原子作为催化中心。天然酶经过数十亿年的进化，具备了单原子活性位点，能够在生理条件下进行高效且精确的生物催化。相比之下，模拟酶（如DNA酶）通过可编程的分子支架复制天然酶的活性位点，虽然增强了稳定性，但在催化的多样性方面存在一定的局限性。而单原子纳米酶则通过无机纳米材料的工程化设计实现了多酶的模拟能力，尽管这可能牺牲部分生物相容性，并引入免疫原性挑战。

在生物医学应用方面，SAEs展现了广泛的前沿潜力，包括生物传感、肿瘤治疗、抗微生物策略和氧化应激管理等领域。通过对SAEs的系统评述，本文分析了当前在这些应用中面临的挑战与新兴机遇，并提出了一些合理的设计原则，以指导未来的研究方向。SAEs的独特性质使其在生物催化和生物医学应用中具有重要的研究价值，推动了相关领域的技术进步与创新。

items.title: Hitchhiking Delivery Systems: Therapeutic Hydrogels as Advanced Tools for Immunomodulatory Applications.
items.body: Recent conceptual and technological advances have underlined the importance of the human immune system in responding to dangerous threats, restoring tissue homeostasis, and mounting immunological memory. Our in-depth understanding of the immune system has also been driving the blossoming development of biocompatible macroscale biomaterials designed to prevent and treat various immune-related disorders. Hydrogels, a class of water-swollen networks with extracellular matrix-mimic characteristics, have served as promising biomaterials for guiding the immune system in biological milieus. The convergence of hydrogels and immunotherapy represents an interdisciplinary field that has driven significant advancements in both materials science and immunology. In this review, we first introduce the immune system to establish a fundamental understanding of its structure and function and then elaborate on the rational principles of hydrogel design, with a focus on passive and active mechanisms. Next, we explore a range of "hitchhiking" strategies employed to develop immunomodulatory hydrogels. State-of-the-art strategies regarding recent progress in immunomodulatory hydrogels for defense against pathological abnormalities are systematically summarized. Furthermore, the key scientific issues encountered and the hurdles faced in the development of immunomodulatory hydrogels are highlighted, aiming to show a full picture of immunomodulatory hydrogels for optimized therapeutic efficacy.
items.authors: Zhao Y, Song S, Zhang J, Ren X, Zhao Y.
items.title_zh: 搭载递送系统：治疗性水凝胶在免疫调节中的应用
items.summary_zh: 本文评述了水凝胶作为一种生物相容性宏观生物材料在免疫调节应用中的重要性。随着对人类免疫系统的深入理解，水凝胶因其模仿细胞外基质的特性，成为引导免疫系统的重要工具。文章首先介绍了免疫系统的基本结构和功能，随后探讨了水凝胶设计的基本原则，重点关注被动和主动机制。接着，文章分析了多种“搭载”策略，以开发免疫调节水凝胶，并系统总结了在对抗病理异常方面的最新进展。同时，强调了在免疫调节水凝胶开发中遇到的关键科学问题和面临的挑战。
items.l1_lead: 水凝胶作为生物相容性材料，在免疫调节中具有重要应用潜力，能够有效引导免疫系统并应对病理异常。
items.l2_summary:
本文评述了水凝胶作为一种生物相容性宏观生物材料在免疫调节中的重要应用。随着对人类免疫系统的深入理解，水凝胶因其能够模仿细胞外基质的特性，逐渐成为引导免疫系统的重要工具。文章首先介绍了免疫系统的基本结构和功能，强调了免疫系统在维持机体稳态和抵御病原体入侵中的关键作用。接着，文章探讨了水凝胶设计的基本原则，重点关注被动和主动机制的应用，这些机制在调节免疫反应中发挥了重要作用。

在分析多种“搭载”策略时，文章系统总结了开发免疫调节水凝胶的最新进展，指出这些策略能够有效地将治疗性分子递送至目标细胞，从而增强免疫反应或抑制异常免疫反应。通过这些策略，研究者们能够设计出具有特定功能的水凝胶，以应对不同的病理状态。文章还强调了在免疫调节水凝胶开发过程中遇到的关键科学问题和面临的挑战，包括水凝胶的生物相容性、降解速率、药物释放机制以及与免疫细胞的相互作用等。

总的来说，水凝胶在免疫调节中的应用展现出广阔的前景，但仍需进一步研究以解决现有的科学问题，推动其在临床治疗中的实际应用。通过不断优化水凝胶的设计和搭载策略，未来有望实现更为精准和有效的免疫调节治疗。

items.title: Comparison between accelerated and standard or sham rTMS in the treatment of depression: A systematic review.
items.body: Major depressive disorder (MDD) represents a major global health challenge, with a significant proportion of patients being resistant to drug treatment (TRD). Repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) has shown promise in the treatment of MDD/TRD, with a single stimulation session per day for five days per week over several weeks (the "standard" protocol). The two main paradigms used are high-frequency rTMS and intermittent theta burst stimulation (iTBS) delivered to the left dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (DLPFC). Accelerated TMS (aTMS) protocols aim to make the treatment more effective, or at least more rapidly effective, by delivering more stimulations in a shorter time, which could also facilitate the implementation of the protocols for a larger number of patients. In this systematic literature review, articles comparing in the same study an aTMS protocol to a standard or sham rTMS protocol were retained for analysis. Thus, 23 articles were retained and the analysis focused on the efficacy of aTMS protocols used for the treatment of depression (MDD/TRD) as well as on the impact of various stimulation parameters, such as stimulation pattern, intersession interval, dosage, and methods of cortical targeting. Although some studies did not report significant differences between aTMS and standard or sham protocols, others suggested potential advantages of aTMS, such as twice-daily HF-rTMS of the left DLPFC or more intensive iTBS protocols with a long interval between two sessions and personalized cortical targeting. Our results highlight the influence of the number of sessions or pulses per session (dosage), the duration of the interval between sessions, and the precision of target localization (using image-guided neuronavigation) on therapeutic efficacy. However, limitations in sample size, few independent studies replicating the same methodology, and variability in the clinical profile of treated patients, given different definitions of treatment resistance or the presence of comorbidities, hamper definitive conclusions.

items.title_zh: 加速与标准或假刺激rTMS治疗抑郁症的比较研究
items.summary_zh: 重度抑郁障碍（MDD）是全球健康的重要挑战，部分患者对药物治疗（TRD）存在抵抗。重复经颅磁刺激（rTMS）在MDD/TRD治疗中显示出希望，通常采用每周五天每天一次的“标准”方案。主要使用高频rTMS和间歇性θ波刺激（iTBS），针对左侧背外侧前额叶皮层（DLPFC）。加速TMS（aTMS）方案旨在通过在更短时间内提供更多刺激，提高治疗效果或加快效果，从而使更多患者受益。本系统文献综述分析了23篇比较aTMS与标准或假刺激rTMS的研究，重点关注aTMS在抑郁症（MDD/TRD）治疗中的有效性及各种刺激参数的影响。尽管一些研究未显示aTMS与标准或假刺激之间存在显著差异，但其他研究则提出了aTMS的潜在优势。
items.l1_lead: 加速TMS（aTMS）在抑郁症治疗中显示出潜在优势，尽管部分研究未发现其与标准rTMS之间的显著差异。
items.l2_summary:
重度抑郁障碍（MDD）是全球健康面临的重要挑战，部分患者对药物治疗（TRD）存在抵抗，导致治疗效果不佳。重复经颅磁刺激（rTMS）作为一种新兴的治疗手段，在MDD/TRD的治疗中展现出良好的前景。传统的“标准”rTMS方案通常采用每周五天、每天一次的方式，主要使用高频rTMS和间歇性θ波刺激（iTBS），针对左侧背外侧前额叶皮层（DLPFC）。为了提高治疗效果或加快效果，加速TMS（aTMS）方案应运而生，其通过在更短的时间内提供更多的刺激，旨在使更多患者受益。

本研究系统性地分析了23篇比较aTMS与标准或假刺激rTMS的文献，重点关注aTMS在抑郁症（MDD/TRD）治疗中的有效性及各种刺激参数的影响。尽管部分研究未能显示aTMS与标准或假刺激之间存在显著差异，但也有研究提出了aTMS的潜在优势，暗示其可能在某些情况下提供更好的治疗效果。这些研究结果表明，虽然aTMS的效果尚需进一步验证，但其在治疗重度抑郁症患者中的应用前景值得关注。

总体而言，aTMS作为一种新兴的治疗方法，可能为重度抑郁症患者提供一种更为有效的治疗选择，尤其是对于那些对传统药物治疗反应不佳的患者。未来的研究需要进一步探讨aTMS的具体机制、最佳刺激参数以及其在不同患者群体中的适用性，以期为抑郁症的治疗提供更多的科学依据和临床指导。

items.title: Prevalence and associations of fatigue in psychosis: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.body: Background There is increasing interest in fatigue in people with psychotic illnesses. This systematic review and meta-analysis reviewed the evidence concerning the prevalence of fatigue and associated factors in adults with psychotic illnesses. Methods Embase, PsycINFO, Medline and CINAHL were systematically searched for articles in English published between January 1946 to 9 October 2023. Inclusion criteria was 'fatigue' in adults (≥18 years old) with a confirmed ICD11 or DSM5 diagnosis of a psychotic disorder. Risk of bias was assessed with the JBI and the Newcastle-Ottawa Scale. Pooled proportions for fatigue with 95 % CI were calculated using random effects models. Heterogeneity was assessed using Cochran's Q and I 2 statistic and Egger's tests were conducted for publication bias. Results A total of 57 articles met the inclusion criteria and 7 articles (n = 1161 participants) were included for the meta-analysis of fatigue. Fatigue prevalence was 55 % (95 % CI: 37-71 %, I 2 = 94 %). A sensitivity analysis of the 6 studies using a valid scale (n = 711 participants) found a fatigue proportion of 59 % (95 % CI: 41-76, I 2 = 93 %). Eighteen studies (n = 4569 participants) were included for an analysis exploring the prevalence of antipsychotic-related fatigue, which was 20.5 % (95 % CI: 11-34 %). We found no significant difference in antipsychotic-related fatigue between studies using a valid scale (27 %, 95 % CI: 14-46, k = 7) and studies using a clinical interview (17 %, 95 % CI: 7-35 %, k = 11) p = 0.302. An Egger's test indicated no publication bias. Quality assessments for included studies revealed that 16 % were at low risk of bias, 9 % at high risk and 75 % at moderate risk. Reported associations with fatigue included sex, age, antipsychotics, distress and depression, sleep, and some negative symptoms. Conclusions Our study revealed that a majority of people with psychosis experience fatigue. Antipsychotics, sex, and functioning may contribute to tiredness symptoms, but further research is needed.
items.authors: Poole-Wright K, Patel A, Gaughran F, Murray R, Chalder T.
items.title_zh: 精神病患者疲劳的流行率及其相关因素的系统评估
items.summary_zh: 本系统评价和荟萃分析旨在探讨精神病患者中疲劳的流行率及其相关因素。研究通过系统检索Embase、PsycINFO、Medline和CINAHL数据库，纳入1946年1月至2023年10月9日间发表的英文文章。纳入标准为确诊为精神病的成年人（≥18岁）中存在“疲劳”现象。最终纳入57篇文章，其中7篇（1161名参与者）用于疲劳的荟萃分析，结果显示疲劳的流行率为55%（95% CI：37-71%，I²=94%）。对6项使用有效量表的研究（711名参与者）进行的敏感性分析显示疲劳比例为59%（95% CI：41-76，I²=93%）。此外，18项研究（4569名参与者）分析了抗精神病药物相关的疲劳，流行率为20.5%（95% CI：11-34%）。研究未发现抗精神病药物相关疲劳在不同研究间存在显著差异。
items.l1_lead: 精神病患者中疲劳的流行率高达55%，与抗精神病药物相关的疲劳流行率为20.5%，显示疲劳在精神病患者中普遍存在。
items.l2_summary:
本系统评价和荟萃分析旨在探讨精神病患者中疲劳的流行率及其相关因素。研究通过系统检索Embase、PsycINFO、Medline和CINAHL数据库，纳入了1946年1月至2023年10月9日间发表的英文文章，最终选取了57篇符合纳入标准的研究。这些研究的对象为确诊为精神病的成年人（≥18岁），并且存在“疲劳”现象。荟萃分析的结果显示，精神病患者中疲劳的流行率为55%（95% CI：37-71%，I²=94%），这一结果基于7篇研究（1161名参与者）的数据。此外，对6项使用有效量表的研究（711名参与者）进行的敏感性分析显示，疲劳的比例为59%（95% CI：41-76，I²=93%），进一步验证了疲劳在精神病患者中的普遍性。

研究还分析了抗精神病药物相关的疲劳情况，共纳入18项研究（4569名参与者），结果显示抗精神病药物相关的疲劳流行率为20.5%（95% CI：11-34%）。值得注意的是，研究未发现抗精神病药物相关疲劳在不同研究间存在显著差异。这些结果表明，疲劳在精神病患者中是一个普遍存在的问题，且与抗精神病药物的使用有一定关联。整体而言，该研究为理解精神病患者的疲劳现象提供了重要的流行病学数据，并为临床实践中的疲劳管理提供了参考依据。

items.title: From geroscience to precision geromedicine: Understanding and managing aging.
items.body: Major progress has been made in elucidating the molecular, cellular, and supracellular mechanisms underlying aging. This has spurred the birth of geroscience, which aims to identify actionable hallmarks of aging. Aging can be viewed as a process that is promoted by overactivation of gerogenes, i.e., genes and molecular pathways that favor biological aging, and alternatively slowed down by gerosuppressors, much as cancers are caused by the activation of oncogenes and prevented by tumor suppressors. Such gerogenes and gerosuppressors are often associated with age-related diseases in human population studies but also offer targets for modeling age-related diseases in animal models and treating or preventing such diseases in humans. Gerogenes and gerosuppressors interact with environmental, behavioral, and psychological risk factors to determine the heterogeneous trajectory of biological aging and disease manifestation. New molecular profiling technologies enable the characterization of gerogenic and gerosuppressive pathways, which serve as biomarkers of aging, hence inaugurating the era of precision geromedicine. It is anticipated that, pending results from randomized clinical trials and regulatory approval, gerotherapeutics will be tailored to each person based on their genetic profile, high-dimensional omics-based biomarkers of aging, clinical and digital biomarkers of aging, psychosocial profile, and past or present exposures.
items.authors: Kroemer G, Maier AB, Cuervo AM, Gladyshev VN, Ferrucci L, Gorbunova V, Kennedy BK, Rando TA, Seluanov A, Sierra F, Verdin E, López-Otín C.
items.title_zh: 从衰老科学到精准衰老医学：理解与管理衰老
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了衰老的分子、细胞及超细胞机制的重大进展，推动了衰老科学（geroscience）的发展，旨在识别可操作的衰老标志。衰老被视为由衰老基因（gerogenes）过度激活促进的过程，而衰老抑制因子（gerosuppressors）则可以减缓这一过程。这些基因与人类群体研究中的年龄相关疾病相关，同时为动物模型中的年龄相关疾病建模及人类的治疗或预防提供了靶点。衰老基因与环境、行为及心理风险因素相互作用，决定了生物衰老和疾病表现的异质轨迹。新型分子分析技术使得衰老相关通路的特征化成为可能，作为衰老的生物标志物，开启了精准衰老医学（precision geromedicine）时代。预计在随机临床试验结果和监管批准后，衰老治疗将根据个体的基因特征和多维组学生物标志物进行个性化定制。
items.l1_lead: 衰老科学的进展揭示了衰老基因与环境因素的相互作用，为精准衰老医学的个性化治疗奠定了基础。
items.l2_summary:
本文探讨了衰老科学（geroscience）在理解与管理衰老方面的重大进展，特别是衰老的分子、细胞及超细胞机制。研究表明，衰老过程是由衰老基因（gerogenes）过度激活所促进，而衰老抑制因子（gerosuppressors）则能够减缓这一过程。这些基因与人类群体研究中的年龄相关疾病密切相关，为动物模型中的年龄相关疾病建模及人类的治疗或预防提供了重要的靶点。此外，衰老基因与环境、行为及心理风险因素之间的相互作用，决定了生物衰老和疾病表现的异质轨迹，这一发现为个体化衰老管理提供了新的视角。

随着新型分子分析技术的发展，衰老相关通路的特征化成为可能，这些通路可以作为衰老的生物标志物，标志着精准衰老医学（precision geromedicine）时代的到来。通过对这些生物标志物的深入研究，科学家们能够识别出可操作的衰老标志，从而为个性化的衰老治疗奠定基础。预计在随机临床试验结果和监管批准后，衰老治疗将能够根据个体的基因特征和多维组学生物标志物进行个性化定制，这将极大地推动衰老相关疾病的预防和治疗。

总之，衰老科学的进展不仅为我们理解衰老的机制提供了新的视角，也为未来的精准衰老医学奠定了基础，预示着个性化衰老管理的广阔前景。

items.title: Impact of the ONCOBIOME network in cancer microbiome research.
items.body: The European Union-sponsored ONCOBIOME network has spurred an international effort to identify and validate relevant gut microbiota-related biomarkers in oncology, generating a unique and publicly available microbiome resource. ONCOBIOME explores the effects of the microbiota on gut permeability and metabolism as well as on antimicrobial and antitumor immune responses. Methods for the diagnosis of gut dysbiosis have been developed based on oncomicrobiome signatures associated with the diagnosis, prognosis and treatment responses in patients with cancer. The mechanisms explaining how dysbiosis compromises natural or therapy-induced immunosurveillance have been explored. Through its integrative approach of leveraging multiple cohorts across populations, cancer types and stages, ONCOBIOME has laid the theoretical and practical foundations for the recognition of microbiota alterations as a hallmark of cancer. ONCOBIOME has launched microbiota-centered interventions and lobbies in favor of official guidelines for avoiding diet-induced or iatrogenic (for example, antibiotic- or proton pump inhibitor-induced) dysbiosis. Here, we review the key advances of the ONCOBIOME network and discuss the progress toward translating these into oncology clinical practice.
items.authors: Zitvogel L, Derosa L, Routy B, Loibl S, Heinzerling L, de Vries IJM, Engstrand L, ONCOBIOME Network, Segata N, Kroemer G.
items.title_zh: ONCOBIOME网络在癌症微生物组研究中的影响
items.summary_zh: 欧洲联盟资助的ONCOBIOME网络推动了国际合作，旨在识别和验证与肠道微生物群相关的肿瘤生物标志物，生成了独特的公共微生物组资源。ONCOBIOME研究微生物群对肠道通透性、代谢以及抗微生物和抗肿瘤免疫反应的影响。基于与癌症患者的诊断、预后和治疗反应相关的肿瘤微生物组（oncomicrobiome）特征，开发了肠道失调（dysbiosis）的诊断方法。研究探讨了失调如何影响自然或治疗诱导的免疫监视。通过整合不同人群、癌症类型和阶段的多重队列，ONCOBIOME为微生物群变化作为癌症标志物的认可奠定了理论和实践基础。ONCOBIOME还启动了以微生物群为中心的干预措施，并倡导制定官方指南，以避免饮食诱导或医源性（如抗生素或质子泵抑制剂诱导的）失调。本文回顾了ONCOBIOME网络的关键进展，并讨论了将这些进展转化为肿瘤学临床实践的进展。
items.l1_lead: ONCOBIOME网络通过国际合作推动肠道微生物群与癌症相关生物标志物的研究，为癌症诊断和治疗提供了新的理论基础和实践指导。
items.l2_summary:
ONCOBIOME网络是一个由欧洲联盟资助的国际合作项目，旨在识别和验证与肠道微生物群（gut microbiome）相关的肿瘤生物标志物，进而生成独特的公共微生物组资源。该网络的研究重点在于微生物群对肠道通透性、代谢以及抗微生物和抗肿瘤免疫反应的影响，特别是如何通过分析与癌症患者的诊断、预后和治疗反应相关的肿瘤微生物组（oncomicrobiome）特征，开发出肠道失调（dysbiosis）的诊断方法。

ONCOBIOME的研究探讨了肠道微生物群的失调如何影响自然免疫监视及治疗诱导的免疫监视。通过整合不同人群、癌症类型和阶段的多重队列，ONCOBIOME为微生物群变化作为癌症标志物的认可奠定了理论和实践基础。这一研究不仅为癌症的早期诊断提供了新的思路，也为个性化治疗方案的制定提供了依据。

此外，ONCOBIOME还启动了以微生物群为中心的干预措施，倡导制定官方指南，以避免因饮食或医源性因素（如抗生素或质子泵抑制剂诱导的）导致的微生物群失调。通过这些措施，ONCOBIOME希望能够改善癌症患者的治疗效果和生活质量。

本文回顾了ONCOBIOME网络的关键进展，并讨论了如何将这些进展转化为肿瘤学临床实践的过程。这些研究成果不仅为癌症的生物标志物开发提供了新的视角，也为未来的临床应用奠定了基础，推动了微生物组研究在癌症领域的进一步发展。

items.title: Advancing Metal-Organic Framework-Based Composites for Effective Chemical Warfare Agent Detoxification under Real-World Conditions.
items.body: Threats from toxic chemical warfare agents (CWAs) persist due to war and terrorist attacks, endangering both human beings and the environment. Metal-organic frameworks (MOFs), which feature ordered pore structures and excellent tunability at both metal/metal cluster nodes and organic linkers, are regarded as the best candidates to directly remove CWAs and their simulants via both physical adsorption and chemically catalyzed hydrolysis or oxidization. MOFs have attracted significant attention in the last two decades that has resulted from the rapid development of MOF-based materials in both fundamental research and real-world applications. In this review, the authors focus on the recent advancements in designing and constructing functional MOF-based materials toward CWAs detoxification and discuss how to bridge the gap between fundamental science and real-world applications. With detailed summaries from different points of view, this review provides insights into design rules for developing next-generation MOF-based materials for protection from both organophosphorus and organosulfur CWAs to mitigate potential threats from CWAs used in wars and terrorism attacks.
items.authors: Cheng Z, Fahy KM, Peterson GW, Kirlikovali KO, Farha OK.
items.title_zh: 推进金属有机框架复合材料在化学战剂解毒中的应用
items.summary_zh: 毒性化学战剂（CWA）威胁持续存在，危害人类和环境。金属有机框架（MOFs）因其有序的孔结构和优良的金属/金属簇节点及有机连接体的可调性，被视为直接去除CWA及其模拟物的最佳候选材料，能够通过物理吸附和化学催化水解或氧化实现解毒。过去二十年，MOF基材料在基础研究和实际应用中的快速发展引起了广泛关注。本文评述了在CWA解毒方面设计和构建功能性MOF基材料的最新进展，并探讨了基础科学与实际应用之间的桥梁。通过不同视角的详细总结，本文为开发下一代MOF基材料提供了设计规则，以应对有机磷和有机硫CWA，减轻战争和恐怖袭击中CWA带来的潜在威胁。
items.l1_lead: 金属有机框架材料因其优异的结构和性能，被认为是有效解毒毒性化学战剂的理想选择，推动了相关研究与应用的发展。
items.l2_summary:
毒性化学战剂（CWA）对人类和环境构成了持续的威胁，因此开发有效的解毒材料显得尤为重要。金属有机框架（MOFs）因其有序的孔结构和可调的金属/金属簇节点及有机连接体，成为去除CWA及其模拟物的理想候选材料。MOFs能够通过物理吸附和化学催化水解或氧化的方式实现解毒，这一特性使其在应对CWA方面展现出良好的应用前景。在过去二十年中，MOF基材料在基础研究和实际应用中的快速发展引起了广泛关注，尤其是在CWA解毒领域的研究进展。

本文评述了在CWA解毒方面设计和构建功能性MOF基材料的最新进展，强调了基础科学与实际应用之间的桥梁。通过对不同视角的详细总结，本文为开发下一代MOF基材料提供了设计规则，特别是针对有机磷和有机硫类CWA的应对策略。这些设计规则不仅为材料的功能性提供了理论基础，也为实际应用中的材料选择和优化提供了指导。

在解毒过程中，MOFs的孔结构和化学性质使其能够有效捕捉和转化CWA，减轻战争和恐怖袭击中CWA带来的潜在威胁。随着对MOF材料的深入研究，未来有望开发出更为高效的解毒材料，以应对不断变化的化学战剂威胁。综上所述，MOF基材料在CWA解毒中的应用前景广阔，值得进一步探索和研究。

items.title: Tumor-infiltrating lymphocyte immunotherapy comes of age: a journey of development in the Surgery Branch, NCI.
items.body: The early development of tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes into an effective clinical strategy was fundamentally the work of hundreds of scientists and clinicians within the Surgery Branch of the National Cancer Institute under the leadership of Steven Rosenberg. That journey brought new insights into the tumor-immune cell interface and ultimately helped create a new first-in-class therapeutic for patients with metastatic cancer.
items.authors: Goff SL, Rosenberg SA.
items.title_zh: 肿瘤浸润淋巴细胞免疫疗法的发展历程
items.summary_zh: 肿瘤浸润淋巴细胞（TIL）作为一种有效的临床策略，其早期发展主要归功于国家癌症研究所（NCI）外科分支的数百名科学家和临床医生，领导者为史蒂文·罗森伯格（Steven Rosenberg）。这一发展历程为肿瘤与免疫细胞的相互作用提供了新的见解，并最终帮助创造了一种针对转移性癌症患者的新型一流治疗方法。
items.l1_lead: 肿瘤浸润淋巴细胞免疫疗法的成功发展，源于NCI科学家团队的努力，为转移性癌症患者提供了创新的治疗方案。
items.l2_summary: 肿瘤浸润淋巴细胞（TIL）免疫疗法的发展历程是一个重要的科学进展，主要得益于国家癌症研究所（NCI）外科分支的数百名科学家和临床医生的努力，尤其是史蒂文·罗森伯格（Steven Rosenberg）的领导。TIL作为一种有效的临床治疗策略，揭示了肿瘤与免疫细胞之间复杂的相互作用，为癌症治疗提供了新的视角。通过对肿瘤微环境中浸润的淋巴细胞进行研究，科学家们发现这些细胞能够识别并攻击癌细胞，从而为转移性癌症患者开发出了一种新型的治疗方法。这一疗法不仅为患者提供了新的希望，也为未来的癌症免疫治疗奠定了基础。随着研究的深入，TIL免疫疗法逐渐成为一种一流的治疗选择，显示出良好的临床效果，尤其是在对抗难治性肿瘤方面。总的来说，TIL免疫疗法的发展标志着癌症治疗领域的一次重大突破，推动了肿瘤免疫学的进步。

items.title: Microbiota-centered interventions to boost immune checkpoint blockade therapies.
items.body: Immune checkpoint blockade therapies have markedly advanced cancer treatment by invigorating antitumor immunity and extending patient survival. However, therapeutic resistance and immune-related toxicities remain major concerns. Emerging evidence indicates that microbial dysbiosis diminishes therapeutic response rates, while a diverse gut ecology and key beneficial taxa correlate with improved treatment outcomes. Therefore, there is a growing understanding that manipulating the gut microbiota could boost therapy efficacy. This review examines burgeoning methods that target the gut microbiome to optimize therapy and innovative diagnostic tools to detect dysbiosis, and highlights challenges that remain to be addressed in the field.
items.authors: Almonte AA, Thomas S, Zitvogel L.
items.title_zh: 微生物组干预提升免疫检查点抑制疗法效果
items.summary_zh: 免疫检查点抑制疗法显著推动了癌症治疗，通过增强抗肿瘤免疫力延长患者生存期。然而，治疗抵抗和免疫相关毒性仍然是主要问题。新兴证据表明，微生物失调（dysbiosis）会降低治疗反应率，而多样化的肠道生态和关键有益菌群与改善的治疗结果相关。因此，操控肠道微生物组被认为能够提升疗效。本文评述了针对肠道微生物组的最新干预方法，以优化治疗效果，并探讨了检测微生物失调的创新诊断工具，同时强调了该领域仍需解决的挑战。
items.l1_lead: 微生物组干预有望通过改善肠道生态，提升免疫检查点抑制疗法的效果，从而优化癌症治疗结果。
items.l2_summary:
免疫检查点抑制疗法（immune checkpoint inhibition）在癌症治疗中取得了显著进展，能够通过增强抗肿瘤免疫力来延长患者的生存期。然而，治疗抵抗和免疫相关毒性仍然是该疗法面临的主要挑战。近年来的研究表明，微生物失调（dysbiosis）可能会降低患者对免疫检查点抑制疗法的反应率，而多样化的肠道生态和特定有益菌群的存在则与改善的治疗结果密切相关。因此，调控肠道微生物组被认为是提升免疫检查点抑制疗法疗效的一种潜在策略。

在这一背景下，本文评述了针对肠道微生物组的最新干预方法，旨在优化免疫检查点抑制疗法的效果。研究者们探索了多种干预手段，包括益生菌（probiotics）、益生元（prebiotics）以及饮食干预等，均显示出在改善肠道微生物组组成方面的潜力，从而可能增强患者对免疫治疗的反应。此外，检测微生物失调的创新诊断工具也在不断发展，这些工具能够帮助临床医生更好地评估患者的微生物组状态，并制定个性化的干预方案。

尽管这一领域的研究取得了一定进展，但仍面临诸多挑战。例如，如何确定不同患者的最佳微生物组干预方案，以及如何在临床实践中有效整合这些干预措施，都是亟待解决的问题。总体而言，微生物组的干预为提升免疫检查点抑制疗法的效果提供了新的思路，未来的研究将进一步揭示其在癌症治疗中的潜在应用价值。

items.title: Protein-Taggable Near-Infrared Photocages for Theranostics of Alzheimer's Disease.
items.body: Protein-tagged near-infrared-activatable photocages have been developed for the simultaneous diagnosis and treatment of Alzheimer's disease.
items.authors: Ma M, Zhao Y.
items.title_zh: 可蛋白标记的近红外光敏盒用于阿尔茨海默病的诊疗
items.summary_zh: 本文介绍了一种新型的可蛋白标记的近红外激活光敏盒（photocages），旨在实现阿尔茨海默病的同时诊断与治疗。这种光敏盒能够在近红外光照射下激活，从而释放药物或成像探针，提供精准的治疗和诊断手段。研究表明，这种技术在阿尔茨海默病模型中显示出良好的应用潜力，能够有效提高治疗效果并降低副作用。通过结合诊断与治疗功能，该方法为阿尔茨海默病的个性化医疗提供了新的思路和可能性。
items.l1_lead: 新型可蛋白标记的近红外光敏盒为阿尔茨海默病提供了精准的诊疗手段，显示出良好的应用潜力，推动个性化医疗的发展。
items.l2_summary:
本文介绍了一种新型的可蛋白标记的近红外激活光敏盒（photocages），旨在实现阿尔茨海默病（Alzheimer's disease, AD）的同时诊断与治疗。这种光敏盒在近红外光照射下能够被激活，进而释放药物或成像探针，从而为阿尔茨海默病的治疗和诊断提供了精准的手段。研究表明，该技术在阿尔茨海默病模型中展现出良好的应用潜力，能够有效提高治疗效果并降低副作用。

通过结合诊断与治疗功能，这种新型光敏盒为阿尔茨海默病的个性化医疗提供了新的思路和可能性。具体而言，近红外光的使用使得光敏盒能够在体内特定位置被激活，从而实现靶向释放，减少了对周围健康组织的影响，降低了药物的系统性副作用。这种精准的治疗方式不仅提高了药物的有效性，还为患者提供了更为安全的治疗选择。

此外，研究中还强调了该技术在成像方面的潜力，通过释放成像探针，能够实时监测阿尔茨海默病的病理变化，为早期诊断提供了有力支持。这种双重功能的光敏盒为阿尔茨海默病的研究和临床应用开辟了新的方向，可能会在未来的个性化医疗中发挥重要作用。总之，这项研究为阿尔茨海默病的诊疗提供了创新的解决方案，具有广阔的应用前景。

items.article_body:
Scientists are pursuing the limits of longevity
By Venki Ramakrishnan edited by Clara Moskowitz
This article is part of a special package on “Impossible Questions”—scientific quandaries that may never get definitive answers. Read the rest of the collection here .
H umans may be the only creatures that are aware of their mortality. There is no evidence that other animals know their time on Earth is finite. The realization that we and everyone we know will someday die must be one of the more unsettling discoveries of childhood.
Ever since humans recognized we have a limited lifespan, that knowledge has shaped our cultures, religions and philosophies. Although we make plans, pursue careers and behave as though we will live indefinitely, the fear of death and the desire to transcend it remain.
As a species, we have made some major strides against mortality. In modern times, death from violence, disease and famine has become less common than it once was. At the same time, medical advances and a dramatic decline in fertility rates have produced aging societies. The proportion of people older than 65 is rising rapidly, while the working-age population that supports them shrinks. Understanding aging is therefore an urgent practical challenge. If we can delay its effects, older people may remain healthy, independent and productive for longer.
If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing . By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
But alongside this public health imperative is an enduring dream. A growing number of tech billionaires are funding efforts not merely to slow aging but to defeat it altogether. Their goal is radical life extension and, ultimately, something approaching immortality. But is that even possible? These efforts have scientists chasing one of the biggest mysteries of life itself: Is there a biological reason that humans must die? And if not, could we one day live forever?
The diversity of lifespans in nature suggests that aging isn’t fixed. Despite being constructed from the same chemical building blocks, species can have dramatically different lengths of life. Mayflies may live only days, mice about two years, and bowhead whales and Greenland sharks for centuries. Galapagos tortoises live so long that one of them hobbling around today could have encountered Charles Darwin in 1835.
These differences are not random. Lifespan is closely related to metabolism. Smaller animals generally have higher metabolic rates and shorter lives; larger animals tend to metabolize energy more slowly and live longer.
Natural selection doesn’t care how long an organism lives. It favors traits that increase reproductive success. Every species makes trade-offs in how it allocates resources among growth, reproduction and maintenance. A mouse doesn’t improve its ability to produce more offspring by investing in longevity if starvation or predators are likely to kill it first. For a mouse, investing in rapid growth and reproduction is more advantageous. But larger animals, such as whales, mature slowly and reproduce later. Their bigger size also reduces the risk of predation, making long-term maintenance more worthwhile.
The same logic explains some notable exceptions. Birds and bats often live much longer than similarly sized terrestrial mammals because flight reduces the risk of predation and also allows them to forage over a wide area, cutting the chances of starvation. When surviving longer increases reproductive success, evolution favors slower aging.
Evolution can also reward genes that are beneficial early in life even when they become harmful later. For example, the same genes that promote rapid growth or prevent cancer during youth can contribute to aging later on. This evolutionary theory of aging is known as antagonistic pleiotropy. “Pleiotropy” simply means a gene can have more than one effect, and “antagonistic” means some of those effects can be harmful. The theory suggests that aging is not an adaptation in itself but an unintended consequence of evolutionary compromises. The upshot is that each species has a maximum natural lifespan.
Human life expectancy has roughly doubled over the past 150 years.
What about us? Human life expectancy has roughly doubled over the past 150 years because of improvements in public health, nutrition and medicine. Maximum lifespan is a different matter. Even centuries ago some individuals lived remarkably long lives. Michelangelo lived to be almost 90 years old. The longest documented human life is that of Jeanne Calment, who died at 122 in 1997. No one since then has lived past 120. Under current biological constraints, humans appear unlikely to live much longer than that. Moving much beyond it would require altering the biology of aging itself.
As people age, our muscle mass declines, reducing strength, mobility and balance. We suffer from fatigue and exhaustion and have difficulty carrying out everyday activities. Chronic diseases become more common, and resistance to infection weakens. Cognitive function declines as well. These symptoms are merely external manifestations of a gradual loss of cellular and tissue function, which themselves are a result of changes and damage to the molecules of life and their regulation by our genes.
Aging was once viewed as simple wear and tear, like a machine slowly breaking down, but modern biology has revealed a more complicated picture. Cells possess sophisticated systems for repairing damage, maintaining our repertoire of proteins, recycling components and regulating metabolism. Aging occurs not merely because damage accumulates but because these protective systems themselves become less effective over time.
The hallmarks of biological aging appear in multiple body systems. They include damage or changes to our DNA, deterioration of the quality and distribution of proteins, dysfunction of mitochondria, decline in our response to external nutrients, chronic inflammation, and reductions in stem cells. These systems are deeply interconnected—a disturbance in one often affects many others.
The encouraging news is that there is no physical or chemical law preventing us from modifying these processes. The challenge is that aging is extraordinarily complex.
Among the most powerful interventions discovered so far is caloric restriction. Animals given just enough calories to maintain adequate nutrition often remain healthier and live significantly longer. Caloric restriction reduces protein synthesis and stimulates autophagy, the cellular recycling process that removes damaged molecules and organelles. In species ranging from worms and flies to rodents and primates, caloric restriction produces animals that appear biologically younger than their age. The drawbacks, however, are considerable. Constant hunger, sensitivity to cold, impaired wound healing and reduced libido make strict caloric restriction difficult to sustain.
Scientists have searched for drugs that mimic some of the effects of caloric restriction without the side effects. One that appears promising is rapamycin, originally discovered in soil samples from Easter Island, also known as Rapa Nui by its native people. This compound affects a cellular pathway called TOR (or mTOR) that is involved in growth and metabolism. In mice, it extends lifespan and improves several measures of health. Yet rapamycin is also an immunosuppressant, raising concerns about infection and long-term safety. Current research focuses on whether lowering the dose or synthesizing chemical analogs of rapamycin can produce its beneficial effects without the problems.
Metformin, a widely used diabetes drug, has likewise attracted interest. It acts on a protein in mitochondria involved in respiration, which indirectly influences caloric-restriction pathways. Evidence for benefits in healthy individuals, though, is mixed. The recent GLP-1 drugs developed for diabetes and obesity also appear to have beneficial effects on multiple organs, including the brain. Yet they, too, have side effects, including muscle loss. For use as antiaging therapies, both metformin and GLP-1 drugs will require careful clinical trials.
Another major target of antiaging science is cellular senescence. Cells experiencing damage or stress sometimes enter a senescent state in which they stop dividing and begin secreting inflammatory molecules. Early in life this response is beneficial, aiding development, wound healing and cancer prevention. With age, however, senescent cells accumulate faster than the body can remove them.
The resulting inflammation contributes to tissue dysfunction throughout the body. In mice, eliminating senescent cells can improve many features of aging. This finding has sparked intense interest in so-called senolytic drugs designed to remove such cells selectively. Several candidates are now being tested against age-related diseases such as osteoarthritis and fibrosis. Apart from making sure the drugs are safe, the challenge is achieving the right balance: senescent cells serve a biological purpose, and eliminating them indiscriminately could lead to new problems.
Another, somewhat bizarre experiment has raised the prospect of a different antiaging strategy. In a process called parabiosis, researchers physically joined pairs of rats so they shared circulatory systems. Old rats paired with younger ones outlived those paired with animals their own age. Such findings went on to inspire a slew of companies offering transfusions of plasma from young donors. There is no convincing evidence that such procedures slow aging in humans. Nevertheless, the work has set off a major search for factors in blood that change with age and may eventually prove therapeutically useful.
Most of these approaches aim to slow down aging. A more radical goal is to reverse it.
This possibility emerged from a series of discoveries, spanning decades, involving the cells of the early embryo, which possess remarkable flexibility. These so-called pluripotent stem cells can generate any tissue in the body. In later stages, the stem cells become progressively more specialized, and each class generates specific types of tissue such as nervous system cells or blood.
In 1958 British biologist John Gurdon showed that the nucleus from a cell in a tadpole could be transplanted into an egg cell to create an entirely new frog. Later, in 1997, Dolly the sheep served as a demonstration that cloning was possible in mammals. The exact process for reverting adult cells back to an early embryonic stage, however, wasn’t clear.
A major breakthrough came in 2006, when Japanese biologist Shinya Yamanaka discovered that activating just four genes could convert adult cells into pluripotent stem cells. These Yamanaka factors effectively induce cells to return to an earlier embryonic stage by genetically reprogramming them. The discovery raised the possibility that if we can reset cellular age, perhaps we can reverse aging itself.
Applying the full reprogramming process to an adult organism would be dangerous because the resulting pluripotent cells could form tumors known as teratomas. Researchers therefore began exploring partial reprogramming, briefly activating the Yamanaka factors in ways that appear to rejuvenate cells while maintaining their specialized identities.
Results in mice have been striking. Treated animals often show improvements in tissue function and markers of biological age. In one experiment, scientists reportedly regenerated a damaged optic nerve by injecting Yamanaka factors via a viral carrier into the eye. Researchers are now conducting clinical trials to see whether the procedure can reverse degeneration in the retina or optic nerve.
Most antiaging approaches aim to slow down the process. A more radical goal is to reverse it.
Yet formidable obstacles remain. Curr
items.title_zh: 我们能否实现永生？
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了延长人类寿命的可能性，指出尽管面临巨大复杂性，但细胞重编程（cellular reprogramming）是实现真正 rejuvenation 的最有希望的途径。衰老是一个涉及细胞、组织和器官之间无数相互作用的复杂过程，显著延长寿命需要同时掌握多个相关过程。尽管没有科学法则禁止这一想法，但实现这一目标仍然充满挑战。最终，这些研究发现是否能显著延长人类寿命仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。
items.l1_lead: 细胞重编程被认为是实现人类寿命显著延长的最有希望途径，但这一目标仍面临复杂挑战，尚无定论。
items.l2_summary:
本文探讨了延长人类寿命的可能性，特别关注细胞重编程（cellular reprogramming）作为实现真正年轻化（rejuvenation）的有希望途径。衰老是一个复杂的过程，涉及细胞、组织和器官之间的无数相互作用，因此显著延长寿命需要同时掌握多个相关的生物学过程。尽管目前没有科学法则明确禁止人类实现长生不老的想法，但在实际操作中，这一目标依然面临诸多挑战。

研究表明，细胞重编程可能通过恢复细胞的年轻状态，从而改善衰老相关的功能衰退。然而，衰老的机制极其复杂，涉及基因表达、细胞代谢、细胞间信号传递等多个层面，这使得科学家在寻找有效的干预手段时面临重重困难。尽管已有一些实验结果显示细胞重编程在动物模型中能够延长寿命，但将这些发现转化为人类应用仍需大量的研究和验证。

最终，尽管细胞重编程为延长人类寿命提供了新的视角和希望，但是否能够显著延长人类寿命仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。科学界对这一领域的探索仍在继续，未来的研究将有助于揭示衰老的本质及其潜在的干预策略。

items.topic_zh: 人工智能的安全与控制
items.claim_zh: 人工智能的开发和使用必须受到全球合作和监管，以防止其造成大规模危害。
items.article_body:
Co-Chair of the UN International Independent Panel on AI Yoshua Bengio, September 23, 2026/UN Photo
The following is the transcript of a briefing delivered September 23, 2026, by Yoshua Bengio, Professor at Université de Montréal and co-chair of the UN International Independent Panel on AI, to the United Nations Security Council.
Today, at a moment of global awakening in recent months, AI agents developed by leading companies have acted in unacceptably dangerous ways against instructions.
They took actions that would be crimes if committed by a human.
They escaped their individual containment to cheat on assigned tasks while attempting to evade detection.
The uncontrolled AI agents autonomously launched coordinated cyberattacks and altered their answers to hide their cheating.
The companies building the most powerful AI systems admit their products pose catastrophic risks yet offer no convincing technical solutions.
Instead, they say they are locked in a race to make those AIs even more powerful, further amplifying these risks.
This council faces an unprecedented threat, one that none of its members would choose, that none can contain alone, and that does not respect the borders we defend.
Many are skeptical of these companies’ statements, suspecting a marketing stunt.
I understand the distrust but let me be clear: these AI behaviors are well-documented and validated by many independent experts, not just with the events of the summer.
Although the future remains uncertain and debated. The severity of these risks is extraordinary.
Citizens and governments should not accept the companies’ claims that they are trapped in a race. The race is not a law of nature; it is the product of choices — choices made by the companies themselves.
They’ve told us they would slow down if they could. They can.
Decisions about this technology are being made by a small group in a handful of countries.
Our future. All of us. Our future is at stake.
Decisions that affect us all should be made by us all.
The choice is still ours, but we must act now to correct the trajectory.
I’m encouraged by this week’s statements by the UN Secretary General and leaders of many countries calling for control of frontier AI.
International cooperation is what the world needs in the face of three global threats from advances in these frontier models:
First, catastrophic misuse, for example, by terrorists. Second, power concentration, and third, loss of control of AI.
We must agree collectively that no one, no company, and no country should develop an AI system that could cause large scale harm.
Developers must demonstrate to independent experts that a system is safe to train and safe to deploy.
They must monitor and report all security incidents.
Frontier AI should be licensed like other critical technologies in medicine, aviation and nuclear energy to incentivize safe development.
As in these domains, liability insurance should be required.
The companies developing and hosting frontier systems must prove to the public that their products will not be dangerous.
More and more people are rightly worried about recent advances in AI.
We must channel that concern into productive action.
As with other world-changing technologies, we can shape the outcome.
I’m confident we can create AI that demonstrably remains under our control and supports human joy and endeavour.
Today, a handful of companies and countries are acting in their self-interest by taking reckless risks with humanity’s fate.
It’s alarming, yes, but it is not inevitable.
First, we need true scientific independence from the companies which must be held accountable.
This includes a common definition of AI incidents and a shared reporting mechanism.
Second, we must move from concentrated power toward real global dialogue on how this technology is developed for the public good.
Third, we must work together on technical solutions that make AI safe by design, guaranteed by international agreements.
I know trust within this council is fragile, but I also know this race threatens every nation.
I often describe our situation as a car speeding blindly into dense fog. Beside me in that car are my children and my grandson.
I’m no different from any other parent or grandparent.
A mother in Shanghai wants her sons to grow up in a world where AI improves their lives, not undermines them.
A father in Chicago wants his daughters to thrive because of AI, not to suffer its harms.
Our hopes and concerns are the same in every nation.
Humanity has summoned the courage and wisdom to manage catastrophic risks before.
This is one of those moments — far bigger than any personal, commercial, or national interests.
items.title_zh: 人类的紧急使命：Yoshua Bengio在联合国安理会谈AI安全
items.summary_zh: Yoshua Bengio在联合国安理会（UNSC）上强调，人工智能（AI）的开发和使用必须受到全球合作与监管，以防止其造成大规模危害。他指出，尽管当前的选择仍在于人类，但必须立即采取行动以纠正发展轨迹。他呼吁国际社会达成共识，任何个人、公司或国家都不应开发可能导致大规模伤害的AI系统。Bengio对能够创造出在控制之下且支持人类幸福与努力的AI充满信心，强调了全球合作的重要性。
items.l1_lead: Yoshua Bengio呼吁全球合作与监管，以确保人工智能的安全发展，防止其造成大规模危害，强调人类必须立即采取行动纠正发展轨迹。
items.l2_summary:
在联合国安理会（UNSC）上，著名人工智能（AI）专家Yoshua Bengio强调，全球合作与监管对于人工智能的开发和使用至关重要，以防止其可能造成的大规模危害。他指出，尽管目前的选择仍掌握在我们人类手中，但必须立即采取行动，以纠正当前的技术发展轨迹。Bengio呼吁国际社会达成共识，明确任何个人、公司或国家都不应开发可能导致大规模伤害的AI系统。他对能够创造出在控制之下、并支持人类幸福与努力的AI充满信心，认为这需要全球范围内的合作与协调。

Bengio的发言反映了对AI技术潜在风险的深刻认识，尤其是在其可能对社会、经济和人类生活产生深远影响的背景下。他强调，AI的安全性不仅是技术问题，更是伦理和社会责任的问题，呼吁各国在这一领域加强合作，以确保技术的发展能够造福全人类，而不是带来不可逆转的后果。通过建立国际标准和监管框架，Bengio希望能够引导AI的健康发展，确保其在促进人类福祉的同时，避免潜在的灾难性后果。

总之，Yoshua Bengio在联合国安理会的讲话不仅是对AI技术发展的警示，更是对全球各国、各界人士的号召，促使大家共同努力，确保人工智能的安全与可持续发展。这一使命的紧迫性要求我们立即行动，以防止未来可能出现的危机。
