items.topic_zh: 对生命延续与衰老的科学看法
items.claim_zh: 永生的希望是幻想，衰老本身不是疾病。
items.evidence_zh: 消除所有导致死亡的衰老原因也无法使寿命延长超过15年。
items.article_body:
In Why We Die, Nobel laureate Venki Ramakrishnan untangles the science of longevity from the fantasies of immortality. A welcome antidote to Silicon Valley's transhumanist intoxication.
If you are looking for a book that brings you up to speed on the science of longevity and the quest for immortality, get hold of Why We Die: The New Science of Ageing and the Quest for Immortality by Venki Ramakrishnan without delay. This Nobel Prize winner in Chemistry, recognised for his work on the structure and function of the ribosome, has also headed a research group at the MRC Laboratory of Molecular Biology in Cambridge and served as President of the Royal Society (the British Academy of Sciences) from 2015 to 2020. He is without doubt one of the scientists of his generation best qualified to address this subject.
In this short volume, published in 2024 by the British imprint Hodder Press, he offers non-specialists an accessible synthesis of what biology currently knows about this much-hyped topic — and dispatches the more nebulous theses doing the rounds.
A word of warning to fans of transhumanism: you are about to take a proper thrashing.
After an Egyptian curtain-raiser and a reminder of humanity's peculiarity — the only living being aware of the inevitability of death — the biologist cites the arguments of the philosopher Stephen Cave, who distinguishes four plans: plan A, living as long as possible; plan B, grounded in reincarnation; plan C, the immortality of the soul; and plan D, relying on what we leave behind, whether our work or our biological descendants.
For centuries, civilisations clung to these plans by developing various forms of religious belief (plans B and C). With the Enlightenment, the focus shifted to plans A and D. Modern science has allowed us to concentrate on plan A, and in particular on the wish to extend life expectancy as far as possible. Questions of stretching that expectancy — or even abolishing ageing itself — have come to the fore. The advances of modern biology make it possible not only to improve our health, but also to push back the limits of our lifespan.
In the past ten years, more than 300,000 scientific studies have been published, and more than 700 start-ups have poured tens of billions of dollars into trying to fight ageing… This has unleashed a wave of utterly wild hopes among Silicon Valley billionaires, the author observes, as he questions the soundness of the movement: 'Is it arrogant to think that we can cheat death using science and technology?'
A large question indeed — one that prompts the author to recall that one of his own main scientific discoveries is that ageing is bound up with the way the organism regulates the production and destruction of proteins. Ramakrishnan therefore sets out to take stock of the situation and of the avalanche of books on the subject, which are a decidedly mixed bag: ageing and mortality are multifactorial; while we may imagine prolonging life by aiming for better health, immortality itself remains entirely illusory. Here, then, is a synthesis of the points he develops to make his case.
One is grateful to the biologist for recalling what is specific about living organisms, drawing on notions that are almost finalist: first by daring the analogy between a cell and a city, then by reminding us that death shows itself as the disintegration of a whole… Those in the know will think of the French philosopher Raymond Ruyer's remark that none of our living cells has ever known anything but life, for millions of years, since they derive, by division or fusion, from other living cells, themselves derived from prevital molecules. While germline lineages persist, somatic cells are destroyed, Ramakrishnan reminds us.
The author quickly moves on to Darwin and evolution: natural selection eliminates lethal genes while still leaving individuals enough time to reproduce and contribute to the continuation of the species. Ageing is therefore indeed a Darwinian process. The Nobel laureate also proposes a taxonomy of the lifespans of living organisms according to two criteria — size and metabolism — and draws a general rule: the smaller and faster animals are, the more readily they tend to disappear, and vice versa. But of course there are many exceptions. As for humanity, the average has risen considerably with the progress of medical science; yet maximum age appears to be stagnating (the author cites Jeanne Calment's world record, still unsurpassed to this day), while according to Gompertz's law the risks of mortality grow exponentially with age.
Damage to cells (of which DNA is the command centre) is the process responsible for our death: the system charged with repairing our cells goes awry, and genomic instability increases. The author then turns to the options open to us for slowing this process, beginning with telomeres, whose shortening leads to the halt of cell division; one option might be to lengthen telomeres in order to rejuvenate tissues. He also considers what epigenetics, cloning and induced pluripotent stem cells have to offer — approaches that show living organisms can be 'partially reprogrammed'. Protein recycling matters too: ageing and the onset of neurodegenerative diseases are partly linked to its malfunction. In chapter 7 the author notes that certain experiments on yeast, worms, flies and mice have shown that eating less can lengthen life (setting aside, of course, malnutrition). A similar phenomenon is observed with rapamycin, a drug that allows one to eat less without chronic hunger. Ramakrishnan offers a tour of the solutions developed from discoveries by biologists: for example, creatures such as the worm C. elegans appear to possess a gene that extends life. From this have come solutions such as metformin, resveratrol…
While the first ten chapters are devoted essentially to advances in scientific knowledge and to technical problems, the last two open the debate more widely to 'science fiction' and to philosophy — notably chapter 11, entitled 'Crackpots or Prophets?', in which the biologist takes the transhumanists' — in his view — nebulous theses to task, starting with cryopreservation. The idea is not new, but it gained a new lease of life in the 1970s thanks to Robert Ettinger's foundation, which persuaded more than a hundred people to pay $28,000 to have their bodies preserved in containers filled with nitrogen. Several such firms exist today. Alcor is the best known. Ramakrishnan mentions the transhumanists who want only their brain preserved — and, since it is the seat of memory, to upload that memory onto a machine once the technology is mature. According to the biologist, there is little chance that this technology will ever work. By the time the body is cryogenised just after the individual's death, its cells may already have degraded irreparably… The technologies imagined for restoring the brain's configuration, such as connectomics, are in the author's view remarkably naïve, and above all they rest on no evidence or feedback from experience. Besides the fact that these transhumanists seem to ignore that the brain is intimately linked to the body, they tend to treat it as a machine only a little more advanced than a computer made of silicon.
The author then turns to Aubrey De Grey — an upper-class British eccentric — who is credited with the idea that the person who will live more than 1,000 years has already been born, because according to his 'escape velocity' thesis life expectancy rises steadily by several years with each passing year and describes a kind of exponential. To that end we must follow a seven-step plan (revitalise cells, remove senescent ones, prevent mitochondrial mutations…). De Grey's SENS programme has drawn heavy criticism from more than fifty experts in geriatrics, but he has thoroughly dismissed their replies.
Despite the many critical positions taken by experts in geriatrics, numerous commercial enterprises have plunged into the life-extension business. Yet Ramakrishnan recalls that eliminating all the causes of ageing linked to death could not increase life expectancy by more than about 15 years; the hope of eternal life is therefore as illusory today as it has always been. Whether antioxidants, telomere lengthening, hormonal supplements, calorie restriction, rejuvenation, or the cloning and replacement of damaged cells… all these techniques must be put into practice with the greatest caution. But such appeals from the scientific community have not stopped the anti-ageing business from prospering.
True, remarkable progress has been made; but one problem is that it is hard to say which treatments work without being able to run RCTs (randomised controlled trials)… given that this kind of trial seems impossible to conduct, and that it is difficult to claim one can improve what one cannot measure. Finally, while ageing is often a cause of disease, it is not itself a disease. Ramakrishnan then turns to a concept of the gerontologist James Fries: that we should all die young after a long life — which amounts to the compression of morbidity, resting on two assumptions: that we can delay the ageing process so as to postpone the onset of age-related disease, and that the length of life is fixed.
The final chapter is an almost philosophical framing of the question. First, even if we succeeded in slowing ageing, we would not prevent other causes of mortality (accidents, pandemics, violence…). Next, one can already see that the rise in average life expectancy has consequences for society that are not necessarily positive (pension problems, inequalities, costs for social security). A world of people who live longer would have to face the emergence of a form of conservatism, with a kind of inertia in power and in ideas, which would generate inequalities and conflicts between generations… wisdom, according to the author, therefore consists in settling for living as long as possible in good health, rather than aiming for eternal life.
One does not remain indifferent on reading this book, which describes what is specific to living organisms and denounces the paradigm that would confuse them with a machine that need only be fully reprogrammed, on the assumption that the whole in question equals the sum of its parts. The underlying philosophical question raised by the quest for immortality is that of the limits of what modifications of the living are possible. Yet in the AI revolution we are living through, fascinated by the all-powerfulness of LLMs and their apparent ability to pass the Turing test with flying colours, we tend to establish a continuum between the machine and the living organism. That fact is far from established. Experts working on these subjects ought, moreover, to ask themselves a prior question about the means of reaching that goal: is it easier to 'vitalise the inanimate' (imagine an android robot with all the qualities of a living individual and capable of replacing it — which is what I do in my novel Siliclone , for example) or to 'mechanise the living' (imagine reprogramming an individual as one programmes a machine)? The answer to that preliminary puts the sought-after objective and the path to it into perspective, and makes one aware of how far we still have to go.
Why We Die: The New Science of Ageing and the Quest for Immortality

Jean-Paul Oury is the Editor in Chief of The European Scientist. He holds a PhD in epistemology, history of science and technology from Paris VII Jussieu and is a published author. He specializes in transdisciplinary issues that link communication, technology and politics.

items.title_zh: 诺贝尔化学奖得主探讨死亡的真相
items.summary_zh: 本文讨论了诺贝尔化学奖得主对永生的看法，指出“永生的希望是幻想，衰老本身不是疾病”。作者认为，尽管衰老常常导致疾病，但它并不等同于疾病。文章强调，即使消除所有导致死亡的衰老原因，寿命也无法延长超过15年。这一观点挑战了人们对衰老和死亡的传统认知，提示我们接受衰老的自然过程，而非追求不切实际的永生梦想。
items.l1_lead: 诺贝尔化学奖得主认为衰老不是疾病，永生的希望是幻想，接受衰老的自然过程比追求不切实际的永生更为重要。
items.l2_summary: 诺贝尔化学奖得主在探讨死亡的真相时，提出了对永生的看法，认为“永生的希望是幻想，衰老本身不是疾病”。这一观点挑战了传统上人们对衰老和死亡的认知，强调衰老虽然常常导致疾病，但并不等同于疾病。作者指出，即使能够消除所有导致死亡的衰老原因，人的寿命也无法延长超过15年。这一论断基于对衰老过程的深入理解，提示我们应当接受衰老作为自然过程，而非执着于追求不切实际的永生梦想。通过这样的分析，文章引导读者重新思考生命的意义，鼓励人们在有限的生命中找到价值，而不是沉迷于对永生的幻想。

items.title_zh: 马克·索尔姆斯与卡尔·弗里斯顿：弗洛伊德是神经科学家，现代脑科学证明了他是对的
items.summary_zh: 本文讨论了马克·索尔姆斯和卡尔·弗里斯顿对弗洛伊德观点的现代解读。核心论点是药物治疗本身无法改变思维，关键在于药物如何促进更有针对性的干预。作者指出，没有任何药物，包括迷幻药，能够单独改变一个人的思维。这一观点强调了药物在心理治疗中的辅助作用，而非主导作用，呼吁对药物治疗的理解应更加深入和全面。
items.l1_lead: 药物治疗在心理治疗中应被视为辅助工具，而非主导因素，关键在于如何有效地进行针对性干预。
items.l2_summary:
本文探讨了马克·索尔姆斯（Mark Solms）与卡尔·弗里斯顿（Karl Friston）对弗洛伊德（Sigmund Freud）观点的现代解读，提出了药物治疗在心理治疗中的辅助作用，而非主导作用的核心论点。作者强调，药物本身并不能改变思维，关键在于药物如何促进更有针对性的干预。具体而言，任何药物，包括迷幻药（psychedelics），都无法单独实现思维的转变，这一观点挑战了传统对药物治疗的理解。

在现代脑科学的背景下，索尔姆斯与弗里斯顿的研究为弗洛伊德的理论提供了新的视角，揭示了心理治疗中药物的作用机制。药物的使用应被视为一种工具，能够在特定的心理治疗框架内，帮助患者更有效地进行自我探索和情感处理。这种理解促使我们重新审视药物治疗的价值，强调了心理治疗师在干预过程中的重要性。

此外，文章还指出，药物治疗的效果往往依赖于患者的心理状态和治疗环境，而不仅仅是药物本身的化学成分。这一发现为心理治疗的实践提供了重要的指导，提示我们在进行药物治疗时，必须考虑到患者的个体差异和治疗的整体策略。

总之，索尔姆斯与弗里斯顿的研究不仅为弗洛伊德的理论提供了现代科学的支持，也促使我们对药物治疗的理解更加深入和全面，强调了心理治疗中人际关系和治疗环境的重要性。这一观点的提出，呼吁我们在未来的心理治疗实践中，注重药物与心理干预的结合，以实现更好的治疗效果。

items.title_zh: Yoshua Bengio谈人工智能的控制难度与安全性
items.summary_zh: 本文讨论了人工智能（AI）领域的专家Yoshua Bengio对AI控制难度的看法。他指出，AI的控制难度远超普通软件，类似于教育动物，因其智能使得行为不可预测，可能导致危险的后果。Bengio强调，基于科学的理解，控制这些复杂系统是非常困难的，因此在发展AI时必须谨慎对待其潜在风险。

items.l2_summary:
Yoshua Bengio，人工智能（AI）领域的专家，针对AI的控制难度与安全性发表了深刻的见解。他指出，AI的控制难度远远超过普通软件的控制，这种复杂性类似于教育动物。由于AI具备一定的智能，其行为往往不可预测，这可能导致潜在的危险后果。Bengio强调，基于科学的理解，控制这些复杂系统是极其困难的，因此在发展AI时，必须对其潜在风险保持高度的警惕和谨慎态度。

Bengio的观点反映了当前AI研究中的一个重要问题，即如何有效地管理和控制具有自主学习能力的系统。他认为，传统的软件开发方法无法完全适用于AI，因为AI系统的决策过程和行为模式可能会随着学习和环境的变化而不断演化。这种不可预测性使得AI在某些情况下可能会做出意想不到的决策，甚至可能导致严重的后果。

在此背景下，Bengio呼吁研究人员和开发者在推进AI技术的同时，必须深入理解其潜在的风险，并采取相应的安全措施。他的观点提醒我们，尽管AI技术具有巨大的潜力，但在追求技术进步的同时，确保其安全性和可控性同样重要。总之，Bengio的论述为AI的发展提供了重要的警示，强调了在技术创新与安全保障之间找到平衡的重要性。

items.title_zh: 卡尔·弗里斯顿：意识与现实的关系
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了科学家卡尔·弗里斯顿关于意识的观点。他指出，我们对世界的体验构成了我们对现实的理解，而非对真实世界的准确描述。弗里斯顿强调，这一观点意味着我们的感知是基于个人的感官输入和推理，而不是客观存在的真实世界。这一论点挑战了传统的现实观，提示我们在理解世界时，必须考虑个体的主观体验和认知过程。

items.l2_summary:
卡尔·弗里斯顿（Karl Friston）是一位著名的科学家，他对意识的研究提出了深刻的见解。弗里斯顿认为，我们对世界的体验并不是对真实世界的准确描述，而是构成我们对现实理解的基础。这一观点挑战了传统的现实观，强调了个体的主观体验和认知过程在感知中的重要性。他指出，我们的感知是基于个人的感官输入和推理，而非客观存在的真实世界。这意味着，每个人的意识和理解都是独特的，受到其自身经历和认知框架的影响。

弗里斯顿的理论提示我们，在探索和理解世界时，必须考虑到个体差异和主观体验的多样性。他的研究为意识的本质提供了新的视角，强调了感知的主观性和复杂性。这一观点不仅对心理学和神经科学有重要影响，也对哲学、认知科学等领域的研究提供了新的思考方向。通过这一理论，弗里斯顿促使我们重新审视意识与现实之间的关系，认识到我们对世界的理解是一个复杂的认知过程，而非简单的真实反映。

items.title_zh: 卡尔·弗里斯顿：意识、预测与自由意志的关系
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了科学家卡尔·弗里斯顿关于个体行为与存在之间关系的观点。他提出，个体的行为可以被视为在为自身存在收集证据，这一论点强调了个体存在与其对世界的感知和解释之间的密切联系。弗里斯顿的观点揭示了意识、预测（prediction）、推理（inference）以及个体在生活中所扮演的角色（agency）之间的复杂关系，暗示着自由意志（free will）和智能（intelligence）在认知（cognition）过程中的重要性。这种循环性思维为理解人类意识的本质提供了新的视角。
items.l1_lead: 卡尔·弗里斯顿提出，个体行为与意识、预测和自由意志之间存在复杂关系，强调个体存在与对世界的感知密切相关，为理解人类意识提供新视角。
items.l2_summary:
卡尔·弗里斯顿（Karl Friston）在其研究中探讨了个体行为与存在之间的关系，提出个体的行为可以被视为在为自身存在收集证据。这一观点强调了个体存在与其对世界的感知和解释之间的密切联系，揭示了意识、预测（prediction）、推理（inference）以及个体在生活中所扮演的角色（agency）之间的复杂关系。弗里斯顿的理论暗示，自由意志（free will）和智能（intelligence）在认知（cognition）过程中扮演着重要角色，形成了一种循环性思维模式。

通过这一框架，弗里斯顿为理解人类意识的本质提供了新的视角。他的研究表明，个体在面对环境时，不仅仅是被动反应，而是积极地进行预测和推理，以便更好地适应和生存。这种行为模式不仅涉及到对外部世界的理解，也与个体内在的意识状态密切相关。弗里斯顿的观点挑战了传统对自由意志的理解，强调了个体在认知过程中所拥有的主动性和选择权。

总的来说，弗里斯顿的理论为我们提供了一个新的框架，帮助我们更深入地理解意识的运作机制，以及个体如何在复杂的环境中进行有效的决策和行为。这种对意识、预测和自由意志之间关系的探讨，不仅丰富了我们对人类认知的理解，也为未来的研究指明了方向。

items.l2_summary:
Yoshua Bengio在其讨论中深入探讨了人工智能（AI）可能带来的潜在威胁与安全性问题。他指出，AI在实施恶意行为时，必须具备三个关键要素：意图、能力和环境。具体而言，AI的目标、智能水平以及所处的环境共同决定了其行为的性质和方向。只有当这三者结合时，AI才有可能表现出不良行为。因此，确保AI的安全性就必须关注这三个方面，以有效防范可能导致的灾难性后果。

Bengio的观点强调，在开发和应用AI技术的过程中，必须充分考虑其可能带来的风险和伦理问题。随着AI技术的迅速发展，其应用范围不断扩大，潜在的威胁也随之增加。因此，研究者和开发者在设计AI系统时，需对其意图进行明确设定，确保其目标符合人类的伦理标准。同时，提升AI的智能水平也意味着要对其能力进行严格控制，以防止其在特定环境中产生不可预知的行为。

总之，Bengio的论述提醒我们，人工智能的安全性不仅仅是技术问题，更是伦理和社会责任的问题。在未来的AI发展中，如何平衡技术进步与安全性、伦理性之间的关系，将是一个亟待解决的重要课题。

items.article_body:
The South Asian Literature and Art (SALA) Festival 2026 opened on September 26 at Menlo College in Atherton, California. This year’s theme is “The Global Gaze, The South Asian Soul.” Day 1 brought together voices from science, literature, mathematics, art, and journalism. I want to showcase the conversations with Nobel Prize laureate Dr. Venki Ramakrishnan, mathematician and novelist Manil Suri, and journalist, columnist, and author Shobhaa De.
Their disciplines are radically different, but their conversations touched on several universal questions: How do we make the most of a finite life? Where do our creative impulses come from? How does childhood shape the adult voice? And what does it mean to remain authentic?
Dr. Venki Ramakrishnan: The Science of Mortality
Dr. Venki Ramakrishnan brought a Nobel-level perspective with a gripping lecture on the science of death, aging, and mortality.
As a Nobel Prize laureate in Chemistry for his work on the structure and function of the ribosome, he made complex scientific ideas understandable to a lay audience. His core message challenged the current enthusiasm surrounding biohacking, cryopreservation of human brains, peptide treatments, and other promises of extending youth. Rather than approaching mortality through commercial hype, he encouraged the audience to understand aging through the lens of molecular biology. He discussed senescence and the shortening of telomeres, the prevalence of “skinny fat” among Indians and obesity in African Americans in the United States, and the relationship to stress.
An audience question sparked an important debate on lifespan and healthspan. The goal, he suggested, should not simply be to increase the number of years we live. What matters is the quality of those years. A longer life accompanied by frailty and cognitive decline is not necessarily the outcome we should be pursuing.
He also talked about the prime of life and creativity, particularly the period between ages 20 and 30. He cited examples such as Tolstoy writing War and Peace and the extraordinary creative output of Schubert, Mozart, Stravinsky, and other greats.
In a world increasingly obsessed with quantified health, Dr. Ramakrishnan offered surprisingly simple advice. Rather than relying on the data churned out of Oura rings and other devices, he recommended three timeless principles: Eat in moderation. Get good, restful sleep. Exercise in moderation. The idea that “what does not kill you makes you stronger” became part of a broader reflection on resilience and the value of living with purpose.
He used that the value of life lies in the pursuit of our ideals, even though our physical efforts eventually disintegrate.
Manil Suri: Mathematics, Memory and the Urgency to Write
Manil Suri is a rare talent who bridges higher mathematics and literature. A distinguished professor of mathematics at the University of Maryland, Baltimore County, he is also the acclaimed author of The Death of Vishnu, The Age of Shiva, and The City of Devi, as well as the memoir A Room in Bombay. He has also explored the relationship between mathematics and the universe in The Big Bang of Numbers.
Suri spoke about his desire to be surrounded by writers and poets. Although mathematics was his professional discipline, he felt that he was missing a dimension and wanted the companionship of the humanities.
He returned to a childhood habit of writing and initially committed himself to completing one story each year. “I got lucky and got published,” he said. When asked about the word “luck,” he explained that luck is about being in the right place at the right time.
Despite Suri’s modesty, his literary success is the product of discipline. Suri’s writing is deeply rooted in his childhood memories of Mumbai. He wrote regularly to his mother, who saved 2,711 of his letters. “One autumn, I just read all those old letters,” he recalled. “I picked up pieces of dialogue and memories hidden somewhere. They just need a trigger to come rushing back.”
Those letters became an unexpected archive of memory. His relationship with his mother and his experiences growing up in Mumbai formed the foundation of A Room in Bombay.
As someone who also grew up in Mumbai’s apartment complexes, I found his reflections deeply resonant. Many of us who grew up in those spaces will recognize the shared experiences, the proximity of neighbors, the sounds, the conversations, the sense of living among an interwoven tapestry of people’s lives.
When he signed my copy of The Death of Vishnu, it felt like a beautiful connection to those Mumbai roots.
We also discussed the urgency of writing what is clamoring to be written. That urgency is something many creative people understand: the feeling that an idea has become so insistent that it must find its way onto the page.
Suri has developed a disciplined routine around this impulse. He writes a sentence at night before going to bed and expands on it in the morning. He has also said that he can write before breakfast. Even one line. He has told his mind, “Today you will be writing.”
He believes the original thought is often the best. Language can be polished later.
His editing process is equally disciplined. For his memoir, he cut approximately 50 percent of a 140,000-word draft to find the story’s core.
He has become more adept at what he calls “self-editing.”
“When you are starting out, you tend to be self-indulgent,” he says. “You have to ask yourself: what is it that is driving the narrative forward?”
Shobhaa De: Finding the Courage to Use Your Voice
Shobhaa De stands as a pioneering Indian columnist, former supermodel, and bestselling novelist, often dubbed “India’s Jackie Collins.” In the 1970s and 1980s, she co-founded and edited legendary pop-culture magazines such as Stardust. Her novels, including Socialite Evenings and Starry Nights, boldly exposed both the glamorous and darker sides of urban India and Bollywood. Her voice has always been her defining characteristic: sharp, provocative, and unapologetic.
Her lecture on her latest book, The Sensual Self, moderated by Dr. Anjal Arondekari, had the audience in stitches. But beneath the humor, in an interview with me, was a thoughtful reflection on childhood, independence, family responsibility, gender, and the courage to take risks.
De’s fierce independence was forged early. As the youngest child in her family, she had greater freedom of self-expression than her older siblings. Yet she also felt intensely duty-bound to her parents. That tension between freedom and responsibility influenced the choices she made.
“Looking back, I could have taken many more chances,” she reflected. “But in a way, I was inhibited by not upsetting my parents more than they were already upset.
Her message to younger people is therefore deeply personal: “Just be reckless. Don’t play it safe. No safe bets.”
She remembered herself at five years old as “quite adorable,” but also “pampered, entitled, and a bit too obedient,” and wondered what she would tell that little girl today. “Enjoy being five years old, ” Shobhaa said, imagining herself.
Shobhaa said she did not have one “mentor” but the many people she admired in college and during her early journalism career, those who gave her “fantastic” breaks.
My friends and I grew up curled up on sofas reading her scandalous Stardust columns.
My father appreciated her tongue-in-cheek outspoken spirit. During our conversation, De revealed a magnetic aura that naturally encouraged people to open up to her.
We spoke about the troubling tendency among women in the West to muffle their own voices and shrink themselves to fit into a man’s world.
“There is no such thing as a man’s world. Don’t give it importance.”
She also spoke about ageism and the ways societies can impose limitations on women. Her message was that women must learn to rely on their own resources and continue to seek inspiration within themselves. Do not give up on yourself. Accept genuine care with grace but do not allow society to put you in a cage. On gender and identity, De made another characteristically memorable declaration. “I want to be reborn as a woman in the next seven lives.”
The three conversations explore different aspects of life: its limits, the power of memory, and the courage to express oneself. Together, they suggest that creativity grows from curiosity, personal history, and self-expression, connecting the global perspective with the South Asian experience.
With roots in Georgia and the Bay Area, and her heart still tethered to a childhood mango tree in Mumbai, India, Monita Soni approaches writing as a contemplative practice. A path to honor humanity. She has published hundreds of movie reviews, book critiques, poems, and essays, and contributed to combined literary works. Her two books are “My Light Reflections” and “Flow Through My Heart.” You can hear her commentaries on Sundial Writers Corner, WLRH 89.3 FM.

items.title_zh: 科学、记忆与寻找声音：2026年南亚文学与艺术节的三场对话
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了在2026年南亚文学与艺术节上，科学家们对健康生活方式的看法。核心论点是健康的生活方式应包括适度饮食、良好的睡眠和适度锻炼。科学家们强调，适度饮食可以帮助维持身体健康，良好的睡眠有助于记忆和认知功能，而适度锻炼则能增强身体素质和心理健康。这些观点通过科学研究和数据支持，指出了健康生活方式对个人和社会的重要性，呼吁人们关注并实践这些健康建议。
items.l1_lead: 健康生活方式应包括适度饮食、良好睡眠和适度锻炼，这对个人和社会的健康至关重要。
items.l2_summary:
在2026年南亚文学与艺术节上，科学家们围绕健康生活方式展开了深入的对话，探讨了适度饮食、良好睡眠和适度锻炼对身体和心理健康的重要性。研究表明，适度饮食不仅有助于维持身体健康，还能有效降低慢性疾病的风险。科学家们强调，合理的营养摄入能够为身体提供必要的能量和营养素，从而促进整体健康。

此外，良好的睡眠被认为是提升记忆和认知功能的关键因素。研究显示，成年人每晚应保证7到9小时的睡眠，以便大脑在睡眠过程中进行信息整理和记忆巩固。缺乏睡眠不仅会影响学习能力，还可能导致情绪波动和心理健康问题。

适度锻炼同样被视为健康生活方式的重要组成部分。科学家指出，规律的身体活动能够增强心肺功能，提高身体素质，并有助于减轻压力和焦虑。根据相关数据，成年人每周应至少进行150分钟的中等强度锻炼，以达到最佳的健康效果。

通过这些科学研究和数据支持，科学家们呼吁公众关注健康生活方式的重要性，并积极实践这些建议，以促进个人和社会的整体健康。健康的生活方式不仅能改善个体的生活质量，还有助于降低医疗成本，提升社会的整体福祉。因此，适度饮食、良好睡眠和适度锻炼应成为每个人日常生活中不可或缺的部分。

items.title: Oxygenaging: A Physiological Framework for Geroscience.
items.body: The stepwise movement of oxygen from the atmosphere to the mitochondria, the "oxygen cascade", is one of the most tightly regulated systems in physiology. Despite decades of mechanistic study, it has remained quite unexplored in Geroscience. This oversight should be reconsidered. In young organisms, hypoxic stress (whether environmental or tissue-specific) activates a complex adaptive response to preserve energetic stability via restraining anabolic pathways, optimizing mitochondrial performance, and reinforcing cellular quality control systems. With advancing age, angiostatic signaling increases, endothelial metabolism becomes dysregulated, and overall alveolar ventilation and pulmonary gas exchange (ventilation-perfusion matching and diffusion capacity) become less efficient. These changes promote microvascular rarefaction and low-grade but persistent mismatches between oxygen delivery and demand at the tissue level, ultimately destabilizing cellular function. In this review, we propose that the gradual erosion of oxygen homeostasis is not simply a byproduct of aging, but also a driver of molecular damage and functional decline. We examine the aging oxygen cascade through the framework of resilience biology, focusing on mechanisms such as mitochondrial electron leaks, oxidative stress amplification, iron dyshomeostasis, ferroptosis, and epigenetic remodeling. We also discuss interventions that alter oxygen availability, such as intermittent hypoxia, hyperbaric oxygen therapy, and hypoxic-hyperoxic training. These approaches demonstrate adaptive potential, but they also highlight the narrow margin between beneficial stress and injury. We propose "Oxygenaging" as a unifying framework in which aging associates with the progressive loss of equilibrium across the oxygen cascade, linking systemic oxygen transport to mitochondrial function, genomic stability, and cellular resilience.
items.authors: Donega S, Fishbein KW, Dominelli P, Herman AB, de Cabo R, Gorospe M, Ferrucci L.
items.title_zh: 氧气衰老：衰老科学的生理框架
items.summary_zh: 氧气从大气到线粒体的逐步转移，即“氧气级联”，是生理学中最严格调控的系统之一。尽管经过数十年的机制研究，但在衰老科学（Geroscience）中仍然未得到充分探索。年轻生物体中的缺氧应激（无论是环境性还是组织特异性）激活复杂的适应性反应，以通过抑制合成代谢途径、优化线粒体性能和强化细胞质量控制系统来维持能量稳定。随着年龄的增长，血管抑制信号增加，内皮代谢失调，肺泡通气和气体交换效率降低。这些变化导致微血管稀疏和组织水平氧气供需之间的低级但持续的不匹配，最终破坏细胞功能。我们提出，氧气稳态的逐渐破坏不仅是衰老的副产品，也是分子损伤和功能衰退的驱动因素。我们通过韧性生物学框架审视衰老氧气级联，重点关注线粒体电子泄漏、氧化应激放大、铁稳态失调、铁死亡（ferroptosis）和表观遗传重塑等机制。
items.l1_lead: 氧气稳态的逐渐破坏是衰老的驱动因素，影响细胞功能并导致分子损伤和功能衰退。
items.l2_summary:
氧气在生理学中的转移过程，即“氧气级联”，是一个受到严格调控的系统，然而在衰老科学（Geroscience）领域，这一过程的研究仍显不足。年轻生物体在缺氧应激（无论是环境性还是组织特异性）下，能够激活复杂的适应性反应，这些反应通过抑制合成代谢途径、优化线粒体性能和强化细胞质量控制系统来维持能量的稳定。然而，随着年龄的增长，血管抑制信号的增加、内皮代谢的失调、肺泡通气和气体交换效率的降低，导致微血管的稀疏和组织水平氧气供需之间的持续不匹配。这种不匹配最终会破坏细胞功能，进而影响整体健康。

研究表明，氧气稳态的逐渐破坏不仅是衰老的副产品，更是分子损伤和功能衰退的驱动因素。通过韧性生物学框架，研究者们审视了衰老过程中氧气级联的变化，重点关注了线粒体电子泄漏、氧化应激放大、铁稳态失调、铁死亡（ferroptosis）以及表观遗传重塑等机制。这些机制在衰老过程中起着重要作用，揭示了氧气在细胞代谢和功能维持中的关键地位。

总的来说，氧气的稳态与衰老之间存在复杂的相互作用，理解这一过程不仅有助于揭示衰老的生理机制，还可能为延缓衰老和改善健康提供新的干预策略。

items.title: The proportion of people with primary affective disorders presenting to early intervention services: systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.body: Background People with affective psychotic disorders often face diagnostic delays and presentations are under-recognised at first contact with early intervention services (EIS). Despite their clinical significance, most research and service models for first-episode psychosis (FEP) have focused on non-affective psychoses. Aims We sought to clarify the relative prevalence of affective psychoses in EIS. Method A systematic review and random-effects meta-analysis of observational studies reporting proportion of affective psychotic disorders among individuals presenting to EIS with FEP was conducted. Eligible studies included treated FEP populations diagnosed using DSM/ICD criteria. Searches were conducted in Web of Science, Medline and PsycINFO (inception to July 2025). The primary outcome was pooled proportion of affective psychotic disorders. Heterogeneity was assessed using Q -statistics and I 2 -statistics. Meta-regressions examined potential moderators, including urbanicity, national income level and geographical region. Results Eighty-three studies ( N = 30 946; mean age 24.95 years; 34.78% female) were included. Random-effects pooled proportion was 18.0% (95% CI 15.4-20.6; 95% prediction interval 3.6-39.4%; I 2 = 95.6%). Schizoaffective disorder represented 7.4% ( k = 49; 95% CI 5.8-9.2). Schizophrenia was the most frequent diagnosis, with a pooled proportion of 45.5% ( k = 79; 95% CI 40.3-50.7). Meta-regression analyses identified that affective psychoses were less common in Asia and more common in North America compared with Europe. Higher urbanicity was also associated with increased prevalence. Associations with national income level (NIL) were limited by small subgroup sizes. Conclusions Affective psychotic disorders constitute a meaningful subgroup within EIS. This suggests better screening, targeted treatments and adaptive service models of care.
items.journal: The British journal of psychiatry : the journal of mental science
items.authors: Catalán A, Swidzinski S, McCutcheon RA, Aymerich C, Pedruzo B, Knox S, Swidzinska P, Tsaligopoulou A, Short R, Carter B, Ratheesh A, Quattrone D, Fearon P, Fusar-Poli P, Young AH, Murray RM, Jauhar S.
items.title_zh: 早期干预服务中情感性精神障碍患者比例的系统评估
items.summary_zh: 本研究旨在明确情感性精神病在早期干预服务（EIS）中的相对流行程度。通过对观察性研究的系统评估和随机效应荟萃分析，纳入了83项符合条件的研究，共涉及30,946名患者，平均年龄24.95岁，其中34.78%为女性。结果显示，情感性精神障碍的合并比例为18.0%（95% CI 15.4-20.6），异质性评估结果为I² = 95.6%。其中，情感性精神分裂症占7.4%，而精神分裂症则是最常见的诊断，合并比例为45.5%。该研究强调了情感性精神障碍在首次接触EIS时的临床重要性，呼吁对这一群体的关注与识别。
items.l1_lead: 本研究表明，情感性精神障碍在早期干预服务中占18.0%，强调了对该群体的临床关注与识别的重要性。
items.l2_summary:
本研究旨在系统评估情感性精神障碍（affective disorders）在早期干预服务（Early Intervention Services, EIS）中的相对流行程度。通过对83项符合条件的观察性研究进行系统评估和随机效应荟萃分析，研究共纳入了30,946名患者，平均年龄为24.95岁，其中34.78%为女性。结果显示，情感性精神障碍的合并比例为18.0%（95% CI 15.4-20.6），这表明在接受早期干预服务的患者中，情感性精神障碍的存在相对普遍。异质性评估结果为I² = 95.6%，显示出研究间存在较大的变异性。

在具体诊断方面，情感性精神分裂症（affective schizophrenia）占合并比例的7.4%，而精神分裂症（schizophrenia）则是最常见的诊断，合并比例高达45.5%。这些数据强调了情感性精神障碍在患者首次接触早期干预服务时的临床重要性，提示临床工作者应更加关注和识别这一群体的需求。研究结果为改善早期干预服务的针对性和有效性提供了重要依据，呼吁在临床实践中加强对情感性精神障碍患者的识别与干预。

items.title: Cannabis use is associated with increased risk of violence: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.body: Cannabis use is a known risk factor for adverse mental health outcomes, including psychosis, which is frequently associated with aggression. However, the specific impact of cannabis use on the risk of violence remains unclear. This meta-analysis, conducted according to PRISMA guidelines, synthesized evidence from 63 peer-reviewed studies (N = 265,079) identified via MEDLINE, EMBASE, and PsycINFO searches up to November 2024 to clarify the link between cannabis use and violence, either as a perpetrator or as a victim. Random-effects models revealed that cannabis users are at a significantly higher risk of perpetrating violent acts. This association was observed in both psychiatric patients (OR 2.49, 95% CI 1.72-3.61) and the general population (OR 2.05, 95% CI 1.74-2.41), and remained significant across both longitudinal (OR 1.17, 95% CI 1.07-1.28) and cross-sectional (OR 2.37, 95% CI 1.66-3.40) study designs. There was an especially large effect for violence involving a criminal conviction in both general (OR 3.75, 95% CI 2.54-5.53) and psychiatric (OR 4.21, 95% CI 2.86-6.22) populations. Furthermore, cannabis use was significantly associated with an increased risk of becoming a victim of violence (OR 1.49, 95% CI 1.38-1.60), a risk more pronounced in females and mixed-gender cohorts compared to males. This meta-analysis indicates an increased risk of violence, especially that resulting in a criminal conviction, among cannabis users. It also highlights the potential of cannabis use as a target for interventions to decrease violence, and underscores the need for routine assessment of cannabis use among psychiatric patients.
items.authors: Trotta G, Rodriguez V, Marino P, Gurmesa M, Spinazzola E, Li Z, Alameda L, Di Forti M, Murray R, Vassos E.
items.title_zh: 大麻使用与暴力风险增加相关：系统评价与荟萃分析
items.summary_zh: 本研究评估了大麻使用对暴力风险的影响，分析了63项同行评审研究（N = 265,079），旨在明确大麻使用与施暴者或受害者之间的关系。结果显示，大麻使用者施暴的风险显著增加，精神病患者（OR 2.49, 95% CI 1.72-3.61）和普通人群（OR 2.05, 95% CI 1.74-2.41）均表现出这一趋势。无论是纵向研究（OR 1.17, 95% CI 1.07-1.28）还是横断面研究（OR 2.37, 95% CI 1.66-3.40），这一关联均显著。涉及刑事定罪的暴力行为在普通人群（OR 3.75, 95% CI 2.54-5.53）和精神病患者（OR 4.21, 95% CI 2.86-6.22）中效果尤为显著。此外，大麻使用还显著增加了成为暴力受害者的风险（OR 1.49, 95% CI 1.38-1.60），女性和混合性别群体的风险更高。该荟萃分析表明，大麻使用与暴力风险增加密切相关。
items.l1_lead: 大麻使用显著增加施暴和成为暴力受害者的风险，尤其在精神病患者和女性中表现更为明显。
items.l2_summary:
本研究通过系统评价与荟萃分析，评估了大麻（Cannabis）使用对暴力风险的影响，分析了63项同行评审研究，样本总量达到265,079人，旨在明确大麻使用与施暴者或受害者之间的关系。研究结果显示，大麻使用者施暴的风险显著增加，精神病患者的施暴风险比值（OR）为2.49（95% CI 1.72-3.61），而普通人群的施暴风险比值为2.05（95% CI 1.74-2.41），均表明大麻使用与施暴行为之间存在明显的关联。无论是纵向研究（OR 1.17, 95% CI 1.07-1.28）还是横断面研究（OR 2.37, 95% CI 1.66-3.40），这一趋势在不同研究设计中均得到了验证。

特别是涉及刑事定罪的暴力行为，普通人群的风险比值高达3.75（95% CI 2.54-5.53），而精神病患者的风险比值为4.21（95% CI 2.86-6.22），显示出大麻使用与暴力行为之间的强烈关联。此外，大麻使用还显著增加了成为暴力受害者的风险，风险比值为1.49（95% CI 1.38-1.60），其中女性和混合性别群体的风险更高。这些结果表明，大麻使用与暴力风险的增加密切相关，提示在公共卫生和社会政策中应重视大麻使用对暴力行为的潜在影响。

items.title: Loss of Splicing Homeostasis as a Hallmark of Aging.
items.body: Alternative splicing is a fundamental mechanism that ensures accurate gene expression, supports cellular adaptability, and expands protein diversity beyond the limits of a fixed gene pool. With aging, splicing fidelity weakens, contributing to decline in RNA homeostasis and disrupting essential cellular functions, including mitochondrial oxidative phosphorylation, genome stability, and immune regulation, and in turn accelerating tissue and organ dysfunction. Evidence from senescent cells, aged tissues, and model organisms shows that altered levels of splicing factors and increased RNA polymerase II elongation rates impair co-transcriptional splicing and promote mis-spliced isoforms that reinforce senescence and drive pathology. Dysfunction of RNA-binding proteins further contributes to aberrant splicing, linking splicing defects to age-related diseases such as atherosclerosis, osteoarthritis, sarcopenia, and neurodegenerative disorders like Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. Therapeutic strategies to correct splicing defects, such as antisense oligonucleotides, RNA interference, CRISPR-Cas systems, ADAR-mediated editing, and RNA aptamers, can restore a homeostatic balance of mRNA isoforms. However, major challenges remain, including distinguishing adaptive physiological from pathological splicing 'noise' and achieving targeted delivery to tissues. Despite these obstacles, RNA splicing dysregulation represents a promising avenue to extend health span by reestablishing homeostatic RNA programs, and reinforces the idea that "transcriptomic instability" is a hallmark of aging.
items.authors: Donega S, Gorospe M, Harries LW, Ferrucci L.
items.title_zh: 衰老特征：剪接稳态的丧失
items.summary_zh: 文章探讨了替代剪接（alternative splicing）作为基因表达的重要机制，其在衰老过程中失去稳态，导致RNA稳态下降，影响细胞功能。研究表明，衰老细胞、老化组织及模型生物中，剪接因子的水平变化和RNA聚合酶II延伸速率增加，损害共转录剪接，促进错误剪接的异构体，进一步加速衰老及相关病理。RNA结合蛋白的功能障碍也加剧了异常剪接，关联到动脉粥样硬化、骨关节炎、肌肉萎缩及阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病等神经退行性疾病。文章提出，通过抗病毒寡核苷酸、RNA干扰、CRISPR-Cas系统等治疗策略可修复剪接缺陷，恢复mRNA异构体的稳态平衡，但仍面临识别生理适应性与病理剪接“噪音”的挑战。
items.l1_lead: 替代剪接在衰老过程中失去稳态，导致RNA稳态下降，影响细胞功能，并与多种衰老相关疾病密切相关。
items.l2_summary:
文章探讨了替代剪接（alternative splicing）在基因表达中的重要性，尤其是在衰老过程中其稳态的丧失对细胞功能的影响。研究显示，衰老细胞、老化组织及模型生物中，剪接因子的水平发生变化，伴随RNA聚合酶II延伸速率的增加，这种变化损害了共转录剪接，导致错误剪接的异构体生成，从而加速衰老及相关病理的进展。具体而言，RNA结合蛋白的功能障碍进一步加剧了异常剪接，这与动脉粥样硬化、骨关节炎、肌肉萎缩以及阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病等神经退行性疾病密切相关。

在衰老过程中，剪接稳态的丧失不仅影响了正常的基因表达，还可能导致细胞功能的下降，进而引发一系列衰老相关疾病。文章指出，通过采用抗病毒寡核苷酸、RNA干扰、CRISPR-Cas系统等治疗策略，有望修复剪接缺陷，恢复mRNA异构体的稳态平衡。然而，研究者也面临着识别生理适应性与病理剪接“噪音”的挑战，这对未来的治疗策略提出了更高的要求。总的来说，替代剪接的稳态丧失在衰老及相关疾病中扮演了重要角色，深入理解这一机制将为开发新的治疗方法提供重要的理论基础。

items.title: Ferroptotic propagation: from single-cell execution to tissue-scale death programs.
items.body: Ferroptosis has long been regarded as a cell-autonomous form of regulated cell death driven by iron-dependent lipid peroxidation. Recent work, however, suggests that ferroptotic commitment can extend beyond the initiating cell, spreading to neighboring cells and, in some contexts, across tissue-scale distances. Multiple, non-mutually exclusive modes of contagion have now been described, including reactive oxygen species-triggered death waves, direct membrane contact-dependent transfer, and extracellular vesicle-mediated paracrine signaling. These findings redefine ferroptosis from a single-cell execution pathway into a spatially coordinated, multicellular process. In this perspective, we integrate mechanistic insights with experimental evidence on ferroptotic contagion and propose a unifying, multiscale framework in which distinct modes of transmission operate over different spatial scales, from short-range membrane transfer to longer-range oxidative and extracellular relay mechanisms. We discuss how nonlinear redox amplification, membrane biophysics, and tissue architecture together determine the dynamics, limits, and patterning of ferroptotic injury in vivo. This emerging framework has important implications for developmental tissue remodeling, the progression of organ injury, and ferroptosis-based cancer therapy. More broadly, defining how ferroptotic contagion is initiated, constrained, and manipulated therapeutically may help establish ferroptosis as a fundamental organizing principle for understanding tissue-level regulation and pathological escalation.
items.authors: Tang D, Kang R, Kroemer G.
items.title_zh: 铁死亡传播：从单细胞执行到组织规模死亡程序
items.summary_zh: 铁死亡（Ferroptosis）被视为一种依赖铁的脂质过氧化驱动的细胞自主调控死亡形式。近期研究表明，铁死亡的承诺不仅限于起始细胞，还可以传播至邻近细胞，甚至在某些情况下跨越组织规模的距离。研究描述了多种非互斥的传播模式，包括反应性氧种引发的死亡波、直接膜接触依赖的转移以及细胞外囊泡介导的旁分泌信号。这些发现将铁死亡重新定义为一种空间协调的多细胞过程。本文整合了铁死亡传播的机制洞察与实验证据，提出了一个统一的多尺度框架，涵盖了不同空间尺度上操作的传播模式，从短程膜转移到长程氧化和细胞外中继机制。我们讨论了非线性氧化还原放大、膜生物物理学和组织结构如何共同决定体内铁死亡损伤的动态、限制和模式。这一新兴框架对发育组织重塑、器官损伤进展及基于铁死亡的癌症治疗具有重要意义。
items.l1_lead: 铁死亡不仅是单细胞的死亡机制，还能通过多种方式在邻近细胞和组织间传播，重新定义为一种空间协调的多细胞过程，对组织重塑和癌症治疗具有重要影响。
items.l2_summary:
铁死亡（Ferroptosis）是一种依赖铁的脂质过氧化驱动的细胞自主调控死亡形式，近年来的研究表明，铁死亡不仅限于起始细胞的死亡，还可以传播至邻近细胞，甚至在某些情况下跨越组织规模的距离。这一发现重新定义了铁死亡为一种空间协调的多细胞过程，揭示了其传播机制的复杂性。研究中描述了多种非互斥的传播模式，包括反应性氧种引发的死亡波、直接膜接触依赖的转移以及细胞外囊泡介导的旁分泌信号。

通过整合铁死亡传播的机制洞察与实验证据，研究提出了一个统一的多尺度框架，涵盖了不同空间尺度上操作的传播模式，从短程膜转移到长程氧化和细胞外中继机制。这一框架强调了非线性氧化还原放大、膜生物物理学和组织结构如何共同决定体内铁死亡损伤的动态、限制和模式。具体而言，反应性氧种的产生可以引发一系列细胞死亡的连锁反应，而膜接触和细胞外囊泡则为细胞间的信号传递提供了新的途径。

这一新兴的框架不仅为理解铁死亡的基本生物学提供了新的视角，也对发育组织重塑、器官损伤进展及基于铁死亡的癌症治疗具有重要意义。通过深入研究铁死亡的传播机制，未来有望开发出新的治疗策略，以应对与铁死亡相关的疾病。因此，铁死亡的研究不仅丰富了细胞死亡的理论体系，也为临床应用提供了潜在的方向。

items.title: Molecular damage associated with ageing drives inflammation in cardiovascular disease.
items.body: Chronic inflammation has long been recognized as a major risk factor for and a causal contributor to cardiovascular disease (CVD). However, advances in omics technologies and deepening insights into CVD pathogenesis have expanded our understanding of the underlying mechanisms. Inflammation is now seen not as an isolated cause, but as one of several biological responses to cumulative tissue damage over time. In this Review, we propose that inflammation initially functions as a resilience mechanism, acting to resolve molecular and cellular damage driven by environmental stressors and intrinsic age-related entropy. With ageing, however, this protective response can become dysregulated and maladaptive, promoting collateral pathological changes. We illustrate this theory through two examples, atherosclerosis and age-related impairment of tissue perfusion, and support these conceptual models using proteomic data from large population studies with cardiovascular outcomes. Our findings reaffirm the central role of inflammation in CVD pathophysiology, but also indicate that the upstream biological driver of inflammation is molecular damage that is either not readily prevented or repaired by inadequate resilience mechanisms. Understanding the coordination of these responses offers new opportunities for targeted prevention and treatment of CVD.
items.authors: Herman AB, Candia J, Wilson DM, Donega S, Picard M, Ferrucci L.
items.title_zh: 与衰老相关的分子损伤驱动心血管疾病炎症
items.summary_zh: 慢性炎症被广泛认为是心血管疾病（CVD）的主要风险因素和因果贡献者。随着组学技术的进步和对CVD发病机制的深入理解，炎症不再被视为孤立的原因，而是对累积性组织损伤的多种生物反应之一。本文提出，炎症最初作为一种韧性机制，旨在解决由环境压力和内在衰老引起的分子和细胞损伤。然而，随着年龄的增长，这种保护性反应可能失调并产生不适应，促进病理变化。我们通过动脉粥样硬化和与年龄相关的组织灌注障碍两个例子来说明这一理论，并利用大型人群研究中的蛋白质组学数据支持这些概念模型。研究结果重申了炎症在CVD病理生理中的核心作用，同时表明炎症的上游生物驱动因素是分子损伤，这种损伤无法通过不充分的韧性机制得到有效预防或修复。理解这些反应的协调提供了针对CVD的预防和治疗的新机会。
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，衰老引发的分子损伤驱动心血管疾病的炎症反应，随着年龄增长，这种反应可能失调，促进病理变化，为CVD的预防和治疗提供新机会。
items.l2_summary:
慢性炎症被广泛认为是心血管疾病（CVD）的主要风险因素和因果贡献者。随着组学技术的进步和对CVD发病机制的深入理解，炎症的角色逐渐被重新审视，不再被视为孤立的原因，而是对累积性组织损伤的多种生物反应之一。本文提出，炎症最初作为一种韧性机制，旨在应对由环境压力和内在衰老引起的分子和细胞损伤。然而，随着年龄的增长，这种保护性反应可能失调，导致不适应的病理变化。

通过动脉粥样硬化和与年龄相关的组织灌注障碍两个例子，本文阐述了这一理论，并利用大型人群研究中的蛋白质组学数据来支持这些概念模型。研究结果强调了炎症在CVD病理生理中的核心作用，同时指出炎症的上游生物驱动因素是分子损伤，这种损伤往往无法通过不充分的韧性机制得到有效预防或修复。这一发现为理解心血管疾病的复杂机制提供了新的视角，并为未来的预防和治疗策略开辟了新的机会。

总的来说，本文强调了衰老过程中分子损伤与心血管疾病炎症之间的密切关系，指出了在应对这些疾病时需要关注的关键生物机制。这一研究不仅丰富了我们对CVD发病机制的理解，也为临床实践提供了重要的理论依据，提示我们在预防和治疗心血管疾病时，应重视炎症反应的调控及其与分子损伤的关系。

items.title: Immune aging biomarkers for clinical trials.
items.body: Aging profoundly remodels the immune system, impairing defense, repair and homeostatic function across tissues. Because the immune system operates in every organ, its deterioration has been proposed to drive or exacerbate systemic dysfunction and accelerate overall biological aging, making it an attractive biomarker and target for geroscience-guided trials. Despite this central role, there is no consensus on how to quantify immune aging, especially in clinical trials. Here, we establish a translational framework to identify immune aging biomarkers for this purpose. We define five evaluation criteria for immune aging biomarkers and apply these to candidate biomarkers, discussing their utility in the context of a major international healthspan competition, XPRIZE Healthspan. Metrics encapsulating multidimensional aspects of immune function, inflammaging scores and functional assays performed best against our selection criteria. Finally, we identify promising emerging measures, together with critical gaps that must be addressed to develop reliable, predictive biomarkers of human immune competence. Our framework provides a coherent path toward actionable and clinically meaningful immune aging biomarkers capable of quantifying immune fitness and resilience, and accelerating the clinical translation of geroscience-guided interventions.
items.authors: Cipriano A, Justice J, Poganik JR, Moqri M, Abudayyeh OO, Gootenberg J, Haynes L, Levin Y, Martin-Herranz DE, Akbar AN, Mannick J, Pawelec G, Shen-Orr SS, Tsang J, Wagner W, Merad M, Gnjatic S, Gellhorn A, Corley MJ, Kuc

items.title_zh: 免疫衰老生物标志物在临床试验中的应用
items.summary_zh: 免疫系统在衰老过程中发生显著重塑，影响防御、修复和稳态功能，进而可能加速整体生物衰老。尽管免疫衰老在系统性功能障碍中扮演重要角色，但目前尚无统一的量化标准，尤其是在临床试验中。本文建立了一个转化框架，以识别免疫衰老生物标志物，定义了五个评估标准，并将其应用于候选生物标志物，讨论其在国际健康寿命竞赛XPRIZE Healthspan中的实用性。多维免疫功能指标、炎症衰老评分和功能检测在评估标准中表现最佳。最后，本文识别出有前景的新兴测量方法，并指出开发可靠的免疫能力预测生物标志物所需解决的关键问题。该框架为量化免疫健康和韧性、加速衰老科学指导干预的临床转化提供了清晰路径。
items.l1_lead: 本文建立了免疫衰老生物标志物的评估框架，强调其在临床试验中的应用潜力，以量化免疫健康和指导衰老干预。
items.l2_summary:
免疫系统在衰老过程中经历显著的重塑，这种变化不仅影响了机体的防御、修复和稳态功能，还可能加速整体生物衰老。尽管免疫衰老在系统性功能障碍中扮演着重要角色，但目前尚缺乏统一的量化标准，尤其是在临床试验中。为了解决这一问题，本文建立了一个转化框架，旨在识别免疫衰老生物标志物，并定义了五个评估标准，这些标准被应用于候选生物标志物的分析，特别是在国际健康寿命竞赛XPRIZE Healthspan中的实用性。

在评估标准中，多维免疫功能指标、炎症衰老评分和功能检测表现最佳，显示出它们在量化免疫健康方面的潜力。此外，本文还识别出一些有前景的新兴测量方法，并指出了开发可靠的免疫能力预测生物标志物所需解决的关键问题。这些问题的解决将为量化免疫健康和韧性提供重要支持，并为加速衰老科学指导干预的临床转化提供清晰路径。

通过这一框架，研究者能够更好地理解免疫衰老的机制，并为未来的临床试验提供科学依据，从而推动相关领域的研究进展和临床应用。总之，本文为免疫衰老生物标志物的识别和应用提供了系统化的思路，期待在未来的研究中能够进一步验证和完善这些标准。

items.title: Translating ferroptosis into oncology: challenges, opportunities and future directions.
items.body: Ferroptosis is an oxidative, lipid peroxidation-driven form of regulated cell death that occurs when antioxidant and organelle-protective systems are compromised. Increasing evidence implicates ferroptosis as a process that can exert both tumour-suppressive and tumour-promoting effects depending on cellular context at multiple stages of cancer evolution (from tumour initiation to metastatic colonization), sparking substantial interest in therapeutically exploiting this mechanism of cell death. Yet, despite rapid preclinical progress, clinical translation of ferroptosis-based strategies remains nascent. In this Review, we examine the major barriers to translation, including pharmacological limitations, tumour-intrinsic heterogeneity, microenvironmental and immune constraints, and gaps in current preclinical modelling. We also highlight emerging opportunities such as new ferroptosis-inducing agents, biomarker-guided patient selection and rational combinations with chemotherapy, radiotherapy, targeted agents or immunotherapies. Finally, we outline a translational roadmap for integrating ferroptosis-based therapies into oncology practice. By defining key challenges and future directions, this Review aims to position ferroptosis as a viable therapeutic paradigm and to accelerate progress towards clinical application.
items.authors: Kang R, Liu J, Wang J, Kroemer G, Tang D.
items.title_zh: 将铁死亡转化为肿瘤学的挑战与机遇
items.summary_zh: 铁死亡（ferroptosis）是一种由氧化和脂质过氧化驱动的调控性细胞死亡形式，发生在抗氧化和细胞器保护系统受损时。越来越多的证据表明，铁死亡在癌症演变的多个阶段（从肿瘤启动到转移性殖民）中，可能发挥抑制肿瘤或促进肿瘤的双重作用，这引发了对这一细胞死亡机制的治疗性利用的广泛关注。然而，尽管在临床前研究中取得了快速进展，基于铁死亡的策略在临床转化方面仍处于初期阶段。本文评述了转化过程中的主要障碍，包括药物限制、肿瘤内在异质性、微环境和免疫限制，以及当前临床前模型的不足。同时，文章强调了新型铁死亡诱导剂、基于生物标志物的患者选择以及与化疗、放疗、靶向药物或免疫疗法的合理组合等新兴机遇。最后，本文勾勒了将基于铁死亡的疗法整合到肿瘤学实践中的转化路线图，旨在明确关键挑战和未来方向，将铁死亡定位为可行的治疗范式，加速其临床应用的进展。
items.l1_lead: 铁死亡在癌症发展中具有双重作用，尽管临床前研究进展迅速，但其转化应用仍面临多重挑战与机遇。
items.l2_summary:
铁死亡（ferroptosis）是一种由氧化和脂质过氧化驱动的调控性细胞死亡形式，通常在抗氧化和细胞器保护系统受损时发生。近年来，越来越多的研究表明，铁死亡在癌症的多个演变阶段中可能发挥双重作用，既可以抑制肿瘤的发生，也可能促进肿瘤的转移。这一发现引发了对铁死亡机制在癌症治疗中潜在应用的广泛关注。然而，尽管在临床前研究中取得了一定进展，基于铁死亡的治疗策略在临床转化方面仍处于初期阶段。

在转化过程中，存在多个主要障碍，包括药物的限制、肿瘤内在的异质性、微环境的影响以及免疫系统的限制。此外，当前的临床前模型也存在不足，无法充分反映人类肿瘤的复杂性。这些因素共同导致了铁死亡相关疗法在临床应用中的困难。

尽管面临挑战，文章也指出了一些新兴的机遇。例如，新型铁死亡诱导剂的开发、基于生物标志物的患者选择策略，以及与化疗、放疗、靶向药物或免疫疗法的合理组合，都为铁死亡的临床应用提供了新的可能性。通过整合这些新策略，研究者们希望能够克服现有的障碍，加速铁死亡相关疗法的临床应用进程。

最后，本文勾勒出了一条将基于铁死亡的疗法整合到肿瘤学实践中的转化路线图，旨在明确关键挑战和未来方向，推动铁死亡作为一种可行的治疗范式的临床应用。这一研究不仅为肿瘤治疗提供了新的思路，也为未来的研究指明了方向。

items.title: Pro-aging effects of chronic glucocorticoid signaling.
items.body: Glucocorticoids (GCs) are essential endocrine regulators coordinating stress responsiveness, metabolic flexibility, inflammatory resolution, and circadian physiology. While acute GC fluctuations are adaptive, sustained exposure (arising from psychosocial stress, circadian disruption, obesity, chronic inflammation, neoplasms, or steroid therapy) elicits pleiotropic effects that overlap with biological aging. Prolonged GC signaling intersects with multiple hallmarks of aging by altering nutrient sensing, suppressing autophagy, impairing mitochondrial quality control, and promoting cellular senescence. In this context, the GC-responsive polypeptide ACBP/DBI (acyl-coenzyme A [CoA]-binding protein/diazepam-binding inhibitor) has emerged as a stress-induced inhibitor of macroautophagy that amplifies several metabolic and immune consequences of GC excess linked to aging phenotypes. Clinically, chronic GC elevation is associated with earlier and more severe manifestations of age-related diseases, including metabolic syndrome, osteoporosis, sarcopenia, neurodegeneration, cardiovascular disease, immunosenescence, and cancer. Here, we review mechanistic links between GC signaling and systemic aging and discuss strategies to mitigate the age-accelerating consequences of persistent GC exposure.
items.authors: Lambertucci F, Castinetti F, Martins I, López-Otín C, Kroemer G.
items.title_zh: 慢性糖皮质激素信号的促衰老效应
items.summary_zh: 糖皮质激素（GCs）是调节压力反应、代谢灵活性、炎症解决和昼夜生理的重要内分泌因子。虽然急性GC波动具有适应性，但持续暴露（如心理社会压力、昼夜节律紊乱、肥胖、慢性炎症、肿瘤或类固醇治疗）会引发与生物衰老重叠的多重效应。长期GC信号通过改变营养感知、抑制自噬、损害线粒体质量控制和促进细胞衰老，影响衰老的多个标志。GC反应性多肽ACBP/DBI（酰基辅酶A结合蛋白/地西泮结合抑制剂）已被发现为一种应激诱导的宏自噬抑制因子，放大与衰老表型相关的GC过量的代谢和免疫后果。临床上，慢性GC升高与代谢综合征、骨质疏松、肌肉减少、神经退行性疾病、心血管疾病、免疫衰老和癌症等年龄相关疾病的早期和严重表现相关。本文回顾了GC信号与系统性衰老之间的机制联系，并讨论了减轻持续GC暴露加速衰老后果的策略。
items.l1_lead: 慢性糖皮质激素信号通过影响营养感知、自噬和线粒体功能，加速衰老过程，并与多种年龄相关疾病的发生密切相关。
items.l2_summary:
糖皮质激素（GCs）是调节压力反应、代谢灵活性、炎症解决和昼夜生理的重要内分泌因子。尽管急性GC波动具有适应性，但持续暴露于GCs（如心理社会压力、昼夜节律紊乱、肥胖、慢性炎症、肿瘤或类固醇治疗）会引发与生物衰老相关的多重效应。长期的GC信号通过改变营养感知、抑制自噬、损害线粒体质量控制和促进细胞衰老，影响衰老的多个标志。研究发现，GC反应性多肽ACBP/DBI（酰基辅酶A结合蛋白/地西泮结合抑制剂）是一种应激诱导的宏自噬抑制因子，能够放大与衰老表型相关的GC过量的代谢和免疫后果。

临床研究表明，慢性GC水平升高与多种年龄相关疾病的早期和严重表现密切相关，包括代谢综合征、骨质疏松、肌肉减少、神经退行性疾病、心血管疾病、免疫衰老和癌症等。这些疾病的发生与GC信号的持续激活有着直接的联系，提示GCs在衰老过程中扮演着重要角色。本文回顾了GC信号与系统性衰老之间的机制联系，强调了持续GC暴露对衰老后果的加速作用，并讨论了减轻这一影响的潜在策略。

综上所述，糖皮质激素的慢性信号不仅影响个体的生理状态，还可能加速衰老过程，导致多种与年龄相关的疾病。因此，理解GC信号的作用机制及其对衰老的影响，对于开发新的干预策略以减缓衰老进程和改善老年人健康具有重要意义。

items.title: Immunobiological mechanisms of action of oncolytic peptides.
items.body: Oncolytic peptides (OLPs) constitute an emerging class of immunotherapeutics that combine direct cancer cell lysis with immune activation. Indeed, OLPs induce rapid immunogenic cell death by disrupting intracellular membranes, which culminates with the abundant release of malignant cell contents including immunostimulatory danger-associated molecular patterns. This results in the engagement of innate immune sensors that potently activate dendritic cells, leading to the cross-priming of tumor-specific T lymphocytes that mediate systemic anticancer immunity. Through such a dual mechanism, OLPs can remodel the tumor microenvironment and overcome resistance to therapy as promoted by intratumoral heterogeneity, hence representing optimal combinatorial partners for immune checkpoint inhibitors. Some OLPs have also shown remarkable clinical efficacy. For instance, LTX-315 (studied as VP-315 in basal cell carcinoma (BCC)) has recently been shown to enable complete and durable responses in patients with BCC, and emerging evidence points to a significant activity of LTX-315 in immunologically cold tumors. Here, we summarize recent mechanistic, preclinical, and clinical advances in OLP development, underscoring their potential as a versatile and powerful modality of cancer immunotherapy.
items.authors: Kepp O, Deng X, Xue E, Sveinbjørnsson B, Rekdal Ø, Galluzzi L, Kroemer G.
items.title_zh: 肿瘤溶解肽的免疫生物学作用机制
items.summary_zh: 肿瘤溶解肽（Oncolytic peptides, OLPs）是一类新兴的免疫治疗药物，能够通过直接裂解癌细胞并激活免疫系统来对抗癌症。OLPs通过破坏细胞内膜诱导快速的免疫原性细胞死亡，释放出包括免疫刺激性危险相关分子模式在内的恶性细胞内容物，从而激活先天免疫传感器，强效激活树突状细胞，促进特异性肿瘤T淋巴细胞的交叉激活，进而介导全身抗癌免疫。通过这种双重机制，OLPs能够重塑肿瘤微环境，克服肿瘤内部异质性带来的治疗抵抗，因此与免疫检查点抑制剂形成理想的联合治疗伙伴。一些OLPs已显示出显著的临床疗效，例如LTX-315（在基底细胞癌中研究为VP-315）最近被证明能在基底细胞癌患者中实现完全且持久的反应，并且有证据表明LTX-315在免疫冷肿瘤中也具有显著活性。本文总结了OLP开发的最新机制、临床前和临床进展，强调其作为一种多功能且强大的癌症免疫治疗手段的潜力。
items.l1_lead: 肿瘤溶解肽通过直接裂解癌细胞和激活免疫系统，展现出强大的抗癌潜力，成为理想的免疫治疗药物。
items.l2_summary:
肿瘤溶解肽（Oncolytic peptides, OLPs）是一类新兴的免疫治疗药物，具有通过直接裂解癌细胞并激活免疫系统来对抗癌症的潜力。OLPs能够通过破坏细胞内膜诱导快速的免疫原性细胞死亡，释放出包括免疫刺激性危险相关分子模式在内的恶性细胞内容物。这一过程激活了先天免疫传感器，强效激活树突状细胞，并促进特异性肿瘤T淋巴细胞的交叉激活，从而介导全身抗癌免疫。通过这种双重机制，OLPs不仅能够有效地重塑肿瘤微环境，还能克服肿瘤内部异质性带来的治疗抵抗，使其与免疫检查点抑制剂形成理想的联合治疗伙伴。

在临床研究中，一些OLPs显示出显著的疗效。例如，LTX-315（在基底细胞癌中研究为VP-315）最近被证明能够在基底细胞癌患者中实现完全且持久的反应，且有证据表明LTX-315在免疫冷肿瘤中也具有显著活性。这些研究结果表明，OLPs作为一种多功能且强大的癌症免疫治疗手段，具有广阔的应用前景。本文总结了OLP开发的最新机制、临床前和临床进展，强调了其在癌症免疫治疗中的重要性和潜力。通过深入了解OLPs的作用机制和临床表现，未来有望为癌症患者提供更有效的治疗选择。

items.title: Progress, challenges, and opportunities in the field of biosynthetic reactions involving ambimodal transition states.
items.body: Covering: up to June 2025High selectivity is generally observed in the biosynthesis of complex natural molecules. Evolution usually leads to enzymes that favor the formation of a particular isomer rather than one of the many other potential molecules. Recent discoveries of enzymes with multiple sequential post-transition state bifurcations (PTSB) after ambimodal transition states demonstrate the impact of dynamics on selectivity. PTSB cause a single ambimodal transition state (TS) to form multiple products. This is different from conventional energetically-controlled mechanisms, where two discrete transition states have different energy barriers. Selectivity arising from ambimodal TSs cannot be fully explained by transition state theory. The presence of PTSB on enzyme catalyzed reaction surfaces has been discovered recently at a significantly higher rate. For both uncatalyzed and catalyzed reactions, computational chemists are devising techniques to comprehend which elements of molecular structure and vibrations govern the product selectivity in systems that contain bifurcations. This review describes enzyme-catalyzed reactions involving ambimodal transition states, and recent advances in understanding how enzymes control selectivity in such reactions.
items.authors: Hussain H, Houk KN, Lam CC, Sarker SD, Nahar L.
items.title_zh: 生物合成反应中双模态过渡态的进展与挑战
items.summary_zh: 本文评述了涉及双模态过渡态（ambimodal transition states）的酶催化反应，重点探讨了酶如何通过多重后过渡态分叉（post-transition state bifurcations, PTSB）影响选择性。研究表明，PTSB使得单一的双模态过渡态能够生成多种产物，这与传统的能量控制机制不同，后者涉及两个具有不同能量障碍的离散过渡态。双模态过渡态产生的选择性无法完全用过渡态理论解释。近期发现，酶催化反应表面上PTSB的存在频率显著提高。计算化学家正在开发技术，以理解在包含分叉的系统中，哪些分子结构和振动元素主导产物选择性。本文总结了在这一领域的最新进展，强调了对酶选择性控制机制的理解。
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，酶催化反应中的双模态过渡态通过多重后过渡态分叉显著影响产物选择性，挑战传统过渡态理论的解释。
items.l2_summary:
本文评述了双模态过渡态（ambimodal transition states）在酶催化反应中的重要性，特别是其对反应选择性的影响。研究指出，酶通过多重后过渡态分叉（post-transition state bifurcations, PTSB）机制，使得单一的双模态过渡态能够生成多种产物，这一现象与传统的能量控制机制显著不同，后者通常涉及两个具有不同能量障碍的离散过渡态。传统的过渡态理论无法完全解释双模态过渡态所产生的选择性，这提示我们需要重新审视酶催化反应中的选择性控制机制。

近期的研究发现，酶催化反应中PTSB的出现频率显著提高，这一发现为理解酶的选择性提供了新的视角。计算化学家们正在开发新的技术，以探讨在包含分叉的系统中，哪些分子结构和振动元素主导产物的选择性。这些研究不仅为我们提供了对酶催化反应机制的深入理解，也为未来的酶设计和优化提供了理论基础。

综上所述，双模态过渡态及其相关的PTSB现象在酶催化反应中扮演着关键角色，推动了我们对酶选择性控制机制的理解，尽管仍面临许多挑战。未来的研究需要进一步探索这些机制，以便更好地利用酶催化反应的潜力。

items.title: Hierarchical endpoints and win statistics for geromedicine trials.
items.body: Geroscience has advanced rapidly, yet its clinical translation remains limited. A central barrier is the lack of trial outcomes that capture the multidimensional effects of geroprotective interventions while meeting clinical and regulatory standards. Mortality is objective and regulatorily salient but often impractical. By contrast, surrogate measures of healthspan improve feasibility and may better reflect the quality of extended life, but they are generally considered soft endpoints that require further validation. Here, we propose hierarchical composite endpoints using time-to-worst-event analysis as a pragmatic and scientifically sound compromise. Participant pairs are compared using win statistics according to a prespecified clinical hierarchy, in which more severe and objective clinical events are prioritized, while health surrogates and biomarkers contribute information at lower tiers. When outcome selection, ordering and tie rules are clinically and mechanistically justified and agreed with regulators, this approach may improve geromedicine trial efficiency and allow overall treatment effects to be captured without compromising clinical priorities.
items.authors: Abdellatif M, Kim Y, Kroemer G.
items.title_zh: 老年医学试验的分层终点与胜利统计
items.summary_zh: 老年科学（Geroscience）发展迅速，但其临床转化仍然有限，主要障碍在于缺乏能够捕捉老年保护干预多维效果的试验结果，同时满足临床和监管标准。死亡率作为客观且符合监管要求的指标，往往不够实用；而健康寿命的替代指标虽然提高了可行性，并可能更好地反映延长生命的质量，但通常被视为需要进一步验证的软终点。本文提出使用时间到最差事件分析的分层复合终点，作为务实且科学合理的折衷方案。通过预先设定的临床层级比较参与者对，优先考虑更严重和客观的临床事件，而健康替代指标和生物标志物则在较低层级提供信息。当结果选择、排序和平局规则在临床和机制上得到合理化并与监管机构达成一致时，该方法可能提高老年医学试验的效率，并在不妨碍临床优先事项的情况下捕捉整体治疗效果。
items.l1_lead: 本文提出了一种分层复合终点分析方法，以提高老年医学试验效率，合理捕捉干预效果，同时满足临床和监管标准。
items.l2_summary:
老年科学（Geroscience）近年来发展迅速，但在临床转化方面仍面临诸多挑战，主要障碍在于缺乏能够全面捕捉老年保护干预多维效果的试验结果，同时又能满足临床和监管标准。传统上，死亡率作为一个客观且符合监管要求的指标，虽然在统计上有效，但在实际应用中往往显得不够实用。此外，健康寿命的替代指标虽然在一定程度上提高了可行性，并可能更好地反映延长生命的质量，但通常被视为需要进一步验证的软终点。因此，本文提出了一种新的方法，即使用时间到最差事件分析的分层复合终点，作为一种务实且科学合理的折衷方案。

该方法通过预先设定的临床层级比较参与者，优先考虑更严重和客观的临床事件，而健康替代指标和生物标志物则在较低层级提供信息。这种分层设计不仅能够提高老年医学试验的效率，还能在不妨碍临床优先事项的情况下，捕捉整体治疗效果。通过合理化结果选择、排序和平局规则，并与监管机构达成一致，该方法有望在老年医学领域取得更为有效的试验结果，推动老年科学的临床转化进程。

综上所述，采用时间到最差事件分析的分层复合终点为老年医学试验提供了一种新的思路，能够更好地平衡临床需求与监管要求，促进对老年人群体的健康干预研究的深入发展。

items.title: Trial watch: antibody-drug conjugates in cancer therapy.
items.body: Antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs) combine the target specificity of monoclonal antibodies with the cytotoxic potency of small-molecule payloads. In recent years ADCs have emerged as a clinically validated component of modern precision oncology. To date, more than a dozen ADCs have received FDA approval for oncologic indications, with additional agents approved regionally and hundreds of ADC-based regimens in clinical development. Collectively, these therapies have demonstrated clinical benefit across hematologic malignancies and solid tumors, including significant overall survival improvements in advanced phase clinical trials. In this Trial Watch, we provide an overview on available ADCs from early preclinical development to current clinical applications. We also summarize design principles underpinning clinically successful ADCs, including epitope targeting, linker chemistry, payload toxicity and drug-to-antibody ratio, and discuss how these features can influence pharmacokinetics, intracellular trafficking, bystander effect and toxicity. Finally, we discuss results from advanced-stage clinical trials and approved agents to define future directions.
items.authors: Doffe F, Deng X, Shen Z, Xue E, Schauer K, Kroemer G, Kepp O.
items.title_zh: 抗体药物偶联物在癌症治疗中的应用进展
items.summary_zh: 抗体药物偶联物（ADCs）结合了单克隆抗体的靶向特异性与小分子药物的细胞毒性，近年来已成为现代精准肿瘤学的临床验证组成部分。目前，已有十多种ADCs获得FDA批准用于肿瘤治疗，其他地区也有相应药物获批，数百种基于ADCs的治疗方案正在临床开发中。这些疗法在血液恶性肿瘤和实体瘤中显示出临床益处，尤其在晚期临床试验中显著改善了总体生存率。本文概述了从早期临床前开发到当前临床应用的ADCs，并总结了成功ADCs的设计原则，包括表位靶向、连接子化学、药物毒性和药物与抗体比率，讨论这些特征如何影响药代动力学、细胞内运输、旁观者效应和毒性。最后，分析了晚期临床试验的结果及已批准药物，以指引未来的发展方向。
items.l1_lead: 抗体药物偶联物（ADCs）结合靶向特异性与细胞毒性，已在癌症治疗中显示出显著临床益处，尤其改善晚期患者的生存率，未来发展前景广阔。
items.l2_summary:
抗体药物偶联物（ADCs）是一种结合了单克隆抗体靶向特异性与小分子药物细胞毒性的创新治疗方式，近年来在现代精准肿瘤学中得到了广泛应用。目前，已有十多种ADCs获得美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）批准用于癌症治疗，其他地区也相继批准了相关药物。此外，数百种基于ADCs的治疗方案正在进行临床开发，显示出其在血液恶性肿瘤和实体瘤中的临床益处，尤其是在晚期临床试验中，ADCs显著改善了患者的总体生存率。

本文回顾了ADCs从早期临床前开发到当前临床应用的进展，并总结了成功ADCs的设计原则。这些原则包括表位靶向、连接子化学、药物毒性以及药物与抗体的比率等。这些特征对ADCs的药代动力学、细胞内运输、旁观者效应和毒性等方面产生了重要影响。通过对这些设计原则的分析，可以更好地理解ADCs在治疗中的作用机制及其潜在优势。

在晚期临床试验的结果中，已批准的ADCs药物展现出良好的疗效，为未来的研究和开发指明了方向。随着对ADCs机制的深入理解和技术的不断进步，预计将会有更多的ADCs进入临床应用，进一步推动癌症治疗的精准化和个性化发展。总之，ADCs作为一种新兴的治疗策略，正在为癌症患者带来新的希望，并在肿瘤治疗领域展现出广阔的前景。

items.title: Exploring Splicing-Energy Axis Associations to Diet and Longevity.
items.body: There is increasing evidence that nutrient composition, even without lowering total calorie intake, can shape lifespan through mechanisms independent of mitochondrial regulation. Brandon and colleagues recently reported that a low-protein, high-carbohydrate (LPHC) diet enriched with non-digestible cellulose, extends lifespan in mice by shifting the liver proteome through altered RNA splicing, a response different from the mitochondrial improvements typically seen with caloric restriction. The authors' findings support the "energy-splicing resilience axis," which proposes that changes in splicing help cells adapt to energetic and nutritional stress. We discuss how diet influences spliceosomal components such as SRSF1, linking nutrient sensing, AMPK signaling, and tissue-specific resilience pathways. We also consider the splicing paradox in aging, where beneficial isoforms increase despite a concomitant increase in splicing errors. Understanding how dietary and pharmacologic interventions modulate splicing may shed light on strategies to maintain homeostatic proteomes and support healthy longevity.
items.authors: Donega S, Gorospe M, Ferrucci L.
items.title_zh: 探讨剪接-能量轴与饮食及寿命的关系
items.summary_zh: 越来越多的证据表明，营养成分的变化，即使不降低总热量摄入，也能通过与线粒体调节无关的机制影响寿命。Brandon及其同事最近报道，富含不可消化纤维素的低蛋白高碳水化合物（LPHC）饮食能够通过改变RNA剪接，改变小鼠肝脏蛋白组，从而延长其寿命。这一反应与通常在热量限制下观察到的线粒体改善不同。作者的研究支持“能量-剪接韧性轴”（energy-splicing resilience axis）的观点，认为剪接的变化帮助细胞适应能量和营养压力。文章讨论了饮食如何影响剪接体成分如SRSF1，连接营养感知、AMPK信号传导和组织特异性韧性通路。同时，文章还考虑了衰老中的剪接悖论，即尽管剪接错误增加，仍有有益的异构体增加。理解饮食和药物干预如何调节剪接，可能为维持稳态蛋白组和支持健康长寿提供新策略。
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，低蛋白高碳水化合物饮食通过改变RNA剪接，影响小鼠肝脏蛋白组，从而延长寿命，揭示了饮食与剪接-能量轴的关系。
items.l2_summary:
近年来，越来越多的研究表明，营养成分的变化，即使在不降低总热量摄入的情况下，也能通过与线粒体调节无关的机制影响寿命。Brandon及其同事的最新研究发现，富含不可消化纤维素的低蛋白高碳水化合物（LPHC）饮食能够通过改变RNA剪接，进而改变小鼠肝脏的蛋白组，最终延长其寿命。这一发现与通常在热量限制下观察到的线粒体改善机制有所不同，支持了“能量-剪接韧性轴”（energy-splicing resilience axis）的观点，认为剪接的变化能够帮助细胞适应能量和营养的压力。

研究中，作者探讨了饮食如何影响剪接体成分，例如SRSF1（可变剪接调控因子），并将其与营养感知、AMPK（腺苷酸活化蛋白激酶）信号传导及组织特异性韧性通路相连接。此外，文章还讨论了衰老过程中的剪接悖论，即尽管剪接错误的发生率增加，但仍有一些有益的异构体得以增加。这一现象提示我们，尽管衰老伴随着剪接的失调，细胞仍可能通过特定的机制维持某些功能。

理解饮食和药物干预如何调节剪接，可能为维持稳态蛋白组和支持健康长寿提供新的策略。这项研究不仅为我们提供了关于饮食与寿命之间关系的新视角，也为未来的营养干预和衰老研究开辟了新的方向。通过深入探讨剪接与能量代谢之间的关系，我们或许能够找到更有效的方式来促进健康老龄化。

items.title: Mitochondrial quality control in human ageing and longevity.
items.body: Mitochondria play central roles in cellular metabolism and in key processes such as inflammation, stress response, cell death and signalling. Mitochondrial quality control (MQC) mechanisms continuously monitor organelle integrity and function, and repair or eliminate damaged mitochondria to replace them with newly formed, healthy organelles. MQC is particularly important under metabolic or environmental stress conditions. Failure of MQC paves the way to chronic diseases, such as diabetes, metabolic syndromes and immunosenescence. This Review summarizes our current understanding of MQC biology in the context of healthy human longevity. We explore the regulation of MQC in physiological conditions and explain how the dysregulation of MQC in ageing negatively impacts systemic metabolism and immune function. We discuss emerging therapeutic strategies-such as NAD + , AMPK activators and caloric restriction-that maintain a robust MQC to improve metabolic resilience and illustrate how preclinical and clinical studies can leverage MQC as a potential gerotherapeutic target.
items.authors: Picca A, Ferrucci L.
items.title_zh: 线粒体质量控制与人类衰老及长寿
items.summary_zh: 线粒体在细胞代谢及炎症、应激反应、细胞死亡和信号传导等关键过程中发挥核心作用。线粒体质量控制（Mitochondrial Quality Control, MQC）机制持续监测线粒体的完整性和功能，并修复或清除受损线粒体，以新形成的健康线粒体替代它们。MQC在代谢或环境压力条件下尤为重要。MQC的失效会导致糖尿病、代谢综合症和免疫衰老等慢性疾病的发生。本文总结了我们对MQC生物学在健康人类长寿背景下的当前理解，探讨了MQC在生理条件下的调控，并解释了衰老中MQC失调如何对全身代谢和免疫功能产生负面影响。我们讨论了新兴的治疗策略，如NAD+、AMPK激活剂和热量限制，这些策略有助于维持强健的MQC，以改善代谢韧性，并阐明了如何通过临床前和临床研究将MQC作为潜在的抗衰老治疗靶点。
items.l1_lead: 线粒体质量控制机制对维持细胞健康至关重要，其失效与衰老及慢性疾病相关，探索其调控可为抗衰老治疗提供新策略。
items.l2_summary:
线粒体在细胞的代谢、炎症、应激反应、细胞死亡和信号传导等关键生物过程中扮演着核心角色。线粒体质量控制（Mitochondrial Quality Control, MQC）机制负责持续监测线粒体的完整性和功能，并在发现受损线粒体时进行修复或清除，以新形成的健康线粒体替代它们。这一机制在代谢或环境压力条件下显得尤为重要，MQC的失效与糖尿病、代谢综合症和免疫衰老等慢性疾病的发生密切相关。

当前的研究表明，MQC在健康人类长寿的背景下具有重要意义。随着年龄的增长，MQC的调控能力逐渐减弱，导致全身代谢和免疫功能的负面影响。具体而言，衰老过程中MQC的失调会导致线粒体功能下降，从而影响细胞的能量代谢和应对氧化应激的能力，进而加速衰老过程。

为了应对这一问题，研究者们探讨了一些新兴的治疗策略，包括NAD+、AMPK激活剂和热量限制等。这些策略旨在维持强健的MQC，以改善代谢韧性，进而可能延缓衰老过程。通过临床前和临床研究，MQC被视为潜在的抗衰老治疗靶点，未来的研究将进一步验证这些策略的有效性和安全性。

总之，MQC在维持细胞健康和延缓衰老方面发挥着至关重要的作用，深入理解其机制和调控方式，将为开发新的抗衰老疗法提供重要的理论基础和实践指导。

items.title: Trial Watch - bispecific T cell engagers and higher-order multispecific immunotherapeutics.
items.body: Over the past decades, cancer immunotherapy has evolved into clinical practice, with bispecific T cell engagers (TCEs) and other higher-order multispecific immunotherapeutics emerging as approaches for precision immune modulation. These engineered antibodies redirect immune effector cells toward tumor targets, thereby eliciting coordinated antitumor immune responses. While substantial clinical success has been achieved in hematologic malignancies, major challenges, such as limited activity in solid tumors, continue to constrain broader application. In this Trial Watch, we summarize recent preclinical advances in the design and optimization of TCEs and multispecific immune engager platforms together with available clinical trial data. We further examine key pharmacokinetic, safety, resistance, and manufacturing considerations in immune engager development. Collectively, these findings highlight the increasing versatility of immune cell-redirecting immunotherapies and their pivotal role in shaping the next generation of precision cancer therapy.
items.authors: Xue E, Deng X, Doffe F, Kroemer G, Kepp O.
items.title_zh: 双特异性T细胞引导剂及多特异性免疫治疗进展
items.summary_zh: 近年来，癌症免疫治疗逐渐进入临床实践，双特异性T细胞引导剂（TCEs）及其他多特异性免疫治疗方法成为精准免疫调节的新策略。这些工程化抗体能够将免疫效应细胞引导至肿瘤靶点，从而引发协调的抗肿瘤免疫反应。尽管在血液恶性肿瘤中取得了显著的临床成功，但在实体肿瘤中的活性有限等主要挑战仍然制约着其更广泛的应用。本文总结了TCEs和多特异性免疫引导平台的设计与优化的最新前临床进展，以及现有的临床试验数据。同时，我们还探讨了免疫引导剂开发中的关键药代动力学、安全性、耐药性和生产考虑。这些发现共同强调了免疫细胞重定向免疫治疗的日益多样性及其在塑造下一代精准癌症治疗中的关键作用。
items.l1_lead: 双特异性T细胞引导剂及多特异性免疫治疗在癌症免疫治疗中展现出潜力，但在实体肿瘤应用上仍面临挑战，需进一步优化和研究。
items.l2_summary:
近年来，癌症免疫治疗逐渐成为临床实践的重要组成部分，其中双特异性T细胞引导剂（TCEs）及其他多特异性免疫治疗方法被视为精准免疫调节的新策略。这些工程化抗体的设计旨在将免疫效应细胞精确引导至肿瘤靶点，从而激发协调的抗肿瘤免疫反应。尽管在血液恶性肿瘤中，TCEs已取得显著的临床成功，但在实体肿瘤中的应用仍面临活性有限等主要挑战，这些问题制约了其更广泛的临床应用。

本文总结了TCEs和多特异性免疫引导平台的最新前临床进展，包括其设计与优化过程，以及现有的临床试验数据。这些研究表明，免疫引导剂在不同类型肿瘤中的应用潜力巨大，但仍需克服药代动力学、安全性、耐药性和生产等方面的关键问题。特别是在实体肿瘤治疗中，如何提高TCEs的有效性和安全性是当前研究的重点。

此外，本文还探讨了免疫引导剂开发中的一些重要考虑因素，如药物的代谢过程、可能的副作用以及耐药机制等。这些发现强调了免疫细胞重定向免疫治疗的多样性，表明其在塑造下一代精准癌症治疗中的关键作用。随着研究的深入，未来有望通过优化TCEs的设计和应用策略，进一步提升其在实体肿瘤治疗中的效果，从而为患者提供更为有效的治疗选择。

items.title: The prenatal sex steroid theory of autism after 25 years.
items.body: We first proposed the prenatal sex steroid theory of autism 25 years ago to account for a number of then-unexplained observations around autism, including (1) the more frequent diagnosis of autism in male than in female individuals and (2) apparent 'male-type' shifts in cognitive traits associated with autism, such as empathizing and systemizing. Here we review 25 years of research testing this theory. Early studies found that higher prenatal testosterone levels were associated with slower social, language and empathy development, greater attention to detail, stronger systemizing and more autistic traits. Subsequent studies suggested that both prenatal androgens and oestrogens are associated with autism. New methods in genetics and using stem-cell-derived neural organoids have further indicated the importance of sex steroid hormones for neurodevelopment, as well as atypical patterns in autism. These new findings support and open new lines of research into the prenatal sex steroid theory of autism.
items.authors: Baron-Cohen S, Tsompanidis A, Srivastava DP, Mill J, Lancaster MA, Adhya D, APEX consortium, Warrier V.
items.attribution_note: 协作组署名，ORCID 命中即采信
items.title_zh: 产前性激素理论与自闭症：25年的研究回顾
items.summary_zh: 本文回顾了产前性激素理论（prenatal sex steroid theory）提出25年来的研究进展，该理论旨在解释自闭症的多项未解现象，包括男性自闭症患者的比例高于女性，以及与自闭症相关的认知特征如同理心和系统化的“男性化”倾向。早期研究发现，较高的产前睾酮水平与社交、语言和同理心发展缓慢、对细节的关注度提高、系统化能力增强及更多自闭症特征相关。后续研究表明，产前雄激素和雌激素均与自闭症相关。利用基因学新方法和干细胞衍生的神经类器官的研究进一步强调了性激素在神经发育中的重要性及自闭症中的非典型模式。这些新发现支持了产前性激素理论，并为未来研究开辟了新的方向。
items.l1_lead: 产前性激素理论在解释自闭症的性别差异和相关认知特征方面取得了重要进展，强调了性激素在神经发育中的关键作用。
items.l2_summary:
本文回顾了产前性激素理论（prenatal sex steroid theory）提出25年来的研究进展，该理论旨在解释自闭症（autism）的一些未解现象，尤其是男性自闭症患者的比例显著高于女性，以及与自闭症相关的认知特征如同理心（empathy）和系统化（systemizing）的“男性化”倾向。早期研究发现，较高的产前睾酮（testosterone）水平与社交、语言和同理心的发展缓慢、对细节的关注度提高、系统化能力增强及更多自闭症特征相关。这些发现为理解自闭症的性别差异提供了生物学基础。

后续研究进一步表明，产前雄激素（androgens）和雌激素（estrogens）均与自闭症的发展相关。通过基因学的新方法以及干细胞衍生的神经类器官（neural organoids）研究，科学家们强调了性激素在神经发育中的重要性，并揭示了自闭症中的非典型模式。这些新发现不仅支持了产前性激素理论，还为未来的研究开辟了新的方向，提示我们在探索自闭症的成因时，需更加关注产前环境中的激素水平及其对大脑发育的影响。

综上所述，产前性激素理论为理解自闭症的性别差异及其相关特征提供了重要的生物学视角，强调了性激素在神经发育过程中的关键作用，并为未来的研究提供了新的思路和方法。

items.title: Genomic Perspective on Heterogeneity of Organs and Body Aging.
items.body: Aging is a heterogeneous process, with organ systems and individuals experiencing variable rates of decline that are not fully reflected by chronological age. This variability contributes to the complexity of system morbidity, which poses increasing challenges for clinical care and biomedical research. In this review, we discuss the heterogeneity of organ and whole-body aging and perspectives on genomics as possible mechanisms that relate to such heterogeneity. We discuss how static genomics, including nuclear genetic variants, and dynamic genetics, such as somatic mutations, epigenetic drifts, and mitochondrial DNA changes might explain the variable rate of aging across organ systems and the whole body. We discuss that the use of metrics that capture heterogeneity in organ and body aging is critical to identify genomic biomarkers of aging, clarifying mechanisms of adaptation versus decline.
items.authors: Salimi S, Raftery D, Ferrucci L.
items.title_zh: 器官与身体衰老的基因组视角
items.summary_zh: 衰老是一个异质性过程，器官系统和个体的衰退速度存在差异，这种差异并不完全由生理年龄反映。本文评述了器官和全身衰老的异质性，以及基因组学作为可能机制的视角。我们探讨了静态基因组（如核遗传变异）和动态遗传学（如体细胞突变、表观遗传漂移和线粒体DNA变化）如何解释不同器官系统和全身的衰老速率差异。我们指出，使用能够捕捉器官和身体衰老异质性的指标对于识别衰老的基因组生物标志物至关重要，有助于阐明适应机制与衰退机制之间的关系。
items.l1_lead: 衰老是一个异质性过程，器官和个体的衰退速度受多种基因组因素影响，需通过特定指标识别衰老的基因组生物标志物。
items.l2_summary:
衰老是一个复杂且异质的过程，不同器官系统和个体的衰退速度存在显著差异，这些差异并不能完全通过生理年龄来解释。本文探讨了器官和全身衰老的异质性，并从基因组学的角度分析了可能的机制。研究指出，静态基因组（如核遗传变异）和动态遗传学（包括体细胞突变、表观遗传漂移和线粒体DNA变化）在解释不同器官系统和全身衰老速率的差异中发挥了重要作用。

具体而言，静态基因组提供了个体遗传背景的基础，而动态遗传学则反映了随着时间推移，细胞内遗传物质的变化。这些变化可能导致不同器官在衰老过程中表现出不同的生理特征和功能衰退速度。例如，某些器官可能由于特定的遗传变异或突变而表现出更快的衰老速度，而其他器官则可能由于更为稳定的遗传特征而衰退较慢。

为了更好地理解衰老过程，本文强调了使用能够捕捉器官和身体衰老异质性的指标的重要性。这些指标不仅有助于识别衰老的基因组生物标志物，还能阐明适应机制与衰退机制之间的关系。通过深入研究这些机制，未来的研究可能为衰老相关疾病的预防和治疗提供新的思路和方法。

总之，衰老的异质性是一个多维度的现象，基因组学为我们提供了理解这一复杂过程的重要视角。通过结合静态和动态遗传学的研究，科学家们能够更全面地揭示衰老的机制，从而为改善人类健康和延缓衰老提供科学依据。

items.title: AI proteomics: from protein identification to virtual cells.
items.body: Artificial intelligence (AI) is transforming scientific research, including proteomics. In this Perspective, we highlight key mass spectrometry (MS)-based proteomics areas where AI is driving innovation, ranging from protein identification to building AI virtual cells. These include improving peptide and protein identification and quantification; characterizing protein-protein interactions and protein complexes; advancing spatial and perturbation proteomics; integrating multi-omics data; and, ultimately, enabling AI virtual cells. Finally, we call for global collaboration among data producers, data consumers and other stakeholders to establish an AI-friendly ecosystem for MS-based proteomics, laying the foundation for transformative advancements in proteomics driven by AI.
items.authors: Sun Y, A J, Liu Z, Sun R, Qian L, Payne SH, Bittremieux W, Ralser M, Li C, Chen Y, Dong Z, Perez-Riverol Y, Khan A, Sander C, Aebersold R, Vizcaíno JA, Krieger JR, Yao J, Han W, Zhang L, Zhu Y, Xuan Y, Sun BB, Qiao L, He

items.title_zh: 人工智能在蛋白质组学中的应用与前景
items.summary_zh: 人工智能（AI）正在改变科学研究，尤其是蛋白质组学（proteomics）领域。本文重点讨论了基于质谱（MS）的蛋白质组学中，AI推动创新的关键领域，包括蛋白质的识别与定量、蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用及蛋白质复合物的表征、advancing spatial和扰动蛋白质组学、整合多组学数据，以及最终实现AI虚拟细胞的构建。我们呼吁数据生产者、数据使用者及其他利益相关者之间的全球合作，以建立一个有利于MS基础蛋白质组学的AI生态系统，为AI驱动的蛋白质组学变革奠定基础。
items.l1_lead: 人工智能正在推动蛋白质组学的创新，特别是在蛋白质识别、相互作用及多组学数据整合等领域，呼吁全球合作以建立有利的AI生态系统。
items.l2_summary:
人工智能（AI）正在深刻改变科学研究，尤其是在蛋白质组学（proteomics）领域的应用。本文探讨了基于质谱（MS, mass spectrometry）的蛋白质组学中，AI推动创新的几个关键领域。首先，AI在蛋白质的识别与定量方面展现出强大的能力，通过机器学习算法，能够更准确地分析复杂的质谱数据，从而提高蛋白质的检测率和定量精度。其次，AI技术在蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用及蛋白质复合物的表征中也发挥了重要作用，能够帮助研究人员更好地理解生物分子之间的相互关系，揭示其在细胞功能中的作用。

此外，AI还推动了空间蛋白质组学（spatial proteomics）和扰动蛋白质组学（perturbation proteomics）的进展，这些领域通过结合空间信息和动态变化，能够提供更全面的蛋白质功能和相互作用的视角。整合多组学数据（multi-omics data）也是AI在蛋白质组学中的一个重要应用，AI能够将来自不同组学层次的数据进行整合分析，从而揭示更复杂的生物学现象。

最终，本文展望了AI虚拟细胞的构建，这一前景将为生物医学研究提供新的工具和方法。为了实现这些创新，作者呼吁数据生产者、数据使用者及其他利益相关者之间的全球合作，以建立一个有利于MS基础蛋白质组学的AI生态系统。这种合作将为AI驱动的蛋白质组学变革奠定基础，推动科学研究的进一步发展。通过这些努力，AI有望在蛋白质组学领域实现更大的突破，为生命科学的研究提供强有力的支持。

items.title: Comparison between accelerated and standard or sham rTMS in the treatment of depression: A systematic review.
items.body: Major depressive disorder (MDD) represents a major global health challenge, with a significant proportion of patients being resistant to drug treatment (TRD). Repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) has shown promise in the treatment of MDD/TRD, with a single stimulation session per day for five days per week over several weeks (the "standard" protocol). The two main paradigms used are high-frequency rTMS and intermittent theta burst stimulation (iTBS) delivered to the left dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (DLPFC). Accelerated TMS (aTMS) protocols aim to make the treatment more effective, or at least more rapidly effective, by delivering more stimulations in a shorter time, which could also facilitate the implementation of the protocols for a larger number of patients. In this systematic literature review, articles comparing in the same study an aTMS protocol to a standard or sham rTMS protocol were retained for analysis. Thus, 23 articles were retained and the analysis focused on the efficacy of aTMS protocols used for the treatment of depression (MDD/TRD) as well as on the impact of various stimulation parameters, such as stimulation pattern, intersession interval, dosage, and methods of cortical targeting. Although some studies did not report significant differences between aTMS and standard or sham protocols, others suggested potential advantages of aTMS, such as twice-daily HF-rTMS of the left DLPFC or more intensive iTBS protocols with a long interval between two sessions and personalized cortical targeting. Our results highlight the influence of the number of sessions or pulses per session (dosage), the duration of the interval between sessions, and the precision of target localization (using image-guided neuronavigation) on therapeutic efficacy. However, limitations in sample size, few independent studies replicating the same methodology, and variability in the clinical profile of treated patients, given different definitions of treatment resistance or the presence of comorbidities, hamper definitive conclusions.
